Fast pass holders almost had no wait at all and this was jamming up the general population lines; sometimes there would be no progress in the line for a half an hour letting all the fast pass people ride.  We ended up staying in the little kid area for the majority of the time. There were long lines there too but the characters came out frequently and were very good with the kids and taking pictures. There was also a nursing room, but only 4 stalls-usually there was a line in there too!  Make sure you get the fast pass and get your tickets from Lawson before you go!

We had a great time at Universal Studios Japan!  "Important Tip: (1) The lines can be very long e.g. 200+ hours. If available, purchase fast pass. (2) All the shows are in Japanese. If you are a show goer, maybe Universal Studios Singapore is better for you".  There are some awesome attractions at USJ. Our favourite stop was definitely "The Wizarding World of Harry Potter". While there, be sure to get yourself a Butterbeer – the best beer (non-alcoholic) EVER! Also, eat at Three Broomsticks restaurant. We had a feast there and the food was amazing!  As far as rides go, "Jurassic Park - The Ride" and "Hollywood Dream - The Ride" were our two favourites.

Unless you are able to pre-book an express pass it is a waste of both time an money. The three good rides (4 if you count the backward version of Hollywood dream) all have at least a two hour waiting line without access to seating, toilet or water. If you like rides, go someplace else.

This attraction is definitely geared towards the Japanese, and it would have been more enjoyable if I understood more of the language. For example, I did not understand what they were saying when I went though the Hairy Potter exhibit, but I still made it though.  I still had fun on one of the roller coasters, and young children (regardless if they spoke the language) would love it.

Great place to visit. The Wizarding World of Harry Potter was fantastic. It is worth it to buy the Express pass, a tad bit expensive, but time is usually of the essence at these parks and I didn't have the luxury of waiting in line for hours for rides that only took 5 minutes. I learned this that hard way from our visit of Universal Studios in LA.

The last Universal Studio I have been to was when I was probably 12 in LA so this is quite new to me. I was told most of the rides are similar to ones found in others. We spent about half a day here as the park isn't very big. It is also easily accessible on the subway from virtually anywhere in Osaka.  We basically went and purchased our tickets and express pass weeks before we went. Tickets to the park you can also buy at the door but if you want to skip the lines for some rides you have to get the express pass. Most of the cases the queue in the express pass line is 20% of what it would be normally. So you definitely shorten the time it requires for each ride. We bought the 5 rides pass and felt it was sufficient but you can get up to 7 rides pass. Advance purchase of the express pass is only sold on the Japanese website. If you don't read Japanese, I remember there are posts and blogs about what to do step by step if you Google it. You first have to register an account and you can just proceed as the guide.  There are restaurants scattered throughout the park but nothing that is extraordinary and is your typical theme park food.
Although a much smaller version to its namesake in Los Angeles, the Universal Studios at Osaka is a pretty fun place to visit. Lots of attractions and fun, although, does not come cheaply.

Advisable to arrive half an hour earlier before gate open. It is not surprising that you get to see long snaking queues waiting at the gate. Food is very expensive inside. Recommend that you purchase your shushi rolls, sushi rice (the one in triangle shaped), drinks and some snacks at the convenient stores outside before you enter the theme park. This will help to save some money if you are on budget. Harry Porter is a must to visit. Once you are there, you are totally 'transported' to a different dimension of world. The place is not huge but captivating. Remember to visit Harry Porter land first once you enter the theme park.

Last time I was here was 13 years ago and I think it has deteriorated since!! Not very international friendly. No English subtitles at all, can't follow story lines to the rides that could go on (which was only 4). Wait for people who don't want to pay so much more money on top of entrance fee which already high have fee was over 4h for Harry Potter rides and over 2h for some others so means can't go to them at all. Save your money.

Great rides. Went 2 days before national holiday so it was only a little crowded. It rained but we made the best of it. We dressed as wizards and loved the Harry Potter park. Getting the tickets were a little difficult because the employees could barely speak English. Luckily we arrived way before the park opened. We bought the Express 7 pass and I thought it was well worth it. Still our entry to the HP park was at 1230. Butter beer was tasty and the HP 3D ride was awesome. We bought our tickets on the Japanese website do we didn't have to stand in line. You can't get it on the English website. Overall it was a great visit.

The experience was excellent and my 7-year-old had a great time. The best rides (according to him) were Spiderman, Space Fantasy, and Back-to-the－Future. I enjoyed the Harry Potter ride, but my son found it to be too scary. Age ７ - 8 is a perfect age for USJ, since you are big enough for all of the `big kid` rides (except the Hollywood Dream and Backdrop) but small/young enough to enjoy the `little kid` rides in the Sesame Street/Hello Kitty area. I wouldn`t recommend the weekend or National holidays unless you have an Express Pass, but a weekday is probably okay without one. We didn`t have one, and the longest we had to wait in line was about 60min for both Spiderman and Space Fantasy.

I was just shocked by how crowded the theme parks were in Japan in general. We went on a 'slow to moderate' day and all of the rides had a minimum 60-90 minute wait. We got lost on the way to the park so we arrived about an hour after opening. The line just to get tickets was 30 minutes. Then to get in we ran to Harry Potter World just to find out that you have to get a ticket to get into Harry Potter World. Having been to Orlando's HPW twice, I was surprised by this. It took us about 20 minutes just to find the area where they were giving out the tickets for the Harry Potter World. Which we then waiting in line, to get a ticket, to give us a time, to get into Harry Potter World later. Where we will then have to wait in more lines.  At this point we decided to go check out some of the other rides while we waited. We managed to get on Jaws pretty quick going through the Single Rider line. The rest of the 'big' rides had lines at least 2 hours. The 'small' lines were around 60 minutes. Others like the Jurassic Park were close to 3 hours, and that was AFTER you got a ticket, to come back to wait in line. It was just insane. I have never been to a theme park where it was that crazy. We ended up waiting in line for about an hour to go on the Back to the Future ride because they got rid of it in the states. And by that time it was time to go into HPW.  By the time we got into HPW the Forbidden Journey line was over 4 hours long. Which was the entire reason we went to Universal. I was a bit heart broken. The Flight of the Hippogriff was just over 2 hours long. They had waiting lines roped off to get into Honeydukes and the Three Broomsticks. And all of the shops were over crowded. I managed to still get my weight in souvenirs though.  After just hanging out, eating and doing some photo taking in HPW we decided to go wander around the rest of the park again. It was fun to just people watch. There was a lot of cosplays. My friends were having fun taking pictures with the cosplayers. We didn't end up riding anything else though. We did go to the One Piece show that evening because our friend is a HUGE One Piece fan. It was a great show even though I couldn't understand anything and had no idea what was going on. This was probably my favorite part of the day besides buying all of the Harry Potter goodies.  Overall the park was way over packed in my opinion. Even for a 'slow' day. But we still found a few jems in the rough.

First time in this place. The rides and shows are awesome and very artistic. The top three shows and ride we like are the Harry Potter, Robo Cop and Spider Man, our most favorite is Spiderman. Very big place but very organized. All spots had information. Congratulations to the management for making this wonderful and excellent animation and very good structure. experience is value for money and worth . Thank you Guys for a Job well done.

Read an earlier review which suggested the same. However, we were not able to get the Express pass via the hotel and decided to try our luck at the park since my 11 years old was looking forward to the visit (we had fun at the Universal Studios in Singapore and we managed to get Express pass there at the gate). Apparently, here they are usually sold out online so please don't expect to be able to get them at the gate. Given that we were already there, we decide to give it a try anyway but the park was just too crowded. If you can stand to wait 2-3 hours in line for a ride then I would recommend entering without first getting the Express Pass. For us, as it turned out, we decided to leave the park early due to the wait (at the request of the 11 years old). To be fair, the Harry Potter ride was enjoyable but for a 3 hours wait? We saw the rollercoaster rides with waiting time of up to 4 plus hours! Just be warned!

I will reiterate what previous posters have said, unless you can get the express pass it is not worth it. They were all sold out by the time we got there at about 10am. In total I think we spent about 5-6 hrs queuing. Worst was the Harry Potter ride 2+hrs, the others averaged around an hour. Its just not worth it. We managed to do about 5 of the major rides, didn't really see any shows and spent some time in the young kids area. After going to Disney, where we felt we had got our moneys worth, this was a real disappointment, certainly did not walk out feeling the same way. I would say this is also suited to older kids, there were a few rides my 2 were not tall enough for, although that didn't make a difference, the number of rides we could do was more limited by time wasted queuing than anything else.

I mainly went for the Harry Potter world which was great, get there at opening time to avoid a super long wait for the forbidden journey ride. Although it's actually worth a long wait. The other ride is ok but it's like a 10 second ride and we waited 2hrs!!! So it's not worth it.  As for the rest of the park, there are too many cruddy simulation rides and not enough roller coasters. All of the shops are the same pretty much and walking around I was bored out of my mind a little.  In short, it's only worth it for Harry Potter.

Second time I've taken my family from Tokyo to Osaka on Shinkensen (not cheap), but we got the added benefit of amaziing weather and a nice surprise in Halloween Zombie adventure at night (starting at 6pm). We were there at park open and the life saver due to packed/crowds was the fast-pass, which I say is an expensive but very necessary for this park. We zipped through lines in minues whereas the lines were hours, literally, esp harry potter (i think the sign said 240 minutes, are you kidding me?!!!!).... Anyway, we left the park at 930, but the kids k,eep talking about the zombies, chasing the zombies, confronting them, etc. could be scary for little little ones, but my 9 year old (and 18 year old) loved it. The usual rides of USA are here, but the space adventure is unique and a blast--my favorite one for the kids I believe... Spider man was most excellent. And Harry potter now has 3D upgrade which is making an awesome ride/experience, even better. The weather was perfect.

This is my first time going to Universal Studios Japan. I was amazed and excited by the attractions here especially the rides. I loved to Jurrasic Park ride. There were having Halloween event too so the kids were having so much fun trick or treating with various mascot of USJ like Pink Panther, Elmo from Sesame Street, Snoopy and Charlier Brown etc. The new Harry Porter section is amazing as well. It's a great place to be for family and kids.

Not much a fan of theme parks but I would definitely go back here for Wizarding World of Harry Potter. However, there are certainly long waiting time on popular rides despite that we went on a Monday and it is not holiday. If you want to skip the lines get the express entry early on. This will save you some time. Another thing to mention, almost everything is in Japanese. There's no English version of the rides.

Theme park won't be in my itinerary unless I travel with my children.  But, somehow most of the tour included it... so we just go there!  I don't like roller coaster or I don't want to have sudden heart attack because of few minutes adrenaline rush rides!  But, 'The Amazing Adventures of Spider Man' and 'Back to the Future' motion-based simulation rides still acceptable... with just a bit of screams, occasionally closed my eyes, and tightly grasped my seat during the rides!  Anyway it's fun strolling around the theme park and watch 3D or 4D movies.

My travel partner and I got up early and arrived Universal Studio Japan (USJ) at 8am. We were able to go in at 830am because of crowd control. (Official opening time for that day is 9am).  One great attraction in USJ is the Harry Potter World. It is hard to get an entrance ticket if you arrive late (unless you purchase the Express 5 or 7 ticket). If you have a limited budget, this is a great way to save money. Simply arrive earlier and run a few hundred meters from the park entrance to the Harry Potter World (everyone will be running towards there).  Must try: Butter beer  One more tip: wear a pair of comfy shoes!
Need to have a full day especially if you are into rides. Waited over 90mins for one of the rides. Japanese are generally courteous and helpful.

My partner and I headed out early from Kyoto to Osaka to visit USJ. We thought we had done the right thing by leaving early and arrived at the park 30mins before opening time. What greeted us was a crowd of people that was similar to visiting Wembley stadium for final. For the next 6hrs we did nothing but queue, queue and queue. We only really went to visit Harry Potter world and when we arrived we were told we had to go and get a timed ticket to enter. We went and stood in another queue to get a ticket to then go and queue for HP. It took just over 2hrs of back and forth before we got into HP world and it really was fantastic. My partner is not a fan of HP but he had to admit that it was done incredibly well and the set pieces were fantastic. The were considering doing the rollercoaster and aske dhow long the queue was, we were told it had reduced quite a bit and therefore it was only going to be 4hrs. Yes 4hrs!!! We just laughed and went and go a butter beer (which we had to queue for). We had tried to get a fast pass tickets upon arrival but all these had been sold within 15minutes of the ticket booths opening. We only did one other ride and again had to wait for 90mins to do that. We left around 2pm and couldn't wait to get out of the place. We spent £80 and I can't say that it was really value for money. I think they need to limit the number of people on any given day but I can't see that will ever happen. Tips for a better experience, book online, get a 2 for 1, stay at the hotel nearby and be prepared to wait in line.......a lot!!!
I have been there once last year.I love this place so much. This place can bring back my childhood's feeling. but too sad I just back then they launch new theme (Harry potter). PS. i will be back :)

Best decision to get the express pass. Especially we chose a Monday and later found out that it's a public holiday. With the express pass, we just bypassed hundreds of people in the queue, saving many hours of wait and tired legs. We took the ride/show for terminator, amazing spiderman, jaws. Spiderman followed by jaws were my pick. The jurassic park was closed for renovation and the Harry Potter park was nothing to shout about. We had a meal in the harry potter restaurant. The butter beer and pork ribs were nice but everything else are below average and we're pretty expensive. Huge range of souvenirs and overall a good experience.

We came here for the day for a change as I had never visited Universal Studios before and it seemed like a different way to spend the day. From a people watching perspective Universal is excellent, so many people dressed up! However the rest I would say was less impressive. The Fast Ticket service was only in operation for Jurassic Park (and on that ride we barely waited), but for all other rides the queues were huge. there were no Fast Passes available when we brought our tickets at the gates despite going early. Riding as singles got us on a few rides faster, but as the queue for the Harry Potter ride was never less than 2 hours (and by the time we left was a 4 hour wait) we decided to give it a miss. I would advise getting in early, going to the one ride you most want to go on and then getting used to the fact there will be many queues. Everything is in Japanese which goes without saying, but if taking kids it would mean that all pre ride videos and theming will be unintelligible.

Universal Studios is what it is. Went to the park by myself and because of the single rider lines I was able to do most rides by noon, even though there were massive lines for guests taking the normal line. Recommend doing Harry Potter land the last hour - as lines there are short by then.

We had an incredible time. There was a huge diversity of rides, and some were a lot more fun than we were expecting! The roller coasters are great, with Space Fantasy being a particular indoor highlight. Harry Potter world is very immersive and the rest of the attractions are great!  The lines can be long, but definitely no worse than any other theme park globally - however if you want to make the most of your day there, the VIP passes are not optional. You'll spend most of your day in a line unless you can skip with your VIP pass.  Try and take in your own lunch - the food there isn't all that great, so we packed some inari to snack on and had a wonderful time.

Admittedly, I only came here to visit the Wizarding World of Harry Potter. But I'm so glad I did. If you can put aside the annoyance of the overwhelming amount of people, it's really great. Unfortunately, due to the amount of people, the tour/ride inside the castle had a 300 minute wait. The souvenirs were also extremely expenses. The thing that shocked me the most was that if you wanted to dine at the Three Broomsticks, you had to line up, like you would a ride. But I didn't care, any Harry Potter fan should come here!
This is a great park, everything is well manage in the park. And btw, Harry Potter was great and Jurrasic Park too

The queues were terrifying and the fanatic japanese high schoolers can be terrifying too. The trick is to visit the Harry Potter section of the park towards closing time and when the queue for the famous Harry Potter ride is cut from a three to four hour wait to a sane waiting time of twenty minutes. Overall, it will likely be a good experience for the children but you have to go armed with patience and the ability to protect yourself and/or your child from the shoving crowd.

we went on a wed thinking less people. seems like this park is crowded every day. harry potter land is the best, you feel like you are in the movie. the ride was so real, even better than the transformers in singapore. make sure you buy the express pass. we went to harry potter and the ride had a 200 minute wait. with our pass this took us 10 minutes. all else you can miss, especially if you don't speak japanese.
Go to get your timed reservation for Harry Potter theme park early. You cannot get into Hogsmede if you don't get one. Frozen butter beer is a must.
this would have been the BEST if they had English as part of every show or event. Still i enjoyed every minute of my stay in UNIVERSAL Studio.

I feel wow for this place! Have read instruction prior for this place and yes queue and queue and queue all the way! So jealous for those who bought express ticket!!! I had to queue for Harry Potter ride for nearly 2 hours and 2 and a half hours for roller coaster but worth it! Mel's drive in beef burger with avocado is great and the onion ring too. Love the atmosphere especially the Harry Potter zone.
There's very crowded during my visit. I wait for 5 hours to enter and the queue for butter beer is longer than 30 minutes.

I visited USJ on 27 October (Tuesday) without an Express Pass. Since we have a Universal Studio in Singapore, I reckoned that I can do without the express pass if I skipped those rides that are similar to those in Singapore.  The park's official opening time is 9.30am but I have read reviews about them opening 45 minutes earlier and true enough it opened at 8.45am but not before letting in hundreds of people (not sure if they are from tour group or annual pass holders) at 8.40am. I have read that if you run fast enough, you will not need a timed ticket nor queue hours for the Harry Potter Forbidden Journey Ride. I was really worried when the 8.40am group ran in but to my surprise i was able to hop onto the ride without having to queue at all. The queue line became 45mins long when I'm done.  I realised later on that we missed the Bio hazard 3 ticket distribution. I heard that it's really fun and I am not sure when they start giving out the tickets. Probably, you should run to get the tickets before going to Harry Potter?  The Hollywood Dream has got to be my favorite roller coaster ride, we queued 2 hours for it. We didn't managed to take any of the Halloween rides after 6pm but it is entertaining enough to be roaming around, looking at the Halloween displays and get scare by "ghosts" played by USJ staff/volunteers.  I think the crowd on the day of my visit is still decent, not mad crowded. There are a few websites that you can take reference from to check the expected crowd for the day of your visit. Try googling for them.  All in all, I really enjoyed my day at USJ.

We went early to get an express pass, unfortunately it was sold out as early as 9 am. We weren't able to see much bec we lined up for 4 hrs to see the 3D attraction of harry potter. though, i would admit that it was really great! and lined up for another 3 hrs to see the 3D attraction of Spiderman. Thats just about our trip in the Universal Studios.
The place is huge and 1 day is not enough! Must buy the fast pass since attraction can be 3 hours long!!! Harry potter city is great, so worth it!

The studio opens daily, with easily accessible location from all arround osaka. You'll start to feel the magical athmosphere once you enterred the park area, the spinning globe with their brand awaits.in the entrance.  The ride is truly magnificent, and the park is kept really tidy and clean.  The place is family friendly, but please ensure that you did not visit the park on the goliday season nor a public holiday in Japan, since the park would be super crowded, even you might run out of express passes

USJ's thrilling rides are quite a disappointment as compared to Disney's! It was very crowded and even the express pass sold out so quickly! The ques for the rides are super duper long! Despite the waiting time, everything was great! Still, we had a great time walking around, snapping photos and snacking around!
It is not enough if you came here only for 1 day. At least, 2 or 3 days. Too many people and you have to wait for a long queue. But don't worry because you won't disappointed with all the ride.

Before I came to Japan, My husband and I decided to buy a year pass. We have already been 3 times in 1 month. We arrived when the Halloween was taking place. PLEASE TRY TO GO AT HALLOWEEN!!!! It is beyond amazing to experience. Zombies walked the grounds of the park, if you bought a heart(from the shops) being near a zombie the heart would flash rapidly then RAWR! Zombie about to eat your brainZ!. SO SO funny! So many screams. I've been told that Halloween has become more and more popular over the last few years so I can only imagine it getting better here. The regular rides, so far I have been on Spiderman which was way better than I was expecting (I don't want to reveal too much without spoiling it) But it was super cool! (I'm 26) haha!! Jaws was great the way the lady who speaks to you acts scared of the shark. Again I won't say too much but go here! please please! So much fun! Even if you're an adult you will turn in to a child for the day! If you're only going for one day, I do recommend getting there when it opens to ensure you get to ride as many as possible. some queues(taking in to consideration the event period) were up to 2.5 hours wait. I advise taking cards or Nintendo DS.  :)

I was tossing up whether to go to USJ as a solo traveller but decided it was something worth experiencing as a Harry Potter fan, and I was right!  -Make sure you plan your train route the night before, and get any cash from an ATM before you go, because not every location will accept cards!  -Be prepared to get there super early. An hour or so plus regardless of the day because it will be BUSY. After buying your ticket and joining the end of the lines for entry, look up the rides/areas you want to visit first (Harry Potter!) and be prepared to run.  After running to the Harry Potter area, I found that the waiting time for the rides was significantly less, about an hour, and it means plenty of time to explore, try some Butterbeer, buy a few gifts and take photos. If you arrive early it also means you don't have to worry about obtaining a timed entry ticket for Harry Potter, unless you want to revisit.  The rest of the park is just as amazing, I loved the Terminator ride especially, and the Christmas themed parade was very enjoyable. And if you want to get photos in front of a statue or with a character, everyone is especially lovely and kindly offering to take your photo :)  If you plan your trip to USJ properly, you will get the most out of the experience :)

Great weather to visit in fall. I did my homework before my visit & chose a day with least expected crowd at USJinfo website.  Bought express passes online & printed the QR codes - hung them in a small plastic folder on a lanyard & it was super convenient.  Express passes can only be bought on the Japanese website (English website has no sale), but someone has translated a step to step guide to buy. A search will bring that up, i'm not allowed to post the link in this review but follow the steps & you'll be able to purchase them before your visit.  Don't think about buying express passes when you get there, they will be sold out.  The express pass7 offered 2 versions of the Hollywood Dreams roller coaster, the normal front going & backdrop. It's either or, no option for both. I took the backdrop & loved it. Select your music when you get on your seat.  Entrance crowd was insane, we arrived at 8am on a day that the park opened at 9.30am and it was already packed. Check park opening hours on USJ page.  HP world usually takes down their entrance barrier late afternoon so even if you did not get a timed entry ticket you can try your luck to enter later in the day.  I picked the least crowded day so there was no queue for food & drinks.  We breezed through the crowds with our express passes (already picked what rides we wanted before going) & finished all 7 rides including HP world in under 3 hours.  Singer rider queues are merely 10 mins faster, HP 4D ride had a queue of 220 mins.  Use Hyperdia to plan your train journey to USJ.  Do your homework & enjoy!

USJ, like most places in Japan, is spotless, clean and very orderly with very friendly staff. It is however, very crowded, so the smartest thing I did was to purchase the studio passes and express passes (7) in advance on the USJ Japanese website (using Google Translate). The Express Pass was very well-utilized, because the average waiting time for each adult ride is at least 1 hour, and we are a group of old adults (aged 28, 30, 53).  The rides were mostly great, but I wasn't a fan of the Back to the Future ride, so Express Pass holders would be better off picking JAWS ride. The most exhilarating ride is the Hollywood Dream (Backdrop Version) aka reverse roller coaster. It is amazing, so glad I chose the Backdrop version when I purchased the Express Pass as the waiting time was 2 hours!  And as with most theme parks in the world, the food & beverages within the park are expensive. My family bought loads of onigiri (japanese rice balls) and snacks from the convenience stores outside of the park for lunch.

The park was incredibly busy and the queue for the Harry Potter Experience was painfully long (around two hours), but it was fun, nonetheless. The staff were brilliant and managed the large volumes of people wonderfully and professionally. The highlight for me though was the Jurassic Park ride! Cheesy and great jump scares followed by a giant splash that managed to get through my poncho!

We were unsure how we'd feel about Universal Studios Japan because we've heard it is very crowded, but we had an amazing time! All parts of the park were pristine. The employees were all friendly and smiling despite the rain and 50-degree temperatures. Every ride was fun, and our favorite area, the Wizarding World of Harry Potter, was perfect!!! The Flight of the Hippogriff was a short ride, but we loved it. Seeing the sights from the books and movies come to life was a great adventure! The food in the park was reasonably priced and very good!
Good time to spend with family, and yes, family friendly. I was there during New Years, and it was freezing because it is by the ocean... Keep warm if you go during winter season

The new 4D ride in Harry Potter theme is simply awesome and so realistic! However, the only downside in this theme park is the long queue (up to 1 hour or more) so suggested if you really wanted to enjoy all the ride in the park, you may consider purchase express ticket to avoid the queue.

It is a pity when all express passes are sold out by 10.30am. Having to wait 1.5 hours per ride is unacceptable when you the consider the express pass line line also often becomes longer than the normal line adding to delays. The delays are significantly longer that the USA Universal due to the sheer volume of people who get into the park. Although not entirely Universal's fault, the place is just too "overbooked" with too many people for the amount of attractions on offer - albeit, the attractions by enlarge (that we were able to experience) were pretty good with the exception of the "back to the future ride" which was tacky and outdated. Nb; We went on a weekday and were there from 10.30am until near close and managed to get on only 5-6 attractions without an express pass...). In hindsight, best recommendation is to jump in the Universal Japan (use google chrome and translate) to purchase the express passes in advance (the English website will not allow you to purchase)... Overall, Not so bad if you have young ones and a great deal of patience - would not recommend going in the afternoon particularly if you are wishing to get on any rides quickly or obtain express passes. Food (as expected) is pricey, particularly in the restaurants in proportion to the serving sizes. Shops and food outlets in oropotion to rides are significantly one sided, parts of the park feel just like a big novelty store. On the plus side, the park is laid out well and easy to navigate. Once you enter tha main gates, you are unable to exit to use the shopping forum and visit some of the outside restaurants unless you have a an annual pass. Personally, I would not go out of my way to return. Money is better spent elsewhere in Osaka.

USJ Japan is one of the must see places in Osaka as it offers incredibly amazing amusement to people of all ages. The rides are fantastic. My favorite ride is the Happy Potter. I have been there a number of times as I have a year pass.  If you love going to amusement park like this, I suggest you buy a one year pass so can have great deal.  Have fun and be amused!

You can expect crowd from the moment you see the ticketing booth at USJ entrance. We have at least 20 people in front of us waiting to enter and that was around 10am. Most of them head towards Harry Potter once entering the park. I know it is pricey but it makes the visit easier if you purchase the express pass that includes Harry Potter and the Forbidden Journey. The park is fun for the older kids.

Back to the future and backdraft are really showing their age now.  The harry potter ride and spiderman are very good, with harry potter being unlike anything ive experienced. Jurassic park and jaws were fun but it felt like theyre also old and tired.  Its telling that theyve tried to shoe-horn in the minions because otherwise without harry potter and the minions it seemed like a theme park based on decades old movies.  I dont know whats better, the disneyfastpass or the universal express ticket that essentially doubles the cost of admission.  Without the express ticket you'll end up spendin a long time waiting at HarryPotter. I felt the 7 attraction express pass was worth it for me because I was by myself but its a bit rubbish that it would end up exceedingly expensive for a whole family to do it.  The whole park seemed more like a shopping mall with rides rather than a theme park with shops. It didnt feel that way at disneyland tokyo where there seemed to be a lot more rides.  Universal studios felt like there werent that many good rides so to disguise the fact that there ist that much content they just increased the shopping squarefootage. (Maybe thats why its only open 10am-8pm). The parade was pretty poor too.

Hogwart is a highlight for fans of Harry Potter. Great fun for the family. Best to buy tickets online plus express 5 tickets - express tickets can only be bought at the Japanese language official site.

Came here on a weekday with friends and had a really good time. First thing we did was grab a pass to get a time for entry into Harry Potter world. The Harry Potter was amazing and very fun. The other rides such as spiderman and back to the future ones were similar but not as great. The Hollywood roller coaster was also very exciting. Many of the shows here were in Japanese so quite difficult for our group to understand. Towards the end of the day there are very few people so the lines for many rides are very short which was great. The light parade was a also a good ending to the day. Definitely recommend this for all age groups as there is something here to do for everyone.

Very packed but Harry Potter and some popular ride need to use express ticket and obtained timed ticket, well mixed of theme for different family group. Transport convenient to use JR rail, using Google Map can plan the train timing and route.

Harry Potter was my major attraction. Sadly I went there during Japan's long weekend and the queue was just insane. I had to wait for 3 hours to get into Harry Potter 4D ride. Make sure to get one or two glasses of Butterbeer. It was fantastic.  No attraction queue was less than one hour. During the whole day we only managed to catch 2 rides.  When I was queuing for Jaws, the sun went down, and suddenly for a brief moment all electricity went off. You could hear thunder sound and all of a sudden people started screaming. Zombies!! Zombies everywhere!!! It was so cool! You have to experience it by yourself.  One major disappointment was the very pricey souvenirs. I went to Disneyland and to be honest, I can get 2 jackets in Disney for the same price of 1 jacket in Universal Studio. Major turn off.

Prior to visiting, we had read reviews of the theme park and had assumed after reading that we should be able to cover the grounds in one day. How wrong we were! The Harry Potter World was excellent although the mad rush to get into this part of the park (and line up for the rides) made for a memorable trip. We also enjoyed the Hollywood Dream roller-coaster rides (the backwards ride being particularly trilling and unusual). The family especially my 6 year old enjoyed this visit tremendously.

Universal Studios Japan was a lot of fun, and all main attractions can be easily covered in a day with an Express pass. The park seems to be crowded throughout the year, so go early when queues are the shortest, and hit the most popular rides first. The most hardcore rollercoaster fans may find the rides a bit tame, but they are otherwise very enjoyable. I enjoyed the Jurassic Park and Spiderman rides, and the Wizarding World of Harry Potter felt like it was straight out of the movies. Definitely not to be missed!  Also, try to stay on at night for the Magical Starlight Parade, which is beautiful and accompanied by a rather addictive parade song...

It was raining cats and dogs the day we went but this place was still packed! TG we purchased the 5 ride Express Pass! It's SOOOOOOOO worth the extra money NOT to have to wait in line!! We rode all the "popular" rides and were done with all the rides by 3:00 and headed to Harry Potter World ~~ but it started to DOWNPOUR like CRAZY so after riding HP and the Forbidden Journey (A MUST!!) we decided we'd had enough, did our souvenir shopping and left USJ. Great fun and a much needed break from all the "old" touristy sights we were visiting! :) I bought our tickets online prior to visiting USJ. If you want instructions on how to pre-purchase your ticket ~ please message me and I will send you link as the site is only in Japanese. :)

The good things: - Many attraction to choose for - Must visit the Harry Porter and try the butter beer (it taste like root beer) - Many restaurant to choose for  The bad things: - Most attraction queue about 1 - 2 hours, so I would suggest to buy the Express Pass which can save alot of time
Jaws? Back to the Future? USJ should close these old rides. The rubber shark needs a serious change of skin. The bright side is that the smoked turkey still tasted good; better than DisneySea.
I have a wonderful time at USJ. The park was huge and so spectacular. I hope I'd get a chance to the Usj again soon.

First time in USJ after having visited Osaka several times. Did all sorts of research before coming USJ and concluded that if not confident of buying express pass online at USJ website (japanese only), next best option is to go at least 30mins before they start selling tickets (which is normally an hour before gates open). Buy express pass to beat the queue or if you do not mind taking single rides, the queue is quite fast too. Most popular place is Harry Potter ride so having express pass to this ride is a must. 30mins from start to end even with the express pass. Hollywood dream (backdrop), Harry Potter rides are good for people who won't get motion sickness. One day spent there is enough if you go early.

Very convenience to get to and you can't miss the Harry Potter's section! The 4D ride with Harry Potter and the gang is so exciting!!! lots of rides and places to visit and take a picture. If you go to Osaka, this is a must!

I liked Harry Potter village and recommend tou to try butter beer it was kind of sada with cream. Actually i could not feel thrill from attractions. They were too easy for me althogh i rode almost every attractions. However the backdrop (Hollywood dream roller-coaster)was nice. I used express 7 ticket and it was very useful becuz i didn't have to wait in line. But i think you can just use entrance tickeck without express ticket if the day you visit is not crowded. I also recommend to go very early (8:30) to enjoy famous attractions without waiting. Bring raincoat to ride some attractions, you can buy there but its a bit expensive (400 yen).

We took the direct expressed train from Osaka station to Univesal station on the Sakurajima line.  We booked all our tickets and express pass online early. So there is no need to queue.  Harry Porter ride took us by surprise as we didn't know what to expect of the 4D3K ride. It's thrilling!!! Luckily we bought the express pass and we queued 15 mins. We saw the signbord indicating waiting time 210 mins!! So better to have the express pass.  The other 4D3K rides like spiderman. Space galaxy etc was fun.  Water world and back draft show was familiar, and if you seen it before in Movie World, you can skip and do other rides.  The finale was to watch the Voices of Angel with all the singings and dancing when the show climaxed with the Christmas tree light up and small fire works. Really had a great feeling of Christmas. Do buy your tickets online to get the good views.

Most rides in Universal Studio were combination show+ride, and the "show" parts were totally lost in translation if you don't speak Japanese. We enquired about the VIP ticket but these were for 10 persons or more and were in Japanese only. As such for non-Japanese speakers the show made very little sense. The only exception being the "Hollywood Dream backdrop", which was purely a roller coaster ride, and the Harry Porter part of USJ, which was beautifully and nicely presented. Even then, the 4K 3D Harry Porter ride was also meaningless if you don't understand Japanese.

It has been years since we were last at USJ. We were advised to purchase Fast Passes ahead of time to avoid long queues and so bought the 7-ride package. The highlight for this visit was The Wizarding World of Harry Potter. The package indicated specific time slots for each ride and we had to be mindful not to miss them. My children went on the Hollywood Dream ride which looked like a really scary ride as it went forwards and another, backwards! My children loved it and therefore it is one not to be missed if you enjoy such thrills! Harry Potter world was an amazing land, with Butter beer, shops selling wands, live owls to an amazing replica of Hogwarts atop the hill. All in all the visit was fun. Try the Chicken chowder in a bread bowl.

If you're a first timer in Osaka and have limited time in the city, think twice about coming here!!! The lines are way toooo long. We came on a Sunday 1 hour before park opening. By then, the fast passes for sale had sold out. The Harry Potter area was great but after that, everything was just ok. The wait for Spiderman took 2.5 hours. Even the line to buy popcorn is sooooo long, it's ridiculous. I feel the place is designed for Japanese tourists only. None of the ushers/park staff speak English and do not try to understand our questions at all. All the rides are in Japanese only. Try to buy the express pass from your travel agencies or online, otherwise you'll end up only going to 3-4 rides for your whole day's stay.

Queue to get into park was relatively short, although express passes had sold out long in advance. Map in English provided and park relatively simply laid out.  Very long queues for nearly all rides. Some confusion over where to get timed tickets as not always clearly signed that they were needed. Harry Potter area so crowded difficult to move.  As with any visit to an attraction where you don't speak the language, a lot of the build up was lost in translation - particularly with Terminator and Waterworld. Subtitles would have been helpful - or a written summary to read on the long queues in!  Avoid the Discovery restaurant - they insist on people reserving tables before getting food, meaning 50% of the tables are always empty. And also if you are single with no coat, how are you meant to reserve a table? Absolutely nothing to cater for this and very mediocre food as well.

Went to the park on Dec 29th, line up for 1 hour just to get the ticket and only regular ticket available, Express Pass sold out -- fine. Got in to the park after 10:00, try to get Harry Potter timed ticket got 15:40. From here everything on long queue, none of them less than 90 minutes. Means without Express Pass, you simply wasting your time and money. At 16:00 managed to get in to Harry Potter area, almost faint when looking at the waiting time for Hogward is 4 hours!!! Who the hell is going to wait 4 hours in the cold for 5 minutes show. Bought several merchandise which all made in china and over price for a plastic. The park management should control the crowd, I bet 1 of 5 will never return unless they can get Express Pass. Park crew, 2 level below Disneyland's crew. Talking without megaphone to hundreds of people, what a joke. My suggestion, get the Express Pass before you come -- even 7AM in the morning no more pass available on ticket counter.
Is really a excellent theme park, we can't finish the rides as it just too many rides are waiting for us...
gain the same experience at the universal studios. too many people and overcrowded. almost everything to enjoy you have to queue for hours. worth to have the express line to save time.

Put simply it is better than Universal Studios Singapore and Disney Hong Kong!  As good as Disney Tokyo.  The rides were both exciting and innovative. The queue for rides were manageable.  Litter free and polite park staff and park goers. Osaka Universal Studios offers the ideal Universal Studios experience. Better than even the LA Universal studios.
The must try ride is the Harry Potter ride but be prepared to wait as the waiting time is long. Get fast pass if you can
Enjoyed the place, amazing for small kids too. We directly went to the Amazing Town, suitable for my 2 and 5 years old. Food are extremely expensive tho..

We spent a whole day here in early December and got to see most of the park, but this was only possible because we pre-ordered express passes (about the same price as an entry ticket for us), which were sold out at the gate. The rides were all good fun and there is no shortage of merchandise and food and drinks! We are Harry Potter fans, and spent a lot of money on the huge range of HP merchandise, and had lunch and butterbeer at the Three Broomsticks. The HP 3D ride had a waiting time of 3 hours when we walked in using our express passes, and a 4 hour line when we walked out! Additionally, the rollercoaster had a 2 hour line at night, and we walked straight onto the ride with the express pass.

Yes, the queue for Harry Potter ride was really long, but I can assure you that it is worth the wait! We went to USJ just before the Labour Day long weekend, yet it was very crowded too as expected. We arrived around 11am at USJ and the express pass had already sold out. We had to queue for almost 2 hour for Harry Potter ride, so it wasn't too bad (we'd expected worse). Must try the Butterbeer, it's quite nice - tasted like soda with caramel and totally non alcoholic. Lunch at the Three Broomsticks was just ok - nothing special and a bit overpriced (just like in any other themeparks). We did enjoyed the Harry Potter World. The 2nd best was Spiderman, but the queue was also quite bad. Don't bother to wait for Terminator, it's rather boring. The Light parade was quite beautiful though most of it are from Disney stories & characters.

Universal studio Japan's new attraction Harry Potter's world, once again is making the theme park never fails to attract locals and tourist to visit and play to this park. Cute souvenirs and various attractions inside are always irresistible for kids and family.
My kids enjoyed our trip, I would recommend to go to Harry Potter first because the line is a bit longer than the other attractions, but definitely worth it.

I am not a big fan of theme park or amusement park, going there is just the Harry Porter attraction because my daughter is big fan of HP. But our family had a great great fun day at Universal Studios Osaka because there are a lots to do, plan and see. We spent a whole day from 9 something in the morning till 8pm and we still haven't visited all the attractions, the good thing about this park is its size, not too large that we have to walk a long way between attractions, and not too small that make you feel very crowded (although we went on Monday which is also not a school holiday, but lots of foreigners and local visitors too). Unlikely other theme parks, the restaurant and souvenirs are not too pricy and the quality is quite good as well. I think one day is not enough and recommend to plan for a 2-day visit. Will definitely go again.  Moreover this is my second visit to the park and my first one was more than 10 years ago, but the maintenance of the hardware is very good.

It was a good visit to just enjoy the atmosphere of the parks. Terrible queues and crowd control thought. The lines were confusing, and you had to queue for everything from rides, to toilets and food. Most rides have an hour or more long queue. Ended up only sitting ONE ride through the whole day. Be sure to get your timed entry to Harry Potter park early. Even then you will have to queue to enter. If you don't mind paying to just enjoy the surroundings, then it would be enjoyable. If you intend to sit for rides of rides, it might be a disappointment. The Harry Potter ride queue was 5 hours long, so we didn't even bother.
Spend a little money and get the 'Fast 7 Pass', best we investment we made. The longest line we were in was about 15 minutes. We had the best time here!

Good fun and interesting rides, suitable for all ages (we are late 20's). I would pay the extra 60 dollars or so for the express pass for the rides as it made the day so much easier - I wish Disneyland did it that way too!  Just take it in for what it is, a fairy tale place full of magic for kids, and an appreciation for the effort, money and creativity for the adults!  Bring your own food along if you need. The lines are sometimes too long for the food.

My teenage son and I went to universal studios on a weekday . I thought the admission price was hideous , the Que to get in was followed by another que and another and another . This was a week day so I couldn't imagine what it is like in the weekend . I think we got on 4 rides in the whole day and I have never been in line for so long so often . In my opinion it was a wasted day , there are much better things to do in Japan for a lot less money .

Universal Studios Japan is just nice! it is worth the visit! We went on a Sunday and did not had to use the express pass on early morning. After a few hours the queue for all attractions were big!!! We were very lucky, went to Spider-man and Harry Potter ride twice (the nicest one)! It was possible with express pass. Harry Potter was very quick (30 min) waiting 1:30h before park close time. the others attractions are a bit old! We had fun! however Disneyland and sea are better, because of their structure! Better staff, restaurants, info, attractions...
We try to have experience at Harry Potter, the location are good, decoration, buildings, but to have an entertainment inside you must to be patient of long queues and not worth it.

Spending the day at the Wizarding World of Harry Potter is magical, but Universal Studios Japan in Osaka offers more than just the Harry Potter experience. Before, I thought USJ just offers the usual Universal Studios rides but I am mistaken. In fact, I even enjoyed the attractions in USJ more than those of Tokyo Disney Resort. Universal Studios Japan did a really great job in making Universal Studios rides unique by blending it with the Japanese culture, which creates a really fun and exciting experience!

the universal studios is super huge and their park staff are super friendly,super recommend to go to harry potter,it has really nice rides,food and merchandise store as well. tips:get yourself an express pass for all atractions,the line up is cazy long even on weekdays

Big tip, get here early!! We lined up by 0830 and were lucky enough to go with a local teenager who knew her away around and had already told us what order we were going to do things. When the gates open, you RUN!!! Roller coaster first and then get tickets to go into Harry Potter World, it's a must and one of the best rides I've been on (4D). You can spend a whole day here and still not see it all. Grabbed most of our food from side vendors (Turkey legs, hot dogs, popcorn, churros) which was finally inexpensive. Popular rides you obviously queue for, but they move with a reasonable pace. Our friend had the USJ app on her phone and that kept us up to date with line up times etc. great way to spend the day. All staff super friendly, happy and helpful. Caught the Osaka loop line from Osaka Station to Nishikuju (?) and then the Universal Studio train. Great day out for families with younger and teenage children.

Went with 2 kids but a lot of things closed for renovation, bought 3 express passed only used 2. I think it is a bit of waste with my experience, hopeful much better next time. Overall place is great.

I've been to USJ twice now with friends and find it both overwhelming and underwhelming. Overwhelming in that there's no limit on the number of people who can enter the park and so wait times for rides can easily get to three hours or more. Underwhelming in that the amount of worthwhile attractions can be counted on one hand. There are some amazing rides, but expect to queue for ages. In fact, expect to queue for most things - tickets, food, restrooms, even to get into the shops at times. The crowd control is virtually nonexistent. The second time we went they were doing up the park for the anniversary in 2017 and three of the rides - Space Fantasy, Spiderman and Jurassic Park - were all closed, leaving only Forbidden Journey and Hollywood Dream as appealing rides. There was no extra entertainment lined up to compensate, aside from the "Cool Japan" stuff which you had to pay extra for. And yet they still have the cheek to charge people full price for tickets! There's also no theming except at Harry Potter and the park layout makes no sense. It doesn't feel interesting or immersive, it feels like I'm in a place that just wants my money and doesn't care about the experience it offers in return.

like us, we didn't expect such long queues for attractions and didn't expect the fast passes to be sold out so quickly. so be sure to get your tickets with fast passes online (you'll need them for sure!)  it rained the whole day. but that didn't damper the spirits of the people visiting universal studios Japan. the minimum waiting time per attraction ranged from 30mins to as long as 3.5hours.  the favourite ride would definitely have to be the 3k4d Harry Potter ride which had an insane queue but is definitely worth it. the site grounds were spectacular too!  the place is huge and probably larger than the one in singapore but they have so much to offer and there's so much to see! it's definitely good fun for the entire family. the only pity was the rain.  awesome awesome awesome!

If you are a Harry Potter fan, theres no reason in the world you should missed out on USJ Osaka. Truely fantastic HP theme park, all kinds of HP shopping you can do and the HP game was the best of all games available at USJ, no comparison even for non-HP fan.  Every building at USJ was outstanding and stunning.  For those of you who wants to go please consider buying express passes otherwise you will have to queue fowever to get in.  For HP fans, onve the USJ doors open, you must head straight to the lakeside ticket mechines where staff member will help you to get HP park entry passes, try to get them for morning and if you decide to get the express passes(must buy in advance), get the express 5 and choose HP enter time around 4.30pm so that you also get to see the night view.

I'm glad I got an express pass online one month before our family's visit here. The lines are long. And if you cannot understand Japanese and it is your first time in Universal you will be disappointed. The narration, signs and everything else is in Japanese. You will not understand what Harry Potter is saying. Sorry, no English subtitles.

USJ while getting fairly dated has the exciting Harry Potter World. Just be sure to get in early and get your entry pass into that section. And try and go for an early session as we found as we went later the busier it got due to the overlap from people in other sessions staying there. Also the Harry Potter ride was crazy long with a 230min wait we didn't bother going.

All 3 of us, 2 adults and our son had so much fun. Though the queue leading to most rides and shows were long waiting hours, it didnt stop us. We did almost all the rides, except the one at Harry Potter as the waiting line went up to 140mins! We skipped that tho, sad but well, perhaps some other time. It was a winter trip, but it got really cold towards the end of the day but that didnt stop us from completing the rides at Elmo. It was really a good finale to the excellent day. Had good food at their restaurants, snacked on Minions banana flavoured popcorn and the famous turkey meat at one of the stalls. Express pass would be extremely helpful but that requires purchases very much upfront months before! Love the whole day spent there, must must do! Must must visit!!

Awesome place. Reach early so that you can enjoy all the rides (avoid weekends or public holiday). If you happen to end up on a holiday; rush for the rides is minimal during the last hour of the day so you can catch up all the rides avoiding long queues. If you are lucky, you might get to travel in special Universal trains to reach the Universal city. Nonetheless the experience here is amazing.

My family and I had a great time at Universal Studios Japan. We spent a whole day at the park and were able to get on all the rides we planned on going on, particularly Spider man, Back to the Future, both Harry Potter rides, and the snoopy roller coaster, which my daughter loved, so we did it twice. Here are a few recommendations that made our trip memorable:  1. Try and stay at one of the hotels on Universal City, it is extremely convenient to walk to the park and when you are done at the end of the day, you walk back to your hotel and avoid the mad dash to the train. It can be extremely busy at the closing of the park.  2. Purchase your tickets in advance. I also recommend purchasing Express passes, particularly Express pass 7. It make a huge difference on waiting in line for the rides. For example, we waited 10 minutes to get on the Harry Potter ride, vice 150 minutes. It's worth the 8200 yen.  3. Purchase Express passes. I recommend purchasing your tickets in advance, particularly the express passes. They actually run out. We were fortunate enough to get to the park a day in advanced and purchased our express passes at the hotel. Also note that if you go with the option of purchasing the ticket at one of the USJ hotel partners, you will have to pay in Yen. Credit cards are not accepted for some reason.  4. Bring enough Yen. The convenience store does not dispense yen from a U.S. issued debit or credit card. If all fails and you need yen, any 7-11 convenience stores will work. Lawsson's does not work :(.  5. Look at the website to see what rides are closed. I was looking forward to the Jurassic park ride, but was closed for renovation and construction of the new ride coming in March.  Overall, it was a great trip. I highly recommend if you are in Osaka, check out USJ. It's worth going to.

This was my first time at a theme park, and it didn't disappoint! I went for my birthday, and it was a good time! All the rides were a ton of fun, and just walking around was cool. Back to the Future was my favorite, and I heard that ride isn't in Orlando anymore, so enjoy it here! The only downside was that Jurassic Park was closed for maintenance, but hey, it happens. Definitely recommend!
The Osaka universal was really friendly but too little games for young children and there are a lot of gift shops. I would recommend rather the Disney world in Tokyo than this one .
Way better than Disneyland. Only about 45 min wait time for each ride. Worth it and has a huge variety of rides.

Went on a Tuesday and was very surprised at the number of people there on a weekday .Best advise is to pay the extra money and get a fast pass .Some of the lines ,especially for the main attractions - Harry Potters Castle you could be waiting for up to three hours in the normal line.^The Japanese seem to take this in their stride .Very crowded inside shops supporting the main attractions . Need to do a lot of planning to get the most out of the day with regards to shows and parades times that you wish to visit .

My family and I had organised a package to come to Osaka for a couple of days from Tokyo, mainly to visit Universal Studios Japan.  Firstly, It was a bit upsetting that one train was not available to take you straight to Universal from Osaka Central without the need for a transfer given the relatively close proximity to the city centre. However, this is likely for reasons outside of anyone's control  The studio is designed to cater mainly for the Asian market, there are very few westerners at the park and therefore buying water or Coke can be difficult to find at food carts around the park as opposed to Tea. However, the staff are willing to go above and beyond to help you, so much as escorting us to a place to buy a bottle of water.  The queues to everything especially the ride were ridiculously long, most rides not part of the kids section were 240 min (4hrs). Having been to all the other Universal Studios in the world, the use of the timed ticketing entry to Harry Potter world is excellent. It not only limits the flow of people into such a small area, but ensures that everybody in there has a chance to enjoy everything in offer.  You can't visit a Japanese theme park without buying popcorn in one of the special collector containers. During our visit the containers were shaped as minions, however it is essential to know that it could take up to 1 hr to buy the popcorn or any other food due to the sheer number of people at the park.  The souvenirs are expensive which isn't unusual to theme parks but are more expensive compared to Disney.  Harry Potter World is similar to other Harry Potter world in the USA. However to get into the site you need a ticket we arrived at the park at 10.30am and our ticket allowed us access at 2.10pm. The problem is that in order to go on the rides you then need to wait an additional 4 hrs which is only just before closing time. Also there is a potential for people to visit the park and not be allowed into an entire section of the park because the allocation has been exhausted. Unlike the Orlando park, there is no additional Gringotts ride as well as the additional park space yet, but the shops are all the same and it feels like the books and movies. The butterbeer comes in hot or cold, not frozen, but frozen isn't really required in Japan.  Communication with staff can be difficult but not impossible, lots of pointing is required, but the staff are determined to be of assistance and it is truly refreshing to be surrounded by such politeness.  All in all, it isn't the best Universal Studios, but it does have a Harry Potter World close to Australia and for that it is worth it.

The highlight of my visit was definitely the HARRY POTTER! I stayed in like 2-3 hours in total just in the section. Prepare some snacks as you might get hungry and the food there are ridiculously pricey, I managed to slipped 2 onigiris and a bag of cookie from Lawson. :)
I haven't been to another Universal Studios but this one is very fun with some unique rides! This location will also be opening up a Harry Potter World shortly, so exciting!

We went an hour before doors open on a Friday hoping to get an express pass. Unfortunately, when we arrived they were all sold out and there were already thousands of people there. Somehow, when we entered and went straight for Harry Potter world we got in and only waited about 90 minutes for the main ride. The line goes through the castle so there is plenty to look at while you wait. We realized how lucky we were when we exited after a few hours and the area had been closed off, with only small groups being allowed in at once. Anyway, HP World is amazing! The themeing is ridiculously good. Have a butter beer and get lunch at the Three Broom Sticks! You can go through many of the shops, and go into Olivanders which also has a mini show with someone from the crowd being selected to get a wand. I personally felt like I got my money's worth with that alone, but then there is the rest of the park! Currently, a few areas are closed off for renovations which only means new attractions for next time. Also, the old rides like Jaws still hold their own and are good fun!

Great time there and really fun. The queuing is really a matter especially Harry Potter. In the morning u have to queue ticket entrance time to Harry Potter. But it's worth because really fun inside Harry Potter Park.
Universal Studios Japan is one of favorite places in Japan on earth of me and my boyfriend. Back to the Future simulator ride is sooooooo amazing! will come back for sure.

We went on a weekday arriving at 9.25 (5 minutes before opening) and waited 30 minutes in line to purchase tickets. Fast passes were sold out.  I would recommend buying tickets and fast passes in advance otherwise you'll line up to get tickets then line up for an average of 60-90 minutes per ride (the line for the new Harry Potter 4D ride was 190 minutes!!!).  Also make sure to get a timed entrance ticket for Harry immediately on arrival otherwise you may not get in at all. If there are options, pick the earliest time possible since it seemed to get busier and busier during the afternoon with even lines to get snacks.

We went here specifically for Hogwarts & Hogsmeade (28 & 30yr old on honeymoon). It was even better than anticipated, a must if you're a fan.  The rest of the park was fun, lines were long (60-90 mins), the Back Drop rollercoaster was awesome. I personally get motion sick & ALOT of the rides are simulators.

This place is definitely for kids and people who are fans of harry potter. It's just too crowded, even on a weekday when you would assume that kids are in school... No... Still lots and lots of people. Crazy time to be at during Halloween Week when the park is open till midnight for Halloween Night. My kids really freaked out seeing all thse walking zombies around the park.
Universal Studios Japan is a franchise amusement park that open in Osaka. They not call it Universal Studios Osaka because the short word will be USO which mean liar in Japanese.

Had so much fun and wished we had one more day to spent in the theme park. Be sure to get an express pass and purchase your tickets online before your trip as the crowds were Huge! Queues were really long and expect to wait between 100min to 200min for the popular rides without express passes! Great for young kids esp Sesame Street Imagination Land. My child would have easily stayed there for 2 whole hours or more just having fun in the humongous indoor playground.

Ride waits were 2-3.5hrs which in my opinion isnt worth waiting with kids. It really took the shine off the day. We wnded up having to spend a lot of money on ither activities to make it interesting.  The Harry Potter attraction was incredible and a massive effort to construct I am sure.

This location includes many of the hit attractions that were featured at Universal Studios Orlando in the late 1990's and early 2000's, including Back to the Future! Spiderman! and Jaws! Oldies but goldies is definitely a theme for a good portion of this park.  Harry Potter World is quite nice, but not so nice as the one in Orlando, however I've been told that it's better than one found in the UK. The wait for Harry Potter's area is quite long, get your passes early so you know how to plan your day!  There are several areas and rides unique to this location, including a Hello Kitty area.
its very cool place to visit and must go place if visit Osaka, best places to where the Jrassic Park world and Hollywood Rids. BUT very looong line for Harry Potter we stay for 1 hour and half
Nice place, but the lines is way to long at busy days. A bit expensive to buy front of the line tickets, but this could be recommended.

It's end of March in Japan. Schools out and end of the business year is upon us. Including the 3 days Holiday. Everywhere is crowded in Japan. It's the 15th year Anniversary for Universal City Japan. The City Walk Osaka was fun and when we got to the ticket booth to go into the park, it was sold out for the day! Oh well. It was fun anyways we had lunch and shopped in City Walk for 3 hrs. We had just as much fun not even going into the park. I keep telling the kids.

As a self proclaimed HP lover, I wasn't disappointed with the Wizarding World of HP. It was amazing!!!! We spent all morning in it. I strongly recommend getting there before USJ opens and as soon as the gates open, make a dash for it. If you go that route, you don't need to worry about getting a pass. Awesome (but on the expensive side)!

The visitor to attraction ratio of this park must rival any overcrowded amusement park in the world. Average queues were around 3 hours and this is for a weekday in late winter. USJ needs to either limit the guests or create additional attractions. One of the worst theme park experiences ever.
More More recommended that if you come to Osaka You must visit 7 blocks recommend amazing things come Monday through Thursday that the weekend has a lot of people waiting in line is a long time
kid or adult will enjoy this place. especially the rides and the attractions, picture perfect!!!, no bad can say about this place. please go and enjoy

Some friends and I came on a weekday in hopes that it would be less crowded, however there were huge queues for most rides and in particular the Harry Potter section of the theme park. A particular highlight for me was the roller coaster Hollywood Dream which was the favourite ride I experienced in all Universal theme parks around the world.

We arrived at about 8:15/8:30am and managed to get an entrance into Harry Potter World at 9am (we literally ran through the park to try and beat the crowds). We only had a short, 40min wait for the major Harry Potter ride - and thank goodness because the ride is only about 30secs long! Harry Potter world was ok, probably because not many people had managed to get in yet, but the rest of the park was just so crowded it was impossible to enjoy anything. There are waits and lines for literally anything you would like to do in the park - take photos, buy popcorn, go to the bathroom. The rides all had waits of 2-4hrs so it's impossible to do them all in a day. We really felt a bit ripped off by Universal Studios - we ended up spending the whole day in a line and about 15mins of that on rides (if that). The only ride we liked was the Hollywood Dream and we waited for 4hrs for that.

I was really looking forward to Universal after hearing good things from a friend but was sooooo disappointed. We arrived in the afternoon and thought we would have plenty of time to get to go on lots of rides, not a chance. Wait times for everything were from 1-3 hours. Some rides were "booked out" since 1pm, what the f? We would line up for something only to realise we needed to go somewhere else to get a ticket to then line up again. Luckily we got a timed entry ticket to Harry Potter and thought, yes! Now we can go on some rides! only to find there was another 3 hour or 1 hour wait for the attractions. We waiting for the roller coaster for about an hour and a half and it was so short, it really wasn't worth it. I mean, everything looks great, the castle looks great, the shops look great but it was so unbearably crowded even the line for a butterbeer involved another ticket and another massive wait. The one redeeming experience was that we (only just) managed to get onto the flying dinosaur ride. It was probably the best roller coaster I've ever been on. If you go, forget weekends or public holidays. Fork out the extra ¥70000 and get an express pass (get there early, these sell out too), and have a butterbeer for me.

Smaller than Florida Universal but had different rides (backwards and belly down roller coasters) and featured character areas (Sesame Street, Hello Kitty, Snoopy). Japanese visitors are always very excitable and give the park a unique atmosphere. Enjoyable but always busy with locals, even on weekdays -- expect a minimim 1-hour wait for any ride. Arrive early as park opens by 8am, and take singles line when possible as wait time is usually much less than the estimate.

Only come here if it's not peak season or school holidays in Japan. Had a day pass, each ride had a wait time of at least 80 minutes. Definitely overcrowded and difficult to enjoy the park when you can't even move around! Whole day= 5 hours in queues, 15 minutes on rides. On the positive side the rides were really cool.. Spider-Man was awesome and the Harry Potter village was nice. Jaws ride sucked and wasn't worth the 90 minute wait. Good luck if you are planning a universal studios trip here!

FUN FUN FUN! I would recommend for you to spend more time at the jurassic park and harry porter (hogwarts). These 2 places are worth the time! You can even buy harry porter's wand and costume. Each Wand cost about ¥3800 the costume cost about ¥14000. Don't forget to try the butterbeer.

Got the 7 express pass which cost me around $120/pax excluding the entrance pass which cost another $85/pax. Pretty standard rides....Not a a single ride there gives you adrenaline rush. The back drop was a pretty good concept but not thrilling enough. Express pass only get to ride ONCE.  Harry Potter is a must visit.  Plus points: Mascots! We don't get to see Minions and Hello Kitty in Singapore.  Overall ... good enough for one time experience.

Awesome fun. But of a shame that not too rides for smaller but shows were great and the indoor Sesame Street area was brilliant. Bit expensive to get in but food and drink inside were cheap, smoked turkey legs are awesome! Easy to get there by train but get there early and book your time for the rides as it gets crazy. Hogwarts was the stand out for us, so well made.

USJ is an amazing park. We tried to book tickets online however discovered the English site says go to gate on the day to buy but when viewing the Japanese version of the same site you can book tickets. That doesn't really seem fair. We got our Japanese friend to buy tickets and express passes for us because of this. We wanted the express pass 7 but it was sold out for like a month in advance so we settled for the express pass 4 - thrill. We wouldn't of been able to enjoy the park had we not go the express pass. We entered the park as soon as it opened on a weekday and the lines were massive already. The advertised wait time for the newly opened Jurassic park ride 'the flying dinosaur' was showing 6 hours.. I kid you not and this was before 9:30am! Thank goodness the express pass we had included it otherwise we would have missed out. It was a great ride but not 6 hour wait great. I loved how this park has many great rides you wont find at other universal parks. It's great they keep adding new rides like the flying dinosaur without removing the old classics (Jaw & Back To The Future). My tips for a good day at the park would be arrive early, buy tickets in advance (express pass a must!), avoid weekends and plan the rides you want to go on first using the map before you enter the park because it doesn't take long for the lines to get really long.

My partner & I had a very enjoyable day at Universal Studios Japan. We arrived around 1hr before opening, having bought our tickets & express pass through a travel agent we needed to exchange the ticket at the booth - just ask the staff which line to jump into. Line seemed to move quick & we were in the park before we knew it. We purchased the express pass 4 and decided we'd go straight to a ride we didn't have an express pass for because lines are shorter at the start of the day. Back to the Future ride was so great!! Our express pass allowed us to go on Jurassic Park, Spiderman, Jaws & Harry Potter(timed entry). We also managed to go through Terminator, BackDraft, Elmo's Go Go Skateboard, Sesame Street Carousel & waterworld. Some are rides & some are movie experiences. Use your express pass for the busier options & do the other rides normally. Very busy park but if you're prepared you'll have a great day. We brought food from home + bought a few things on the day when we spotted a small line. Water bubblers around the park. It's worth the extra money to contact a travel agent and have them book your tickets & express pass for you! The lines are quite large and you'll definitely enjoy your day better :)!!

We had a great day in the park. We didn't go on too many rides because of the queues but still enjoyed watching other shows, especially the night show. Prepare and bring your own food with you since prices for food and everything else is way too expensive!

My first time here. Didn't expect this place to be so humungous and the lines to the rides were meant to go on forever. Such an amazing place. The bad thing about this place though is most attractions only speak in japanese so it's hard to understand the storyteller. But despite this setback, it was still worth the visit. Most specially the Harry Potter area.

It was an enjoyable theme park, especially for those with Express Passes. I brought my family of five (3 teenagers) there. Enjoyed the day, especially in the Harry Potter world. However given how pricey the admission ticket and express passes were (the express pass cost double the admission ticket), it won't be a place I will be revisiting in a hurry.  The waiting times were far too long for all popular rides. One wouldn't be able to go for the same ride a second time.  The other comment I have, like others visitors there - you need a Japanese translator as they don't cater for foreign visitors. Everything is in Japanese.  If not for the experience of Harry Potter world, would have preferred to go to Universal Studio in Singapore.

Even though it is packed with human, I still enjoyed USJ to the max. Due to crowd, I strongly recommend to purchase express pass (need extra money of course) if you wanna try all the rides. As we arrived late, all the fast pass has been sold out so we can only queue for the all the rides that we want.  As Harry potter is our main reason to come here, we rushed to the ticket booth to get a time entry ticket. It is very important to get a ticket as you are not allowed to enter Harry potter area if you do not have a vaild time entry ticket.  After getting the ticket, we rushed to other rides. As there are too many people, every rides needs at least 2 hours waiting time. We choose the shorter time queue such as Jaw (it was lame but i somehow enjoyed it but this is more for kids), backdraft (showing how the casting team creating fire) and the Jurassic park ride.  After only 3 rides, it was around 3.30pm and we need to get into harry potter theme park. This place is so awesome and it is recreating a harry potter world!
