Purchased my tickets online, using the Goggle chrome translate. But the translate page won't work for the check out. Hence you need to use 2 separate browsers to do that. Easy to guess and figure out even if you do not know Japanese. Saved quite abit to buy direct. Tickets from 3rd parties or travel agents are much more expensive, maybe by 20 dollars at least and some 3rd party agents do not sell express passes. Have your tickets printed out before u go. You will need to flash the express pass for scanning/verification. The express pass entitles you to one ride for each of the ride listed in the express pass.  Oh and the flying dinosaur is extremely scary. Avoid wearing slippers to the park in summer. Not very ideal for the roller coaster rides. The park will give u rubber bands to tie your slippers to your legs, but i don't think the bands can hold on to slippers, more of shoes.

Japanese amusement park, therefore hyper clean and fun! Many people came and were wearing costumes! Very funny! Booking the fast line ticket is definitely a must and should not be avoided. Otherwise you can expect more than 2h on almost each attractions! It's not cheap but it's really worth it!! Food is awfull, try to eat outside of the park. Harry Potter new attraction very disappointed. I get sick on the Dinosaure ride but it was quite fun! A must to do in Osaka!

i think i lucky enough that i can enter harry potter castle without time tickets as not much ppls in dec. backdrop, flying dragon and harry potter forbidden journey are the best. the special performance -voice of angel really facinating.  without purchasing fastpass 5 or 7, i don think u can finished all the rides

This was the low point of our trip. It was the Friday a few days before Christmas, so this may be why it was extra crowded. We booked tix beforehand, arrived prior to opening and still had to line up for almost an hour before entry. It appeared those who bought tix on the day had a shorter line and walked straight through. The Harry Potter section was impressive but very confusing about where to get the "pass" to enter. The system of dining made no sense. There were very long lines in restaurants and staff told us to mind a seat before lining up for food. This meant that bags/clothes were left on tables as people lined. Meanwhile, these empty tables meant that people hovered around tables of those dining. Very uncomfortable and took us at least 45 mins to get a table. We left early and only managed one ride as lines were unbearably long and the fast pass system confusing. (We have been to other universal studios and Disneys before).

First note, do not visit on weekends or on Japan's public holidays, it will kill ur mood by its long queue. Second note, arrived at least 30 minutes before the gate opens, and you will already see the queue lines. so come at least 45 minutes before the gate open. Third note, if this is your first visit, run directly to Harry Potters' mini theme park, if you don't know where, just follow the people's wave. :) don't run too fast or you will fall down. Enjoy the 4D ride + butter beer. and other rides there.  Fourth, you can browse top ride at the sites, and ride them all. Especially the Hollywood Dream - The Ride. :D  Unless you are on the top front of the queuing lines, go for toy story, or forget it. It can be more crowded than Harry Potter and can spend your time for queuing there.  Fifth suggestion, if you have more budget, buy express pass. If not, dont worry, you can always go for single lines to enjoy fast track to most of the well known ride. :)  Enjoy the theme park, it is very recommended to visit them while in Osaka. And you can visit Kaiyukan also

Dont come here during my time that is on xmas holiday eve as the queue are really ridiculous for all things that are rides, snacks even meal. Cannot enjoy the park. In my opinion they realy need to make a quota for visitors.

I haven in end of December and the queue are mega long so if you want to visit you have to come at 8:30 to book the express pas which I have missed or other way you will take maximum two rides where each ride need 3 hours and the popcorn one hour.

I think this is a better Universal Studios than the one in Singapore. The place is huge and packed with people on a Friday. Of course, no one should miss going to the Wizarding World of Harry Potter. You're time is just limited and scheduled, so you get a special ticket near the central gate before you'll go in. The place is cool for a Harry Potter fan like me. :) I was like in their world.

We went a day after christmas so it was crowded as expected. We brought 2 toddlers along so we were not here so much for the rides. The whole area is awesome, and even better than USS (which is also awesome btw). Had a fantastic time with the kids especially at the elmo world.

i've been looking forward to visit Universal in Osaka for so long and sad to be so disappointed. The staff is not as friendly as they should and hard to communicate in English (no Chinese also). Obviously they have outsold the tickets that the less poplar rides take at least 1.5hrs of waiting. Even though with a fast pass (which doubles the entrance fee) the wait is up to 30min. Food sucks and are overpriced. Theme park itself is still fun, especially the HP and Spiderman ride. However the HP wonderland is as tiny as it can be and the stores are overload with people and overpriced souvenirs. Space ride that is eligible on the fast track pass was in maintenance, forcing us to go to the terminator blocked by the parade, then causing an extra 30min to surpass it. The terminator and back draft (both in the fast pass package) are so boring and out of date. I would give another chance when the minion them park is open but would not expect much from universal again especially there are Disney Sea/Land in Tokyo that never let people down.
If you want to waste your time by lining up minimum of 120 minutes up to 180 min, then go here. No english translation, food very expensive.

BE WARRY!!! During the holidays when the park gets crowded, there is a connection of the park's closing hour with the qeue time of popular attractions. If the park closes at 9pm and the qeue time is 2 hours, the cut-off time of the qeue will be 7pm. Anybody trying to get to qeue after 7pm will not be allowed to. It is very frustrating as the park doesnt announce this policy.

Nice theme park that is more for kids and family. If you like roller coasters this isn't a place for you. The rides are really easy going but the lines are super long. Expect to wait for over an hour for the big rides. I would recommend going on a weekday. I also agree with other reviews in this place is just fun once. When you've done it once that's really enough.

Went here for a day mainly to go to the Harry Potter attraction, once into the park we had to get a timed ticket to be able to go to Harry Pottrr and we discovered there was a 6 hour wait before we could get in. There was huge lines for toilets, restaurants etc and average wait time for other rides was 90-100 minutes. Once we were finally allowed into the Harry Potter section we discovered all the side shows were gone for the day and the two rides we wanted to go on were already closed. No one at the rides spoke English so it was hard to tell what the rides were. Overall was a waste of time and money.
So much fun but get in early the lines are long for all the rides but especially Harry potter it was 200 minutes long!
Most of the rides are old and dated, some like Backdraft, T2 are unknown to the young generation. Harry Potter world is the only thing worth visiting. Get the express pass as the wait is too long.
We went to USJ on Halloween and it was packed with costumed visitors. During the day there was a parade and at night there are zombies that chase the guests. The haunted houses were a blast.

US Osaka is pretty small yet it has all kinds of theme and games.  The good thing about this theme park is extremely accessible. There are lots of nice resturant outside the park as well.  The bad thing: the movie played all in Japanese without subtitles. You need to guess what they are talking about.  Because the park is small, it is very easy to locate the games corner.  Parade is interesting, u could dance with the dancer which make it quite interesting for kids.  For those who smoke, it also has a few smoking area.  The overall food price is reasonable and the taste is good. At least those fast food they serve is well food and warm.

Lovely theme park with a fair share of attractions for people of all ages. The unique point of USJ will be the Harry Potter attraction with a pretty awesome 4D ride. Be sure to get your tickets once you get in as the Harry Potter portion is by timed admission only.  Highly recommended to pay extra for the express pass to avoid that can go up to 2 hours.

We went early to try and get the most out of the day. It was super busy to the point where we couldnt even find a seat anywhere. It was so hot too so that didnt help. The Harry Potter castle was ridiculously busy. Hours waiting in the queue in the sun was horrific. I would not recommend going when its a school holiday.

Yes I can proclaimed it with confident Universal Studios in Japan 🇯🇵 was better than Tokyo Disneyland ! The Rides are scarier than Tokyo Disneyland and the food 🥘 are much better ! Tokyo Disneyland is for under age teenagers where the rides "tried" to scare you but they came up short (you still felt safe at the end) where as USJ Rides really scared 😳 you especially The Flying Dinosaurs where they even warned you many times over that this ride is borderline dangerous. Also I know it's odd to talk about the food in amusement park where it is usually mediocre and expensive but USJ was the exception that the food was actually pretty good (we still gotta eat right even in amusement park ?) Tokyo Disneyland I believe had the worst food ever in any amusement parks I ever been (to the point I believe it's a cash grab that they lower the quality of the food so low that I barely can eat it).  The only negative factor for USJ was because it was quite massive that you really need to manage your time allocation efficiently because some of the most popular rides take minimum 3 hours so I really had to move around strategically to get all my favorites rides (also you have to factor in the "express tickets" availability)  So there you have it ! If you have limited time and can only choose Universal Studios Japan or Tokyo Disneyland : CHOOSE UNIVERSAL STUDIOS ! Especially if you like scary rides !

I have been to this Universal Studio for three times. The last time I went is mainly because of the Harry Potter section. The new 4D ride is extremely fun, you better purchase the ticket online and suggested to get the express pass for Harry potter otherwise you will have to queue up for an hour.  The theme park is great, size not so big and you should able to try most of the famous game in one day.  Only one minor complaint, I just don't understand why the food here are so bad, even those fast food stuff you found in Japan 7-11 is much better than what you get in here and their food selling inside Universal studio are not cheap.

Lines are as long as the shinkansen.. or longer! I mean yeah, I got it it's a holiday but you can't even go anywhere without being bumped or pushed. Seriously? What happened to Japan?  We did enjoy the Harry Potter, but just that. All the other rides will take an hour or so to get on.  It is crammed and not too much space or stores or even food stalls to see. So this is a no for me. Not going back!

My bad for not buying express passes in advance, but wasn't expecting the place to be oh so crowded! You have to get a timed entry pass to enter the Wizarding World of Harry Potter (you can get inside in two hours) and line up for another 220 minutes to try the Harry Potter ride. Not sure how long it'll take on off peak season, hope it's not this long. We decided to check the other rides instead of spending almost 4 hours waiting. Just walking around is a bit stressful as there's a lot of people and you have to line up for almost anything and everything. Been to several amusement parks on peak season and the crowd isn't as bad. Anyway, try the Butterbeer, it's really good!

Universal Studios Japan pleases both kids and adults alike whereas I feel Tokyo Disney is childish and strictly for the kids.  The Harry Potter area and especially the Forbidden Journey ride are a must. The special effects are amazing and apparently has even caused motion sickness for some patrons who are overly sensitive to that condition. It's a real trip.  Old favorites like Jurassic Park, Jaws, Spiderman and Snoopy Wonderland never cease to disappoint with our two kids who are under 10. When the queues at Snoopy Wonderland get too long, make a reservation for later in the day and you can come back later in the day at a specified time and literally go to the front of the line. If the machines to make reservations are a bit intimidating, just ask the staff for help. The language barrier might be an issue but a bit of pointing and gestures (with a smile) will get you sorted.  It's the 15th anniversary of USJ so they have a great parade that starts at 2:30pm (at the time I write this) and kids will love it. A great production.  An awesome place that would normally get full marks but I can only give it four stars for the price gouging that goes on inside once you've paid the entrance fee. The cost of food and souvenirs is insane.  Just on that, get yourself an express pass otherwise rides like Spiderman and Harry Potter have queues of over 3 hours. We pretty much walked straight past the queues with our express passes and got straight on. Go to the USJ website for details because the number of express passes issued each day are limited.

I now understand why they offer 2 day passes. We were there from open to close and only got to ride 1 ride and see 2 shows. I understand Osaka is a very busy town and there would be a wait, but most rides were up to 3 hours to wait in line! Be prepared. Other than that there were a lot of food places and attractions. The Harry Potter portion was nice, even for someone who has never read the books or watched the movies. Butterbeer is good!

Long queues to ride everything and we were apparently lucky with some rides with waiting times of 180minutes! (It can be 300 minutes in peak holiday times). The park was clean and the atmosphere was jolly. The entry tickets are reasonably priced, the park is just too small for the number of people who want to get in. The Wizarding World of Harry Potter was a highlight for the kids. It seemed to be less crowded first thing in the morning, than when we visited again later in the day. I wouldn't return to USJ in a hurry however the kids (8 & 10 years old) said it was a definite highlight of their time Japan.
The rides were very fun especially harry potter and spiderman and the jaws.More interesting to me was terminator 2.The queue for harry potter was an hour but I was expecting it though...anyways.

The place is so easy to reach by JR train, but the queue to enter the main gate is unbelievable.... The new ride Harry Potter is really really good, the merchandise is also very interesting, however they are incredibly expensive. In fact all the food and merchandise are all very very expensive. The churos and clam chowder are good. I think they should put more food truck around every corner because we have to walk a long way just to find the churos.  Some of the rides or show are quite old already ( eg. like BAckdraft) i think they should start making new show and rides to compete with Universal studio SGP / LA.  It is a must go place in Osaka especially those who are young at heart and those who like adventure  For tourists, they provide tax free counter for a min spending of 5,000 Yen of merchandise, don't lose the docket though

The first thing to do is to hit the timed tickets for the Harry Potter area! We got the earliest time slot we could to minimise meeting the crowds but it was still very crowded!!! The wait for the voice of angel show was 2 hr before the show, so do go prepared with mats and blankets if you are able to get your hands on some. We took turns to go out of the viewing area for toilet breaks and snacks.

We got to USJ at 10am and did the Flying Jurrasic Park, Hollywood Dream and Jurrasic Park Water ride and Harry Potter 3D ride all in 90 minutes without an Express pass. Hence, do the big rides, first, quick and early. Going on a weekday helps.  After all that the Spiderman Ride was 90 minute wait and MASSIVE waste of time. Terminator 2, my gf walked out of because it was in Japanese and the voiceovers are very irritating for an English speaker.  Food at Finnigans pub was great (for a theme park)  Shops are fun to look at.

First day on a Monday we got there before opening with tickets purchased from the hotel, people line up everywhere but there isn't really any indication of where to line up (if you have tickets you don't need to go to the window). Went straight to HP World and it was AMAZING. Wasn't actually too busy and the language barrier didn't really matter. Most things can be paid for by credit card (restaurant food, clothing, wands etc) but you'll need cash if you want butterbeer from the wagons (and you will). Olivander's ("ride") line doesn't take long even if its full. The 3D ride in the castle does end up taking a long time - (recommend the fast pass for that alone which you would need to go to the windows for). There is also a must do Castle Walk that generally doesn't have a line but the entrance is right next to the other and can be missed easily. We did a quick walk around the rest of the studios but nothing was too interesting (jaws and jurrasic park are not our thing - meeting all the sesame street characters was pretty good)) so went back an spent the rest of the day at HP. Lost count of the people coming up to take photos with us (we bought the uniforms and robes and wands). Second time spent Sunday afternoon there and then went back on the Monday and it was crazy busy - needed to get the timed entry. Recommend staying close by so it's a quick trip back to the hotel (rather than a lot more walking and trains).
Universal Studios Japan, located in Osaka, is one of four Universal Studios theme parks, owned and operated by USJ Co., Ltd
I'm so surprise to see a lot of people inside, just because Japanese Holiday when i go there. Waiting time, 2 hours in almost every attraction. Outside have many store, a lot of Pocky there ........

Not many people know this but you can buy your tickets at Lawsons supermarket. I did this because I wanted to buy the entrance and express pass together. I know a lot of my friends who bought their tickets (only entrance pass) from a local travel agents but I hate queuing for anything plus I was traveling with my parents and I wanted to make it a comfortable trip for them. Since this was done 2 years ago, I might miss a few details but hopefully this can be useful for people who are already in Osaka and didn't buy their tickets yet. Mind you this can only be done if:-  1. you visit a less busy Lawsons (don't even try to buy the tickets at the airport (Lawsons) there is just too many people. Fortunately, I was staying at Shin-Osaka and the female Japanese cashier was extremely nice and helpful not to mention patient with me. Yes, you will need a lot of assistance from an employee at Lawsons.  2. bring along a hotel name card showing address and telephone number (she/he will be keying this into the machine)  3. you need to know a little bit of Japanese (most of the cashiers can't speak Eng) or you can write down on a piece of paper the number of tickets you'll be buying, specific date, time for the express pass. It helps if you can read the numbers/days in Japanese too.  The whole process did take quite a while but when everything was done, I left the store with those awesome tickets in my hands and feeling quite proud of myself.  When the day came to go to USJ, I did see a huge huge line for the tickets/express pass and it started to rain.

Very cold day in Osaka but still lots of people visiting. Some of the rides were closed but we still had a great time at the Harry Potter theme area. Most of the stores carry the same things and somewhat overpriced. But as theme park experiences go, everybody was wonderful and helpful.

We arrived early to get Express Pass tickets. Ticket sales started at 8:15, gates open 9am unless you get an early start pass (online only or annual pass I think). Even on a weekday in January it was busy. Several different types of express pass tickets (e.g., STD is 4 rides, XR is 7), they give you set times to go on certain rides and are one use per ride only.  Attractions were good, and only one we wanted to experience was closed. Had to wait a few times but nothing really horrendous. Highlights: Spider-Man, Harry Potter (impressive castle), Hollywood Dream roller coaster, Flying Dinosaur roller coaster. Jaws was kitschy but the driver made it fun (all in Japanese of course).  Service great, people very friendly but not obsequious. Food not appalling. We were there for most of the day and managed multiple rides on most of the attractions we wanted.

I have lot lot of fun in Universal studios Osaka! Lot of crazy things and beautiful building for pictures and selfie! Is a must come place in Osaka!! And easy to go there too.. Go 梅田station then change to jr subway to go there!

We traveled as an American couple to Universal Studios Japan for New Years Eve celebration. The live performances and fireworks were great. We also enjoyed the rides and the Harry Potter section of the theme park. I will warn you that you make a reservation to see the Harry Potter in advance and come back a couple hours later to get in. But if you leave the Harry Potter area, you won't be able to go again. It's a one time only. Make sure you do everything you want to see and repeat if desired before leaving to explore the rest of the park. It helps with keeping the lines down in that area but the 3D ride in Hogwarts castle was worth the wait.

Japan really gets into the theme of Halloween!!! So much fun, Harry Potter world is a truly great experience (it's all spoken in Japanese though... but you still get the general jist) the wait times for rides however are crazy long... even using fastpass. Still a great time to be had.

We travelled in weekday with our children, two kids (6&2 yo) and one teenager. We arrived around noon and got express standard ticket for 4 rides, time just fits to play all the rides while spending some time in the Elmo playland and wonderland. We played during meal time of most people and took afternoon tea instead to avoid the crowd. Even during Chinese New Year holidays, the queue is not really long, 30 mins for Jaws , 120 mins for Harry Porter if without express. 5-20 mins with express. They have child switch function, parents can take turn to play the ride without queuing again. Staff are cheerful and helpful. English is ok. Game types in kids land are not many. The snoopy roller coaster is good for my 6 yo kid. Being to many theme parks, not too much surprise to adults, stereotyped. One day is enough.

Had a great time...was able to complete the major rides in the park in a day...with careful planning.  If you want to enjoy the park, you should definitely purchase the tickets online beforehand and get the express pass. there are many types of express passes...I got the express pass 7 with the Flying Dragon. a few of the rides comes with a time limit (whereby you can only use the express pass at a certain time). The popular rides are at least 2 hours wait. With the express pass, we got in the ride in less than 20 minutes.  I was surprised at how crowded the park was. I don't remember the one in Southern California ever being this crowded. We arrived 15 minutes before 9am (the time that the park opened). We couldn't even get on the subway that goes to Universal Studios because the first subway was all packed. We had to wait another 10 minutes for the second subway. once the door opens, a whole mass of people flooded out of the subway...marching towards the front gate where we waited patiently in line until the park opens. somewhat confusing because the people with tickets were interspersed with the people lining to buy tickets.  Once in the park, we ran to the first major ride...Evangelion (a virtual reality ride). We didn't have the Express pass for this ride, but even though we went to this one first, the wait was still 80 minutes...but worth the wait. an amazing ride...you literally feel like you are inside the manga (cartoon).  The next ride you shouldn't miss is the Flying Dragon. a roller coaster with a lot of twist and turns.  Harry Potter world was spectacular also, but again, would be more enjoyable if there were less people. I really couldn't even shop at the gift shop because there were so many people.  The rest of the rides and attractions were similar to the ones in the US...except it's all in Japanese. the staff were very friendly, and most of them speak basic English. If you purchased the express pass, it will probaly include Terminator and Backdraft. Unless you understand Japanese, I would skip these two and opt for other attractions not seen in the US.

We went on a monday and bought the reborn 15th anniversary express pass that specifically allows us to enter harry potter, and express pass to forbidden journey and flying dinosaur ride. Realise on monday 31/1/17 that the harry potter world has no entry restrictions and the times entry ticket was not applicable. However with the pass we could cut the super long queue to forbidden journey.  The rest of the ride e.g superman and hollywood of dreams has less than 30mins of wait time and it definitely moves very fast. It's either the system has improved of there were less people that day. The only long queue i saw was the evangelion ride which was 110minutes.  We didn't have our bags checked so we managed to bring some food in as opposed to some blogs mentioned that they won't allow food inside.  Entering was before 9am and there were such long queues but the japs are very disciplined in queueing up. Just some other tourists that likes to cut thru lines.
The tickets are quite expensive. But the attractions make up for it. Prepare for long lines if you dont get the express tickets

Visited USJ not knowing much about the rides but holy moly was it worth the 7000 or so yen that I paid! The Harry Potter ride in 4K 3D through the hogwarts castle is undoubtedly the highlight and most popular attraction and the lines are not even that long! Well they weren't for me and my friends the day I went (I went on a Wednesday and assume the lines would be much longer on a weekend). I went on that ride at least 5 times that day before I had too much vertigo (lol). The other phenomenal ride is the flying dinosaur in Jurassic Park world. This is a must if you love being put in a doggy style position. Nah but seriously it is amazing and again the lines were not that long!!!  The only negative I have about USJ is the cost of the food and quality of the food! Could be much much better in regards to both!! My suggestion is take your own lunch with you as it will save you plenty, especially if you go with families and annoying kids who whinge and if you go with annoying friends who always want to eat OR if you go with fatties who just like to eat heaps.  Overall, totally worth the experience and I would be keen to do it again when I return to JAPAN !!!!

Absolutely beautiful place, well arrange and maintain. But every attraction need to wait minimum 1 hr, suggested to buy express ticket type. Even for buying ticket and enter it self need to wait minimum 30 minutes. Hundreds people on lane nonstop.

Colorful, exciting at first. Huge downer that the lines are ridiculously ... and I mean ridiculously long. This means everything. We wanted one popcorn. We waited over one hour. When we went to investigate, we found the vendor making each popcorn one at a time and bowing as the money was paid. This is not the USA where bags and bags would have been prepared much earlier. I understand the courtesy and freshness aspect, but when you are waiting for over one hour for a small bag of popcorn, patience wears thin. The ride we went to (underwater sea) - we waited over 3 hours. Just to give you an idea.

We came on Friday in January. We didn't buy the express pass as we figured there shouldn't be that many people on weekdays during winter time. We were right! We waited less than 20 minutes for the Harry Potter ride. In fact, we didn't have time to see the detail of the castle because it was so empty and we had to keep moving.  However, it did get quite cold and windy after 5pm. Besides, the park opens late and closes early during weekdays. It was too bad the Jurassic Park was on maintenance. Overall, we enjoyed USJ very much!

We bought the standard express pass with 5 rides but for three or 4 of the rides, there were just 5-10 minutes of wait time anyway so it wasn't really needed. Probably the other express passes with more of the bigger rides would've been better value. I particularly liked the Harry Potter world and there were plenty of things and shows to watch throughout the day!

1st time to USJ. Very exciting. Big place. A lot to play and shop. There are different shops selling different thing. The ride and shows were awesome. Waited a long time but all worth it. We were there the whole day.

I visited USJ in August last year. It's so crowded that I guess you have to line up at least an hour for each game. Luckily my son and I've got a fast pass. It's quite expensive but if you see the crowd in such hot weather, you'll find it worthy to purchase it. You save a lot of time to visit other scenes.

We went there on 1st January 2017 so you can imagine the crowd. Jam packed! We didn't get the Express pass as it was already sold out which was ashamed as we had to queue up for almost 2 hours to get on the rides. But luckily we were able to experience most of the ride towards the end of the day as people were slowly leaving. Totally love the Harry Potter and Amazing Spiderman 3D ride. It was amazing! Would definitely go again but maybe on the weekdays and not on public holiday.

The kids absolutely loved it. Need to start early in the morning as we finished in the night. There are lockers avaiable of you need to stash any belongings or baggage which was convenient. Food is plentiful both inside and outside. Great place for families

The flying dinosaur, Hollywood dream ride and the whole of the Harry Potter world was amazing. I enjoyed every single experience here. The lines get extremely long so I suggest purchasing express tickets for the rides mentioned above and arriving at the park before it opens.
Nice place to visit but be prepared for long queues to play the rides and rather expensive food. Of course you could cut some queues with Fastpass but be prepared to pay.

Very good . My 8 yr old loved the Harry Potter village . My 70 yr old father couldn't stomach consecutive rides but agreed the Spider-Man and Harry Potter rides were great . Pity q was long . The jaws ride was hilarious

Universal studios is a great attraction. Make sure you allow a full day to try as many of the attractions and rides as possible. The studios are spotless in part because of the Japanese culture and in part because of an army of attendants that really go out of their way to care for the guests and park alike.  The rides and attractions are all great and whilst some might appear scary, actually they are very well designed and very safe. Make sure you stay for the night parade as it is truly a festival of lights, sound, dancing and fun and the kids (and big kids) all have a wonderful time. Near the end of the day as the crowds thin out, there is still time to take some of your favorite rides again (and again)!  Getting to the park is really easy with the Osaka subway.

The rides are so cool and coming in early is a must to avoid the long queue.I would also recommend that you get the express pass to truly enjoy all the attraction specially the Harry Potter. Spending the whole day in Universal studios will unleash the child in each one of us. I had such an amazing experience here in this place. Don't forget to try the Beer Butter.
Actually i was visiting USJ on February 2016 (late review sorry) but i had a great great experience there although jurassic world wasn't open yet that day. 😉
USJ is wellknown for their harry potter area. Everything in this park had very long waiting line. I bought fastpass 4 which recommend unless you plan to go in single ride line.

Tips: go early! especially during weekends, or even on Fridays and Mondays cuz Japanese people tend to have "long weekends" break. If park opens at 8am, then you need to arrive by 7.15am and queue. In this way you will get to be in Harry Potter park without reservation ticket and with far less queuing time for that ride in castle. Plus you will have a second chance to go to Harry potter theme park by obtaining reservation ticket in vending machine. Thus you have two entries.

Went here with my family last November 2016, and we had a fun time!  We were able to secures special passes (what they're called escapes me) that allowed us to jump the line on select rides.  We went to Harry Potter and had a fun time taking photos and shopping. The ride was fun, but because I'm on the heavy side, we were ushered on the side and given a special seat to accommodate my size. A bit embarrassing on my part but I'm thankful the staff of Universal Studios were very nice and made every effort to make me feel comfortable despite the adjustment. ;)  Also, got to try the Jaws boat ride, the Spiderman 4D experience, and the highlight for me and my 2 brothers.. The Jurassic Park ride! It was a lot of fun just walking around and shopping for souvenirs, enjoying snacks, taking photos with the cosplaying guests and the characters that roam the park like Marilyn Monroe and Snoopy to name a few.  We were exhausted but the good kind because it was great time for my family and I, and was an explosive start to our stay in Japan!  I highly recommend that if you plan on shopping, keep your passport with you(why wouldn't you right?) and keep ALL the receipts you acquired from the souvenirs you purchased because you can present them at an office near the entrance for a tax refund! It's as if I got 2 of my souvenirs for free!  Food is on the pricey side but its good for the most part. It'll take me forever to discuss everything. I do recommend the butter beer and the turkey leg! ;)

Universal is busy but organised and if you're a Harry Potter fan you will be in heaven !! Or should I say Hogwarts 😃😃 HP world was fantastic. Butter beer was delicious and the grounds so realistic. Great Day in Osaka.

Easily accessible by train in Osaka, Japan. As are the Disney theme parks in Japan -- often crowded. Arrive early. Consider the Express Pass, or sit-down dining package that includes an express entry.  Crowds thin out later in the day. Plan to stay until late.  The Flying Dinosaur (Jurassic Park themed) will satisfy any thrill-seeker. Holds its own against any domestic park roller coaster, even at Six Flags. Suspended coaster goes through two loops (Tatsu at Six Flags Magic Mountain only does one).  Beautiful Hogwarts castle set on a lake. Same 'Forbidden Journey' ride in 3D as at Universal Studios Hollywood.

I've been to many amusement parks and this one is at the top of the list in terms of it's aesthetics. It really is a beautiful park and a lot of attention to detail was placed in the different sections. Negatives: The park is smaller than many others and there are a lot of people. This makes the fast pass or express pass essential. It is expensive, but worth it if you want to hit all the big attractions in a single day. It cost us ¥11,000 per person on top of the ¥7,400 per person entrance fee. This was the most expensive fast pass (lets you use it on seven different attractions), but there are cheaper options if you only want to use it on a few rides. Expect lines to be at least 80 minutes long and up to 230 minutes long (yes, 3 hours and 50 minutes) for the best attractions. This was the low and high end wait times for our Thursday visit.  Must do: The Flying Dinosaur, Harry Potter and the Forbidden Journey in 4K3D (I don't even like Harry Potter), Hollywood Dream - The Ride.  Consider skipping: Terminator 2: 3D, Flight of the Hippogriff.

As the title suggests, this place is crazy-busy, even on a Monday.  We were lucky enough to have Express passes - without them, I'm not sure it would be worth it. For example, the main rides can last 3-4 minutes but require 3-4 hours in queue for standard ticket holders - I can't imagine how anyone can justify that.  Otherwise, the rides are fun, the movie sets are awesomely elaborate, and the overall experience in pretty mind blowing.  Worth doing it if you can handle the crowds.

Bring out the child in you for one day. We went here on a Wednesday and the number of visitors was quite tolerable. Queue to Harry Potter was very short and we took our ride in just minutes. This place is miles better than its asian counterpart in Singapore.

We managed to do and see quite a bit of things (not to mention a little souvenir shopping), eat theme park food and seeing all the mascots (and their meet and greets)! We even managed to catch the parade and one show – The Animation Celebration (Hollywood).  Since we were there to experience the theme park and certain rides, we decided to save some money by not getting the fast (express) passes and just go with the flow. The fast (express) pass could really help you save the waiting time since the average waiting time per ride can range from 60 minutes up to 240 minutes.  There was a huge crowd at Harry Potter World, so we kinda gave the whole world a miss. We only went there for a look see and took a couple of photos and videos. I know! How could we skip it?  Despite not having the fast pass, the crowd was still manageable that day and we managed to take 6 rides (we could have taken another one more ride - the Hollywood Dream Backdrop - but after the Flying Dinosaur, we were pretty winded lol) + 1 show + 1 parade! Still not too bad if you ask me.  Although food in a theme park can be pricey, what is a trip to one without indulging a little right? 😁 We might have missed out on the butter beer at the Harry Potter World, but that doesn't mean that it's the end of the world you know. There is after all, always next time.  Lunch ended up consisting of snacks throughout the day – turkey leg, popcorn, churros, hot dog buns etc… I guess that is where the money we saved on the fast pass went to. All in all, it was an eventful fulfilling day at the theme park. Do check out my blog for more photos and more on the experience.

Harry Potter World was amazing!! luckily, we did not need express passes when we visited..the crowd was manageable since it was a weekday on a february.. good thing we bought our tickets online as the lines are crazy..we arrived very early (8am) and did not need timed-entry tickets to enter HP World..although we waited 30minutes for the forbidden journey, it was a good wait. souvenir prices are crazy tho. for the other rides with long lines, try the single rider lines since the wait is shorter compared to the regular line for groups.
One of the places definitely worth the while to visit. The next best thing to the one in LA. Will be fun for the family.

Been there during week day and it was super busy, well at least compare to one in Singapore. Universal Studio Japan had longest queues I have ever seen, 260 min minimum to wait. I would say the one in Singapore was better experience.

This place has it all! Minions, Harry Potter area, big rides and lots to see. The Harry Potter and the Forbidden Journey ride is mind blowing and well worth waiting for. The Spider-Man ride is also well worth a visit and has been put together very well. If you go on the Jurassic Park ride make sure you are wearing water proof clothes as you get a big splash at the end of the ride. Overall an amazing time with the family that will be remembered for a long time. Definitely worth purchasing the express pass to skip the sometimes 2+ hour queues so you can maximise your time on the rides and shows.
The express pass is really worth it if you really want to explore USJ! Best time to go is every Wed or Thu! Enjoy!

I had concerns that the language barrier might affect the experience of visiting USJ....if anything it enhanced it! I found, with the attractions being largely in Japanese, it forces those with an English-speaking background to create your own stories. The park was crowded (we attended on a Friday)....I definitely recommend an Express Pass if you can afford it. Grab an ICOCA pass and catch the train to and from the park. The Wizarding World of Harry Potter is the highlight.....a timed pass is required to enter this section of the park. Yes....the park can be expensive...but if you plan it right it will be one of the highlights of you trip to Osaka.

Spent a day at universal studios on a recent visit to Osaka. The park has a good range of entertainment for the whole family We visited the park mid week and were very suprised at how busy it was with long waits for rides.

Harry Potter world has always been a part of my bucket list. Despite my high expectations, this place still left me in awe. Definitely a must visit in Osaka! But do remember to buy those express tickets especially on during local holidays.

Spend a whole day in Universal my favorite ride is spider man its so exciting and water world is well performed will be back again with family. Monday a bit hectic with a queue of student so better get an express ticket

I had to wait 3 hours in the line and there were no rest rooms on its half way. If you get out of the queue, you have to wait again from the starting point! They should be smarter when designing and building this amusement park!

i very much recommend pre purchase of ticket and express pass, so that you get direct entry on arrival. saves you plenty of time, since the queue at the ticket booths can be super long. not to mention the waiting time on the best attractions can be up to 2 hours. get the express pass, you will be so glad as you quickly whiz through the long lines of people waiting. express pass gives you automatic entry to the harry potter area and a perfect reserved spot to watch the parade.
>2h wait time for rides. Basically either buy the express pass (2x price) or don't waste your time with this place (might be because it's spring break... But still...)

If you are a fans of Harry Potter, you have to visit this place. Basically it just the same like other themepark. Overpriced stuff, average meal with crazy pricing, queuing all day long, etc. Expect crazy queuing time on weekend and holiday season (Obon, Golden week). Im not a theme park kind of person, so basically i wont visit this place again except i have to. I like the butterbeer though..

As avid Harry Potter fans we had to visit USJ. The Harry Potter World exceeded our expectations. The attention to detail in HPW was amazing. Using wands, shopping in Hogsmeade, and chatting with the Hogwarts Express conductor added to the expected rides and activities. We loved it. USJ was better than I thought too. We enjoyed Jurassic Park and Spider Man rides in particular. I loved walking through Fisherman's Wharf and New York City as well. It was really overpriced of course, but we spent a day and half there and made wonderful memories. We went in January and it was freezing cold so the crowds weren't as bad as I've heard they can be. We didn't buy the timed entry or fast track passes and the longest we waited in line was 45 minutes (for Jaws and for the Flight of Hippogriff). We stayed near the park entrance (the park does not offer same day re-entry which is pesky) but we found the convenience to the entrance helpful at the end of a long day. My six-year-old was delighted at everything we did there and it was a fun-for-the-whole-family event.

Outside of the Harry Potter area I really didn't find too much fun in Universal. Queues can be quite long and if you're not a fan of minions then truly you'll find yourself in hell. On the plus side I didn't find that the park was as expensive as you might expect.  Universal city walk just out front of the park has a Lawson so it's very possible to buy your lunch there and bring it in with you, cutting costs even further.
The park was great, and Harry Potter world was worth the trip, but the 3 hour long lines for big rides was crazy. We probably won't be visiting any more theme parks in Asia after this.

What I should have done. Buy ticket in advance (website or travel to USJ anytime before the day I intend to go to get the tickets and definitely get express pass if you can). Express pass will save literally hours of waiting.  Do not underestimate the queues!! Bring a book. I bought a ticket on the day and turned up 1 hour before opening time. The express passes had already run out. I had to prioritise and did not do any roller-coasters. What I did: 1. Went straight to Harry Potter and the Forbidden Journey in 4K3D and didnt hang about looking at anything else, just go straight there save myself an hour of queuing. Great ride. (1 hr wait). 2. Ollivanders. Nice bit of entertainment. 3. The amazing adventures of spiderman. great ride. 3 hour wait! 4. Backdraft. Have to get through some introductory pap before the pyrotechnic show (that didn't last long, but was a nice bit of entertainment). 5. Attack on Titan The real. 3 hour wait! Disappointing 4d cinema experience. Maybe because I was blown away by Harry Potter. Was however a nice bit of entertainment, in retrospect. 6. Got a timed ticket (ticket to let you back into Harry Potter area once queues start to back up) and went back to Harry Potter (this time 2 1/2 hour wait).  Food is expensive. Get snacks. Although there is a risk that you might not be let in with them. Nothing vegan (which I am) except Chips. Vegetarians may struggle too.  Next time I would load up and bring a note in Japanese to say "I am vegan and cannot eat meat, dairy, egg, fish, fish broth, selfish and that is why I have to bring food" in case they stop you.  Otherwise enjoy USJ.

Had a great day in Universal Studios Osaka in July. Spent the whole day there. Was very busy when we visited and express passes had already sold out. Advice buying tickets and express passes in advance. Good to see the Jaws ride again after it has closed at other Universal parks. Quite a few unique rides in this Universal Studios. Highly recommended.

First time in here, and so excited..!!!! larger than USS in Singapore. Especially Wizarding World Of Harry Potter *two thumbs. And I like flying dino rollercoster very much in here increase adrenaline hahaha.., Maybe next time i will purchase express pass ticket.

At 200 cm (6 feet 6 inches tall) I am up against it when it comes to theme park attractions. I have been to Orlando, Los Angeles, Singapore and now Osaka Universal Studios. This by far has the least amount of rides for someone of my height. Stupidly I paid a considerable amount of money for the premium front of line pass that only ended up giving me access to the Spider-Man attraction. My wife at 167 cm (5 foot 6 inches) tall had a fantastic time. Food and presentation was fantastic hence the 4 stars. Rides only being for short people stopped it from getting a 5.

We visited on a Thursday and the crowds weren't to bad, certainly not as bad as Tokyo Disneyland. We didn't get the express pass and arrived at about 11am. The line for entry tickets was about 30 minutes long. For the major attractions we didn't have to wait anymore than 20 - 30 minutes. On some occasions the normal line moved faster than the single riders. Lines for food was also very reasonable. Overall, in half a day we managed to knock over the main rides and stroll around checking out the shops.

Long queues started forming outside park entrance at least an hour before opening time. December is peak travel season, plus holiday in Japan, hence park was very crowded with long queues for most rides.  Worth getting the express pass though not cheap. Plan your rides - harry porter's could take up to 3 hours of queuing for one ride.  Things are generally more expensive here than Disneyland.

All is fun at US. But if you can't get proper express passes. Then just don't go. 3-4 hours I one line, is something you shouldn't have to pay full fare for doing. I tried buying express passes. But the clerk didn't speak any English. So no luck for us. Next time I just won't go knowing a full day spent there will only give me 2-3 rides. Did Harry Potter castle 3D. Very nice. But it's insane to stand in line for 3-4 hours for a 3-4 minute run.

We really enjoyed Universal Studios. Our main reason for going was Harry Potter World, which was great, although unsurprisingly all the characters are in Japanese, so the feeling isn't quite what I expected. The 4D ride was great and drinking butterbeer outside Hogwarts was wonderful - the butterbeer is delicious!! We had the Express pass and it saved us quite a lot of time - the big rides had a 60-80 minute wait but with the Express Pass we waited a maximum of 15 minutes. We didn't need the timed entry for Harry Potter World as it wasn't a really busy day, but we used the pass on the Harry Potter ride and many others. Our favourite rides were the Harry Potter, Spider-Man and Evangelion (The Evangelion is a VR roller coaster - an absolute must!) Our teenage son loved The Flying Dinosaur (too scary for me!) We didn't buy food in the park, as we'd been warned it was expensive, which from what we saw seemed to be the case. Instead we had a good breakfast and took in some snacks. We arrived at 8am, gates opened at 9.30am (we were at the start of the line and while it's worth getting there early as everything got busier as the day went on, probably an hour before opening would be fine).

The Harry Potter area is the area that I must go every time when I visit Osaka Universal Studio.  It is always fun and all the games are exciting.  However, I am not very into those roller coaster game so I skipped the roller coaster in that area.  It is a place that you need to see if you have never been to Osaka Universal Studio

LOST IN TRANSLATION  Experience would have been excellent if weren't for the language barrier. Most Japanese only speak Japanese. And they struggle when they do speak English. My country has English as second language. Japanese should improve on their English.  WEATHER  When my family visited, it was cold and pouring rain. If you don't want these two together, avoid early April.

Took the 2 boys (9&6) for the day. Both found Harry Potter to scary and experienced motion sickness which they haven't experienced at Tokyo and HK Disney of US Singapore. We visited Tokyo Disneyland a few days before and the experience wasn't anywhere as good. Express Passes are very expensive but were worth skipping 90min queues but still expensive. Universal in Singapore is better in my opinion.

I've been to two other universal studios (Singapore and Hollywood) and Japan was by far the best. The park was easy to get to and back from with its own train station less then 5 minutes from the entrance. The staff are so friendly and helpful.

It is newer property then Universal Studio in LA. Good size theme park for Japan where land is so short. Quite few attractions. Harry Parter was the best. But it's just not the same as LA one since LA one is original and has live studio sets. But if someone haven't seen LA they will enjoy it with family.

This globally chained attraction is good and pretty much same . But in osaka, japan I liked it very much. A little problem I faced is in some song & dialogues they used Japanese. Apart of that rides were too good. Well managed system. Parents with toddlers are encouraged to go. Because they have a 'child switch ' system in most of the ride. So one parent can hold the baby another can use the ride and vice versa. Cheers Enjoy

Wonderland is wonderful. Our 3 and 5 year olds just couldn't get enough of Snoopy, Sesame Street and Hello Kitty. The rides were wonderfully age appropriate.  Then there was adrenaline junkie me - completely satisfied by the Flying Dinosaur ride in Jurassic Park. It was one of the best roller coasters I've been on. Imagine being strapped from an overhang roller coaster dangling about the ground horizontally and feeling like you are about to be flung of the coaster. F.U.N!

This is my second time going to USJ. My first was more exciting than the second time.  No more parade, Some part are close, and Less Crowd on Friday.  I have noticed that even the park highlight-Harry Potter, are not that crowded anymore.  Thus, there's no more need for expensive special pass they offer. In fact we finish all the rides my children wanted before Sunset.  All you have to do is come early and you can have all the rides in one day.

We loved USJ - we had gone to Tokyo Disneyland and whilst it was good we did not experience good service and the queues and crowds were hugh! USJ whilst busy was still really good - because they have single lane riders you can split up and get on rides quickly and even for those you waited was not too bad - the rides were AWESOME especially the Harry Potter one in the castle and the roller coaster in Jurassic Park (scariest ride I have ever been on). Harry Potter world was amazing - if you are planning on buying a wand from there buy it early as you can do tricks with it in particular places - we got it late so by the time we realised we only got one in - the look on my daughters face then doing it was so beautiful she was so amazed and BEST of all was the service - everyone was so nice and friendly - my daughter had so much fun interacting with everyone and it was such a more relaxed place than Disneyland - I had my older children as well and they loved it :-) Can't wait to go back!

Best so far compared to Australia and definitely a lot bigger than Singapore!  Advisable to purchase the express pass for those who only has a day to visit as you may not want to spend 80% of your time there waiting in line.  The park was surprisingly not as crowded during the 3rd week of April. Weather was still cooling with a lot of sun.  For those who have extra to spend on their budget, I've noticed that the park lets visitors who has the 'early ticket' in almost an hour before the park opens.  As a Harry Potter buff, I spent a huge chunk of my time there exploring every knick and cranny they have to offer. Felt so surreal reliving a childhood dream <3

One of the BEST universal studios ive been to (including Singapore/Florida) whilst it is smaller than the one in Florida i believe it has a great selection of rides that caters to the young/old quite well  Super important to get the Express pass as the lines and amount of queuing were simply crazy. Got to commend the Japanese tho as they did this admirably and very respectfully.  Harry potter world and the random carnival games stood out the most to me. Super fun and very unique!

I bought a studio pass tickets with 7600¥ for all game in here. And you can buy VIP tickets for all game inside without wait. All is very nice, I had a great day. "Harry porter is amazing, don't forget it if you come "

USJ is really entertaining with so many themes within the vicinity. There, you can find Sesame Streets section, Minions Park, Hello Kitty, Jaws, Snoopy, Marvel Heroes and highly anticipated The Wizarding World of Harry Potter. My friends and I visited end of April 2017 and it wasn't very crowded. It could also because the park is big and hence, the crowd were diverted. We spotted many local students visiting the park when we were there in the morning, which was surprising. The queues to the rides were in orderly manners and quite fast. If you do not want to waste time queuing, you can make a reservation at the automated kiosk to get an appointment ticket for the ride then go back later at the stated timing on the ticket. Very efficient. I will definitely want to go back again when I visit Osaka next time.

Everytime I travel to a different country, I always find time to go to amusement parks. Universal Studios in Osaka is great place to spend with family and friends. Most of the attractions are 4D or shows but there also extreme rides like the Jurassic Park roller coaster and the Evangelion 4D roller coaster (which I both kept on riding non-stop). The Harry Potter park inside is also a great unique place especially if you are a fan of the saga. Make sure that you ride Harry Potter's forbidden journey if you haven't tried the one in Orlando. There are also classic attractions like Jaws. However, the new Minion (from Despicable Me) is still under condtruction. All in all it was a great experience with my family and for me, far better than the one in Singapore.  I suggest you go on the weekdays as it tend to get really really crowded on the weekends, even with a purchase of fastpass ticket. This way there are only 10-15 mins. queue lines and you get to save on spending extra on a fastpass. Also, check the weather report to get that bright sunny weather! You wouldn't want to go and spend your day there under the rain like my family and I did!
Theme parks in Japan never really have a quite day. You will always have queues no matter when you go.  Strongly recommended shelling out the extra $$$ and get an Express 7 pass.

Universal studios Japan is amazing!! Once you enter you will feel ... happy. Something I didnt feel in singapore and something you always feel when you enter disneland. The people are cheerful and are very nice. My son got sick and the people in the clinic genuinely cared and really wanted to help. Go to Harry Potter as soon as you enter, especially if you are a fan!! The details are amazing
I love it. Spent the entire day there to let the crowd die down little bit. USJ is defintely 3 times bigger than USS. I love the spiderman ride and of course harry porter too!

Great day and it was much bigger than expected, but if you want to enjoy the shows, it would really help if you could speak Japanese because theres no english spoken. Still a great day. Also one day is all you need, unless you wanted to line up for hours waiting for rides, then you'd need two days. We skipped the rides.

When you plan to visit USJ, make sure you get heavy breakfast and physically fit as Harry Potter is very famous and always packed which you need to run.. run.. the moment the park opens its gate to the guests. I run myself to the Wizarding World of Harry Potter to ensure that I managed to enter the castle without having to queue for more than 2hours. To non-Japanese speaker, make sure you bring the English version park map gotten from you hotel since they only distribute Japanese version park map in the park, which I had the challenge to explore the park smoothly. Otherwise, you can always approach the employees who are friendly and helpful. Since the park is huge and there are a lot of attractions to visit, I would suggest you plan for 2days in the park. and check the weather too, where it was scorching hot when I was there and we were punctured after few hours in the park. Shopping tax refund counter is available in the park upon exit and the service was quick and smooth.

My fiancé is absolutely addicted to Harry Potter. But everything was in Japanese with no subtitles, which made it very difficult to get around! Absolutely understandable since we were in Japan. But I'd like to suggest to have English subtitles or signs if possible.

Like it so much, there is many nice game most of it is 4D/5D game... very nice... the new flying dinosaur is super nice, really have flying feeling during the ride... there is many cute minions around the park... Harry Potter background is really nice, so magical feel~

A nice theme park, with great atmosphere. Ticket was around 7500 yen, typical price. Many attractions are the same as Universal Studios in Florida though. The biggest downside is that all the rides are in Japanese (without english subtitles). The rollercoaster in the Jurassic Park area is definitely one of the most, if not the most, spectacular in the world. I would pay 7500 yens just for that one rollercoaster.

The park is fantastic. Being from Florida, it's hard to beat Universal Studios and Islands of Adventure in Orlando. USJ has Universal Cool 2017 going on and if you're into gaming and Japanese pop culture, like our teenage son, this is a must. There are several attractions that do not exist at US Orlando, and they were all phenomenal. Every ride that has a twin in Orlando, that we rode, was identical....With the exception of the language. All attractions are in Japanese...Harry Potter and Spiderman speak Japanese. Even though we didn't understand what was said, we K ew what was going on. Interestingly, the music played through the park is American. We bought one day passes with 7 attraction express passes for three, and 2 Universal Cool 4 attraction express passes and it was 63,000 yen. It's expensive, but we only had 1 day and this let us see what we wanted without waiting. We hope we will have an opportunity to return.

As a family with small children. At first I thought my nephew who is almost 4 years old cannot enjoy much here as only few rides allowing for small kids.  I got it wrong, my nephew took almost all day in Wonderland zone only. And he did have a very enjoyable time. For 92cm height kids can join 5-6 rides in this colorful Wonderland zone.
So happy to have visited this, and I strongly recommend getting the fast pass on your favorite rides. We had a lot of fun!

First things first, I actually have more photos because it was really picturesque but there's a limit of 10 so I tried to choose the best from the first batch. Second, we didn't get a fast pass and almost decided against lining up for the castle ride however it was the best decision to take our chances because we truly enjoyed the ride and couldn't stop smiling the rest of the day. It's really such an unforgettable experience especially if you are a fan. I spent so much in merchandise - bought three wands for me and my nieces and scarves too so make sure to save up for those because if you ask me everything was worth it. Oh and I drank butter beer too and ate in the restaurant.  This review is focused more on Harry Potter World because I spent most of my time in that area however we also enjoyed the Spider-Man ride and the kiddie area where Sesame Street world is located.

Attracted by the fame of Harry Porter, we went on a week day but the park was still packed with tourists. This park is much bigger than Singapore where we visited two years ago. As my daughter is a big fan of Hello Kitty and Snoopy, we decided to spend the day in Easter decorative Wonderland which is more friendly for young children. Of course Sesame characters refreshes my childhood memory! Waiting time is much more reasonable in Wonderland. We relaxingly spent six hours exploring every fun - Snoopy rides, base ball game, climbing frame... Of course we were most excited when dancing with Hello Kitty✌️✌️✌️✌️✌️Very consistent wit high Japanese standard of beauty, the Hello Kitty and Snoopy buns are just too pretty to eat. My daughter has to struggle for this tough decision 😂😂😂😂😂😂😂 Though we have been to Universal Studio twice by now, Osaka park is just too big. We will return for the second time to explore the park more thoroughly ✌️✌️✌️✌️✌️
Lots of glamour - a bit outside Osaka . Looked a bit like Disney with Harry Potter thrown in Many happy people here . Definitely a place for adults and children especially .

USJ is bigger than Universal Studios California but they have the same amount of attractions. But USJ beats them all because of the Harry Potter attractions. If you're a Potterhead, you shouldn't miss going to this place. We were there for the Universal Cool Japan attractions and the Evangelion XRide was the best. :) But get ready to walk because the train station to the park is not too far but add that distance to the distance of all the attractions in the park and you're just about to be walking the whole day.

This is my first time visiting an Universal Studio park and I was really excited, especially for the Harry Potter zone! I have to say, I was not disappointed 😀 I was there for a whole day and it was definitely worth it. So much to see and do. The rides are so fun and they've put so much thought into the different areas. I will visit the park again! This is a fun park for friends, couples and families ^-^

An interesting and entertaining place with plenty of sights and fun but the queue for each ride could be quite lengthy and time consuming. New park like the Harry Potter and Minions proved to be the most popular. A must visit place in Japan.

Located on the North side of Osaka Port, this location is easily reached by rail line. A short walk through the Universal Citywalk and you are at the entrance of Universal Studios Japan.  This theme park is more akin to Universal Studios Los Angeles than Sentosa mainly due to the size of the area and the amount of patronage. Expect long queues at most times of the year.  That being said, it is a fun place for families, especially so for the children.  Prices are as expected. Pre-purchase your tickets if you can.  There are hotels on-site if you prefer to stay close to the venue.  Recommended.  Note: you can catch a fast ferry across the river to visit the Osaka Aquarium if you have the time. Well worth a visit.
This is the one destination that all of traveler must visit. It's so fun and excited especially Harry Potter.
Came here for Harry Potter. Would recommend visiting Harry Potter villagers first for the 4D experience.
Other parts are nice but the main part you shouldn't miss is 'Harry Potter' and to play 4D amusement machine just keep waiting patiently maybe there is a long line but it's really worthy to wait 👍🏻

Went at opening hour and left at closing time but only managed to get on 5 rides, 4 of which are from express pass. Frankly the rides are really fun but queues are way too long. I can't imagine if we did not get the express pass!

We immediately went to the store when entering (as we had pre purchased tickets) and bought express passes. Unfortuantely we picked a day when it was school holidays so the crowd was extremely large (bigger than Disneyland). If we had known we would of paid the extra and bought these when we purchased our enterance tickets, but were happy you could get the express pass inside the park. This meant the long 2hr plus queues were not a worry (although Backdrop said 80mins and we got through in 20mins, so I think they mixed the queue time as Hollywood Dream is the next queue), we were able to do the 'less' popular rides without having to wait long, maybe 30-40mins tops and jump queues for the major rides. It confused us that the Harry Potter entrance time on our express pass said 1240 but you can enter the area at anytime, so we could have spent more time there instead of going in the middle of the day - as there is absolutely no shade when walking around, only one area at the entrance which was already packed. Most rides are in Japanese with no sub titles, only ride that had them was Minion Mayhem and this was only because it was a newer area so hopefully this improves and is a step forward for the park. Most rides are 4D so if you can not deal with motion rides and screen time then they are not for you as motion sickness is easy with these, particularly if you wear your own glasses (like me) for reading or screens. Overall though did the park in 1 day with an express pass which was good, but if you don't have a pass then I would recommend 2 days.

Nice place to live along the characters and being the part of their story. My recommendation is to start your journey with Flying dinosaur to awake your senses!! A awesome ride meant for everybody. After that any ride can be taken. Spiderman and Harry Potter rides are must. There is lot to try in snacks and drinks. Fruitbeer is one thing which everyone needs to try. And before you finish have a seat on Backdrop ride which will end your USJ trip on a high note. Caution: If you don't have child with you, then avoid Dragon quest.

I actually went back here for The Wizarding World of Harry Potter. It was high time to try some chocolate frogs and get a wand. They're a bit pricey but what the hey. The best part of the visit was dining with a view of Hogwarts. It couldn't get any better than that!

It's in the details. Pay close attention to how the decor the place and create the magical experience as you prod through the walkways. Forget about rushing to queue with the rest. Enjoy the day through having a bite, playing some Street games, watching Street live shows, and enjoy the story unfolds as you walked into each "world".  I'm most amazed with one staff, who was supposed to go round the park to change the thrash bags from the rubbish bins. However, during his tour of duty, he stopped by to draw some nice cartoons on the floor using his cleaning water. Tourists loved it! Took photo with the staff who now becomes a free Lance artist!

We headed in during the week to avoid the crowds. We ended up with a two day pass, which gave us time to explore and not feel rushed. The rides were great and typically we found the estimated time on the board for line ups wasn't accurate and we managed to get on much sooner. Some of the areas were in Japanese, but we still managed to really enjoy the stay and enjoyed every moment. Lots of character meeting opportunities and something for every member of your family. Highly recommend.

My review is 4 stars (very good), with one BIG caveat - buy the express ticket and avoid the queues. It's very expensive (an extra 6000 yen), but we didn't queue for more than 10 minutes for any of the rides.  If we hadn't got the express tickets we were looking at 2 and a half hours in a queue for a single ride (e.g. The Harry Potter ride).  If standing in line all day is your thing then save the money, but otherwise the express ticket is a MUST.

Its smaller scale of universal studio orlando with harry potter but only 1 harry potter park. Its mainly in japanese so maybe its difficult to enjoy some show. But the rides with google vr + roller coaster was awesome!
A must visit if you love theme parks. But the language barrier is a big turn off. All the rides are in Japanese! EVERY SINGLE ONE of them! hehe

Easily accessible by the train, here's the fantasy land for adults (what disneys are to kids). Still prefer the physical adventuress of the Jurassic Park and Jaws with actual happenings around you (yea these 2 are the classic types of games). The rest like Minions, Spider-Man, Harry Potter are the new ones mainly interacting with animating and a dynamic shaking/ vibrating seat.  Definitely need to get an express pass to save your time on the queue! I got the express pass 4 which entitled me to 4 games without waiting in the line, I found it sufficient.  Not commenting on the food, just cope with it, you are in an amusement park!

It's true that the lines are long. But if you will go solo, you will be able to ride all the major attractions even without an express pass since they have lines for single riders. Enjoyed my day here. And it was very convenient to have the bus station that caters buses that goes to other cities of Japan. I took an overnight bus to Tokyo after spending the whole day here. No need to worry about your luggage as well as there are Lockers that are fairly priced.

There are so many sites and sounds it is hard to experience everything in one day. There are a lot of crowds and rides available. The Harry Potter area was packed and the ride was a great experience. Some of the rides were a bit scary at times- especially the Jurassic Park one. However the theme park atmosphere was really enjoyable and is great place for couples and families. So much to see and do and a great attraction in Osaka. I was here in October 2014.

The weather was scorching but we had a great time anyway. We first headed for the Harry Potter area. Awesome! On the ride, we were flying around on our broomsticks and flew around Hogwarts. Wonderful! The rest of the rides were fun too. To end the night we rode on the Hollywood Dream- WOW!

I love theme parks and was really looking forward to this. But overall the day was a disappointment. We went there on a "quieter" day, Thursday. Even the ticket queues were long, not to mention slow!  Once in the park it was 80+ minutes for almost anything. I guess selling express passes is their business model. There were just too few rides for the amount of people. Also the shows were schedules around noon to 2pm so I missed some of them.  Tips: 1. Get your tickets in advance. I don't understand how the ticket queues can be so slow. 2. Contratory to what everyone else says, leave Harry potter for the last and hit Minion Mayhem first. Everyone runs for the Harry Potter when park opens and the queues are immediately 90 minutes. 2-3 hours before the park closes the queues were 25min for Harry Potter and 80+ elsewhere.

We went here early on a Thursday morning expecting the park to be rammed but the park turned out to be not too busy as we managed to ride our favourite rides multiple times. We found some of the wait times to be over-estimated in most cases (100 minutes for flying dinosaur, waited only 30 minutes), likely to control influx of people, so don't be too daunted by waiting times in off-peak season. I've visited Universal Studios Orlando multiple times and thankfully the Japan park provided many unique rides that makes it stand out. Park is easily and relatively cheaply accessed by JR lines and subway. We purchased our tickets via Lawson's 'Loppi' machine which i recommend if you didn't prebook tickets or as an alternative to purchasing the tickets at the park as queues for those can get ridiculously long. Overall a magical day out and a definite highlight of our holiday.

Im sorry. I think I nver to say "Just" for my trip destination. But, Im so dissatisfied with USJ than USS. The day when I visit USJ, its raining from morning. We cme from 7.30Am. At 9.00Am the gate open, but the left queue may enter. Middle and right queue NO! In the fact!!! The first cming from right-middle-left. And we must patience until 9.35Am when the gate open again. Too worst! Me and my friend just enter Harry potter world theme park, again and again with longggg queue to enter castle! 12Pm we back to downtown osaka. So dissatisfied

Universal Studios Japan (USJ) has something for everyone. From world class atmosphere entertainment to cutting edge rides, USJ is much more mature than Disneyland whilst still offering favourites such as Harry Potter Land.  At times it can be a little difficult sourcing food if suffering from allergies such as gluten intolerance, so it's worth packing snacks.  Rides: On a clear and sunny day expect to wait in line for roughly 90mins although it's worth purchasing an express pass, making the most of your time.  Entertainment: World class atmosphere and live shows. They're all quality shows, especially the Water World Stunt Show and the Violin show.
One of the best Universal Studios with the amazing Harry Potter which will bring you to the land of magic.

Our family enjoyed our trip to Universal Studios Japan. I just wish they would include English subtitles in the videos they show, especially in Harry Potter, so that non-Japanese speaking guests would understand.

Time Allowance: A whole day... at least.  Budget: A studio day-pass would cost you 7,600 Yen (Adults) / 5,100 Yen (Children) / 6,830 Yen (Senior). The prices could at least double if you would avail their Express Pass. You can check their website for more details.  Why Visit it: If you like theme parks and/or Harry Potter. Also, watch out for their seasonal events like their anime inspired rides and attractions (i.e. the Attack on Titan replicas, a Neon Genesis Evangelion 3D VR roller coaster ride and many more)  Why avoid it: If you suffer from Agoraphobia or Enochlophobia and if you are not a fan of theme parks.  Other notes: - Do you like to practice delayed gratification? Do you want to test your patience? Do you like standing in line for hours (at least 2-3 hours per attraction)? If you answer no to any of these questions then you need purchase their Express Pass to save time. Based on my personal experience, I was able to ride almost 80-90% of the rides on a single day at other Universal Studios theme parks (Hollywood, Orlando and Singapore) without purchasing any special VIP passes but Universal Studios Japan is so crowded that you would really thought of buying one. Without the buying the said pass, we went there at around 10am then left at 930pm and just managed to try 5 attractions! So if you are in a tight budget and can't afford it, you would need to plan your visit accordingly.  - You could buy tickets online via Klook.  - Also note that Express Pass can get sold out.

We visited universal studio with our 4 years old son. It took 30 mins to get in even though we had tickets arranged by our tour guide. Apart from the Annoying intermittent showers , we had good time there. We spent most of our time in wonderland. There are great indoor activities for kids - snoopy studio, Elmo' little drive, Bert and Ernie's wonder- the sea are high lights for my son. Staffs are very friendly and helpful. Minion park is another favourite place for my son. We managed to watch the water world show which was great. It can have loud noises at some stages which may affect the young children . Also try not to sit at the front rows as there can be water splash from the show. I can't comment about rides as we did not try. It would be nice to arrange some shades for rain around the waiting area at the entry gate. You can spend nearly whole day in the studio.

It might be exaggerated, but I strongly recommend an Express pass. I was here on a rainy Wednesday, which should be less crowded, however I felt like the place is full of people. Famous rides queue are as long as 80 minutes.  A standard Express 4 ticket should give you a pleasant half day with minimum queuing and a few more rides in the afternoon. With an Express 7 ticket, you should be fine for a whole day.  Tips: food inside is expensive and not very good, so, have your breakfast before coming

Although not as big as the other theme park in Tokyo, USJ still holds its own. We arrived at 9am (very late accirding to some theme park enthusiasts) but still able to get into the most popular rides with 60 -120 mins queueing time. The key is to be ready with the entrance ticket and purchase one of the express ticket (even the least option one will do you far) secondly if you arrived before the ride opens, remember its opening tine and be there when it does. When a ride just open, it will be less crowded and you probably endup eaiting for 5 to 10 mins. Dont rush for populat rides like the hollywood dream or the backdrop, it is less crowded in the afternoon and its more enjoyable. Don't be lazy to spend time queueing for one or two popular rides like the flying dinosaur. I wont recommend more than that.
