Our itenerary as I can remember it: spiderman the ride(just open), backdraft (just open), water play with minions crowd on the edge of new york area,T2 the ride (just open), flying dinosaur (60 mins queue and was worth it), harry potter the ride (use express pass timed at 13.30), play around in hogsmeade (buy the butter beer and an olivander's wand), Jaws the ride (use express pass and loving it), minion the ride (use express pass timed at 17.00), jurassic park the ride(15 minutes queue at this time of the day about 5.30pm), hollywood dream the ride (use express pass), watch DIO's World in the 4D cinema (official USJ map 20, mentioned as Shrek's 4D adventure). One last tip, keep an eye out for on street events like the minions water play on new york area, sesame street character appearance and minion characters appearance.. don't be shy to asked for selfies with these friendly folks.  There you go, have fun!

Was a fair queue when we arrived so decided to splash out on the express 4 pass. Well worth the money. The newer rides (Harry Potter / Minions) were much more immersive whereas others are very old and could do with updating. There is a lot of information on the rides in Japanese (shock) but it did mean a couple of the rides weren't really worth it (Godzilla I'm looking at you). For 2 adults including express passes, lunch at Harry Potter world including Butterbeers and some sweets we spent almost $500 AUD so not cheap.

My now 17yr old son and 15yr old daughter came here 2 yrs ago and and found USJ to be a great place to be. Since then they've added the much talked about Dinosaur ride and Jurassic Park rides.  Our opinion was that the Dino ride was the best where you're seated upright then you're turned forward so you're having the ground as if your a Teradyctal flying round the coaster. Once again it may not be the fastest, highest etc for all the coaster geeks but the total experience and colourful staff with their exuberance makes it the top ride in the park.  Like every ride there's a single ride lane which makes the Express Pass redundant. On occasion they may shut them but it's rare.  Personally the Express Pass is a waste of money as with most rides is that you're seated securely into a seat where you can't speak to your family member. You can still queue up together and have fun but why wait over 70 mins when you can go on in 10!!! A no brainer. That's based on two visits on different days.  It was yesterday, a Thursday, we visited on and unlike last time, again a weekday, the park felt quieter. It may be the increase in ticket costs but statistically Wednesday and Thursday are the quietest days.  We cherry picked the rides and themed shows based on last times visit so we had more time to go on our favourite rides multiple times.  We missed Terminator and Backdraft as they're all in Japanese and despite this we still thought them pretty lame. We missed Jaws, as we did it last time and although in Japanese was still worth the wait.  The new Jojo show was in 3D was pretty cool with hydraulic chairs and atmospheric water and heat blown on you at various times. My son, a real fan, understood the elements of the story despite it being in Japanese.  The Hollywood dream ride is still right up there. There's single lanes for the forward facing experience with the backwards and best version being a free for all wait. The displayed 70 mins was a 20 min wait!! Which again makes the overpriced Exp Pass a complete rip off. The single lane took more time to walk it than the actual wait of 5 mins!!  We still loved the 4D Spiderman ride. Again in Japanese but it really doesn't matter.  We never ate inside in the numerous and well priced restaurants but get your hand stamped and visit the cheaper places to eat outside, with the ubiquitous Golden Arches. The outside lockers mind you are expensive at ¥1000. You need 2 ¥500 coins unlike the inside ones at ¥100.  Contrary to the official website and other people's experience is that they don't check your bags so you can bring in your own drinks and food. Unless we got lucky twice save money and stock up. There's a Lawsons right before you enter.  I bought my tickets through Klook, download their app, to save money. Don't get scared about 3rd party sellers. Their an official Web partner. I've used their services in Hong Kong, Singapore, Beijing etc and the vochure codes are downloaded onto your phone. So it's a matter of scanning it, like at the airports, to gain entry.  We arrived at 0715 this time as 0815 on our first visit was too late as the mass crowds were insane. There's an early entry for hotel visitors and bought tickets but they open the gates at 0830 rather than the advertised 0900 opening and like many others ran to the HP ride and was greated with a 20 min wait. Well worth the run. As you go towards Jaws turn hard tight.  This time we bought a Butterbeer in a souvenir mug at £11 but was well worth it. It does taste great. A chocolate frog in a keepsake box with a 3D card at £8 and a scarf at £37.  We went on it again at 1800 and it took us longer to walk round the windy walkways than the actual time advertised.  It still is our fav 'themed' ride and as a non HP fan still found it to be excellent.  The 'kids' were tired as the heat does sap your energy and enthusiasm but it still is good value if you plan your day. The water Minion show and evening entertainment were missed but on our last time's visit is worth a go, along with One Piece.  A totally fun day out despite the price hike. Lastly please don't compare the parks around the globe as it's like comparing apples and oranges.  My email is mattalansharp@gmail.com if you fancy a chat to ask any questions.  Have a great day.
Modern place, amazing rides. I missed the manga-style caricature making, as it close to entrance. Ensure you don't make the same mistakes as I do.

It may not have Diagon Alley like in Orlando, but Universal Japan's Harry Potter area has Hogsmeade, the castle, and the black lake. Visiting made me so happy because it really is so accurate! The lines can be long and entry to the park is pretty expensive, but if you're in Osaka and you're a fan of Harry Potter, you really can't miss it. I walked through the rest of the park, which is pretty standard Universal Studios, but the standout area for me was the Wizarding World.

We went during what I believe was Chinese New Years so many tourists and young people around. Usually doesn't phase me being in large crowds, but did get pretty overwhelmed with the amount of people.  Started off, we looked online and saw that you could buy express passes to beat the queues. We arrived at Universal Studios about 45 minutes before it opened in the hope to get one of these express passes (as you could only get them from the kiosks, not online). After waiting in line for about 15 minutes, turns out they only sell about 100 or so of them and they had all been sold out. We were a bit annoyed but not much we could do about it.  Once in, I had a dilemma with the lockers. You pay approx $20NZD for a day locker (as we had backpacks). Turns out you can only access them once, so when I forgot my phone which was in my bag, I went back to the locker to get it and then it wouldn't lock again. So I had to pay another $20NZD so we had security for our bags.  I think the longest wait we had was 3 hours for the SpiderMan ride, which was very exhausting and we were hungry and needed to go toilet by that time but couldn't get back out.  Rides are awesome if you have the luck of not waiting hours. The shortest wait was about 1 hour for the back to the future ride as it was near the end of the day. I think all up we only managed to go on about 4-5 rides from the time it opened to closed.  Recently the Harry Potter part opened up, which proved to be the most popular. I was really keen on going on it, but turns out so was everyone else! We approached the line, waited for about half an hour and then saw that the wait was 4 1/2 hours!!!! No way were we waiting in that! So instead we just walked around Hogsmeade Village and did a walking tour through the castle (still took just over an hour).  Will make the choice to visit during off-peak season next time. So beware of other tourists!

So many awesome, fun activities to be found at USJ! The lines are crazy sometimes and if you can afford to, purchase the express tickets for the most popular attractions like the flying dinosaur.  USJ caters for all age groups and interest levels! It really is a place where you can have so much fun. Some of the attractions are in Japanese only (eg Terminator) but don't let that detract you from going-the experience alone is worth it!

A heavenly place for the kiddos. Never get bored to return to this place, especially with the addition of 2 new attractions: The Minions and Harry Potter. Suggest to get the ticket before your arrival and get the express line pass to save your time.

If you are after thrilling rides then this place is for you in Osaka! There was just a lot of people though especially in the harry potter village! The line for the forbidden journey was more than an hour! I suggest you purchase an express pass so that the waiting time will be a bit lesser and be sure to bring with you some water! We went there in June so the it was really hot! The overall place was full of cute stuff but the food was a bit expensive! So just put a little allowance on your budget to make sure!
It was very nice and fun place. It's not huge place that we can see most of time for a day! 1日あれば大体色々見て回れますがアトラクションに乗るのが時間掛かります。

Who doesn't like Universal studios? The moment we stepped into this place, we immediately felt excited by the colourful and exciting atmosphere and surrounded by familiar songs. Everyone's happy there.. old and young.. visiting USJ was a last minute decision so we couldn't get the fast passes.. hence missing out a lot of the rides.. every area that we stepped in, we felt like we have transported into the movie itself.. harry potter world was definitely our favourite.. we took million of amazing pictures.. all rides were narrated in Japanese..which made the experience even more authentic and interesting. Even watching the crowd was fun... many young people put on costumes from their favourite movies or Japanese anime...It was also fascinating seeing a pair or group of people wearing same clothes or of the same anime such as one piece. Joker from Batman and Hayley Quinn were definitely trendy during the time we were there.

I have been to the Universal Studios in LA and Orlando and I have to say the attractions are better in US. This park is more focus in small children. Although the Jurassic Park roller coaster is great but you have to wait around one hour in line.

Start queuing before the gates opened. Within first hour of operation, expect waiting time to escalate to 60mins for more popular attractions such as Minion, harry potter. Get express pass where possible as waiting time can be up till 150mins which is torturous in summer.

We visited the 1st week of August and the heat, added to the crowds and long lines, made it less than satisfying, although we enjoyed looking through the Harry Potter section. Our companions spent more than 2 hours in line for the HP ride, and thereafter refused to spend any more time in lines. For families with small kids who absolutely MUST get on the rides, perhaps it would be good to invest in the express passes, get 2-day passes, and book at a hotel beside the park.

I used the online travel agent klook and got the express pass and the VIP pass. Worth it to get into the part a little early and beat some of the crowd. Got on every single rollercoaster and every major attraction. I felt like a kid again. There was a lot of people but I expected that since it's Obon season. If your even just thinking about it then go. Be warned though. The Harry Potter ride "the Forbidden Journey" will get you sick if you can't deal with 4D motion rides. I got so ill to my stomach, but it didn't last long. A butter beer later and I was alright.

My friend and I are 21 and we just recently came back from Japan. We took the train from Kyoto to Osaka for the day to visit Universal Studios. We left around 6/6:30 to get to the park around 7:30 (hour before opening). To our surprise, we arrived to locals sprinting to the gates to line up before they opened. The park ended up opening 45 minutes before the time online and it seemed as though we were the only tourists to get there at this time. As the gates opened the locals begun sprinting to the most popular attractions (Harry Potter Simulator and the Flying Dinosaur). We were hesitant about not having express passes however we went to the Harry Potter ride first up and it only took us an hour to get on this ride which turned into 3/4 hours by midday. Every other ride took us roughly an hour to get onto except for the Flying Dinosaur which took around 160 minutes but still totally worth it. By the end of the day we had got on every ride we wanted to! Huge Highlight of Japan, alot bigger than the Japan Disneyland and alot more exciting for older people! If you are a patient person getting an express pass is an unnecessary fork out! Couldn't recommend it more

What do you have to do to get a Fast Ticket here? Where is the entrance to the Jurassic Park Rollercoaster?  Everything was so unclear. The shops were dull. Harry Potter was amazing. Waaaay too many minions.

USJ is a great example of the type - and we have been to CA and FLA versions also  In planning your visit be aware that, entirely deservedly, this is a destination visit for the entire North/ East Asian region, so it gets really busy  As a result, if your budget runs to it, then do buy fast passes in advance; nb if you want to buy them on the day of your visit then arrive promptly - we arrived at c8:40 and most types of pass were already sold out - if you don't have fast passes then waits of 120-150 minutes didn't seem uncommon  Otherwise enjoy a really well run and clean park!

followed kids to USJ Osaka as they wanted to check out the wizarding world of Harry Porter. the one in London was a standalone and not part of Universal Studio as in Japan and USA. Took the Osaka line to Osaka Universal City. Summer drew a sizeable crowd. Harry Porter was a delightful place to visit especially for those who have read JK Rowlings' books and grew up with Harry and friends. But unable to stand the long queue snaking up to the castle, my wife and i decided to go for lunch at Azzura de Capri the Pizzeria, just before the Jaws and Harry Porter entrances. The parade started while we were in the queue, and it was fun watching the characters in colorful costumes on the equally colorful vehicles. We ordered vegetable pizza which came with generous topping of capsicum, cranberries, aubergines, mushroom garlic and onions. Completed the healthy repast in a posh Italian decor with strains of italian classical songs, the only giveaway being the waitress' greeting in japanese; this was the only drawback as the staff could not converse in english and even trying to enquire about a take out had to be by sign language!
Really worth it! It is a must go to if you happen to be in Osaka. Great experience especially the harry porter show! The butter beer too ! The rides were awesome too!

Was worth going to see "The Wizarding world of Harry Potter". If you love Harry Potter this is a must do. Best to get there an hour before opening time as the queues get quite long and best to go during the week. We went to the "The Wizarding world of Harry Potter" section first before too many people got there.

Arrived at our hotel in Osaka to find out all the express passes for USJ were sold out. I prepared myself for hours of queuing and hardly getting on any of the rides, but I need not have worried! We got there around 8am, along with thousands of others, but it was worth it as the gates were opened early. Headed straight to the Dream, and following advice I'd seen on a Tripadvisor review, we queued in the single rider queue. We were on the ride within 20 minutes, our group of 4 were sitting behind each other, so no problem. Same with the Harry Potter ride, this time we used the single rider queue, and we were sat next to each other. It took us less than 50 mins, when the main queuing time was shown as 150 mins. This happened on all of the rides, so if you can, get in the single rider queues. We did all of the major rides, including the Flying Dinosaur, maximum queuing was 50 minutes, most were under half an hour. We left feeling satisfied we'd gone on everything, and I was even more pleased I'd not spent the best part of £200 on the Express passes!

FYI; I have some advice at the end of this review. If you do still decide to visit this park, You really should read it, trust me.  Now I love theme parks and I love Osaka. I've been to Universal in LA, Disney in Anaheim, Dream World, Movie World, Sea World and Water World all on the Gold Coast in QLD, but this one is the ONLY one that has had me nearly in tears with disappointment. Be aware, unlike Universal LA, Osaka has NO free wifi. This caused a very big issue for me when my Hubby went missing. Turning on my roaming cost me an insane amount of money. Anyway, we decided to get there early in the hopes to avoid some of the crowd, we knew it would be insanely busy either way though. We had to line up to get our tickets(normal), then we had to line up to get in (not as normal) then we got told to line up just to get an English map (what?? ok...) When we went to get our tickets, we asked for Express tickets to the Hogwarts ride, the only ride I really wanted. At 9.15am, sold out. Seriously they open at 9am!! Argh.  We headed straight for Hogwarts once in the park. There were no signs telling anyone where to go, or what area they had to be in, or that we all needed to get into yet another line in a totally different area to get tickets into Hogwarts area. Why not just get tickets when we buy our entry into Universal, especially when we'd specifically asked for Hogwarts?? That would save a hell of a lot of confusion and avoidable crowding, time and lines!  Anyway, Lucky I overheard a staff member explaining it to a fellow confused couple. So off we go into another line with about 2000 people in it. (seriously this entire line could have so easily have been avoided). Finally get our tickets after another drama that is way too confusing to explain here. Go back to Hogwarts entrance, there is a massive line, what's it for?? We all assume, to get in, but no signs, so who really knows.  We see some people getting into a blocked off area, but again, no signs. So we line up with everyone else. After waiting 20mins, the line leads to the exact same blocked off area which we had tickets for and would have been allowed to get through. Damn it!!!! Where were the signs??  Finally we get into Hogwarts, it's amazing and right at the entrance is the Butter Beer stand, so of course we line up. Gotta try that! 10 mins waiting until a staff member asks if we have a ticket. You have got to be kidding me!! We have to wait in yet another useless line, to get yet another ticket, just to buy butter beer.  O...K...(patience wearing very thin now...) So we do. After about 15minutes we get our tickets, then we have to get back in the original line. FINALLY we get our drinks. Just so you know, they were AMAZING. Like super creamy, creaming soda with frothy ice-cream foam on top. YUM.  Next we see a massive line that basically starts from the entrance, to what we assume is the ride. 1.5hrs waiting time (It sucks, but we figure that's pretty normal for a busy theme park) So we get in the line. 30 mins waiting, waiting, waiting, before a staff member comes and asks us all if we have express tickets. WTF!!!!??? WHY IS THERE NO SIGN???????  If there was a sign, we would have never gotten into that line and wasted our time. By this stage we are really getting sick of their lack of communication (in any language) and their severe lack of crowd control, organisation and lack of SIGNS. So we walk to the normal line minimun 3.5hour wait!! Yet if we were allowed to get in when we first arrived (only minutes after 9am), instead of piss farting around getting useless tickets and standing in counterproductive lines, none of this would be an issue.  So, we never make it to the Hogwarts ride. The ONLY ride I wanted to go on.....insert what ever word you think I may have said at this point.  So by now its around 12.30pm, yes all that stuffing around took ALL morning!! and we had still not really accomplished much at all. Most rides were around 1.5hr wait which is pretty normal for a busy theme park, it's the waste of time, extra lines that they don't tell you about, that make this Park a waste of space.  Lunch; I wait in a line for 15minutes in full sun (it was a 34C day) to get a beer and hotdog for hubby and a seafood salad and soda for me. All advertised on their signage. I finally get there sweating up a storm only to find out they don't sell anything but shaved ice, beer and hotdogs with no topping for around $18 Aus. OMG!!!! I'm am now furious. I'm hot, I'm hungry, I'm upset about Hogwarts, and I'm tired of lining up for nothing, because that's all I have done ALL freakn day so far.  So many "shops" that had awesome potential to be really cool shops or attractions were just facades, or stores that had no relation to the facade itself. For example the Max Factor shop looked amazing on the outside, but once you walk in, it was just housing lockers for storing your stuff. The Teddy Bear store was just a facade and every time there was an actual shop, it literally sold the same crap as all the stores next to it. There was disappointment at every corner it seemed. Until we finally got into the Water World attraction. The ONLY thing without disappointment for us. But at around $88Aus a ticket into Universal Osaka that's one damn expensive show.  My advice if you still visit here; Be aware, no free WiFi. So if an issue arises, suck up the cost of roaming charges or buy a Japanese data only sim card (approx $35AU for 3g/b per 7 days)! Minimum 15-30 minute wait for any kind of food any time of day, including restaurants. Even between meal times, you have to wait in line for a table or find a find a table and then go order food. They will not serve you food at the table and will not sell food unless you have one.  Most lines are in direct sun, including many food lines. So in summer, be prepared to sweat it out. (I love summer heat, but this was tough at times) Small sandwiches cost around $18aus 1 slice of minion pizza will set you back around $13 aus 5 pieces of Hello Kitty popcorn chicken was $5.50aus Very little informative signage for rides and attractions.  If there is a ride you want, pre-purchase your tickets weeks before online. No subtitles on video attractions at all, so you had better learn Japanese, or avoid enjoying these. For example the Back Draft attraction and Hogwarts Castle walk through.  Most of your day will be waiting in lines. Half of these lines will be counterproductive, so you'll have to deal with that.  In hindsight we really should have known that the USA is really the best place to do the USA successfully. It's seem stupidly obvious now, but we can't do much about it, apart from give info to others in the hopes of saving them from making the same mistakes. If only we had read a review like this, we could have gone to the LA park instead and had the world of fun I was so excited for.  We should have stuck with the authentic, original park near the heart of Hollywood. Because Universal LA was awesomely incredible and I give that Park 5 stars!!!
the rides were spectacular especially the one with Harry on his broomstick ! again,again, again, i wanted to scream after the ride but their was quite a long queue.

I've been in different Universal Studios and this one is the worse, because of the crowd. In both that I've been you could visit all attractions if you spend there a day. In this one it's impossible. The waiting time is at least 60 min. That is really disappointing. It's very good place to visit with great attraction, even some of them magical (Harry Potter one :-P). Unfortunately if there is no limits of visitors it's just a place where you stay in queue for ages.

We arrived 8.30, and left just before closing time. We also paid for express passes. With 2 kids 10 and under, super 34 degree heat and loads of queues, it was not easy getting through all the exhibitions quickly.  Yes you probably need to be super organised on what you wanted to see. To me, it's a shame you even have to do that, after paying so much money just to skip the queues with the express pass.  The main attraction for us was really going to Harry Potter world for my mad HP fan daughter. Minions was pretty cool too.

Word of advice: Make sure you buy the ticket in advance and arrive there early.  We arrived at 9ish and we found the queue to get in was enormous . Beside it was a Thursday so can't imagine the crowd during weekend.  The Top 5 rides that you shouldn't missed are 1- Flying Dinosaurs 2- Harry Potter's hidden passage 3- Hollywood's Dream & Backdrop 4- Spider-Man 5- water world show  If you want to beat the queue, you can either buy the express pass or you can use the single rider which I have tried both.  The merchandise and the food are quite expensive. However, you can bring in your own food and drinks.  We had the frozen butterbeer(non alcohol) in the wizard world of Harry Potter. And the frozen pineapples and mango which are very nice for a hot summer day.  Universal Studio Japan really do it well.

We bought ticket online to prevent long queue. Went there on Thursday because we read in some blogs Thursday was one of the less crowded day. No timed ticket. If you are Minion's fan, you MUST go there first because the waiting time for the ride will be super long. We didnt get to Minions ride because the waiting time is 2 hours at the time.

Went here during the Halloween festivities - was awesome to see after 6pm all the monster and zombies running around the place. While I thought it was great fun a lot of people were genuinely afraid which added to the atmosphere. The horror rooms were pretty cool too. However, I strongly recommend to book ahead well in advance - get an express pass, book your attractions and the Harry Potter zone. We only rode 3 rides, missed out on Harry potter and most other attractions were booked. If you plan well and get there from opening, you should enjoy your day.

Universal studio is a must when you are in Osaka. The park is so huge! We were lucky that when we were there there was not too much crowd. We managed to get to the harry porter park quite easily. You need at least 1.5 days to cover the park . Our 6 year old daughter really enjoyed the rides at wonderland and refused to leave the area to explore the other parts of the park. Of course we eventually managed to pull her out . Food for Muslim visitors are very limited but you can probably pick and choose food without meat, lard etc . Maybe it's time for USS Japan to consider having halal food options.

Very fun and nice experience! Must go for Harry Potter fan! The atmosphere is excellent. People have their wand and cloak. I think this is even more fun than London's Harry Potter studio. Japan Universal make me feel like I have magical power:)

New character "moppy". This store is located in front of Hollywood dream the ride. You can also play "smile game" and if you get high score there, you can get special pass ticket which you can ride any attraction with no need to wait for.

The park is great with plenty on offer. It is however 100% set up for Japanese only visitors so if you don't mind fumbling your way through the instructions and listening to the attraction dialogue in Japanese then you'll be OK.  Having said that if you are limited for time don't bother with the Terminator attraction as it's mostly a show in Japanese for 20 minutes with some cool 3D effects for about 10 minutes out of a total of 30.  If you can afford it get an express pass but also know that if a queue is less than 20minutes don't use the express option as that's similar to the wait you will have anyway.  Save the pass for another ride or repeat later (you can only use it once). Queue wait times varied from 90 to 170 minutes long.  There is also a quiet haven in the middle of the park in the form of a hotel style restaurant. Much needed after several hours of crowds and constant noise.  Food is mostly junk food and expensive so take some with you if you don't want to pay the premium inside.

Whenever there is a Universal Studios, I am sure to check it out.  Filled with exciting rides, it is sure to bring out the kid in you.  Suited for all ages, well laid out (just needs more toilets)  I would recommend spending a whole day here but if you arrive after 1500 hrs it is cheaper.  The day we went there was a special event on, Zombies!

We chose to visit on a weekday knowing that the lines and crowds were incredibly long. We bought our tickets online and got to the park roughly an hour and a half before the park opened and we were pretty much near the front of the line to get in the park. We had someone in our group line up at the ticket lines for express passes but probably didn't need them. Even though they let in a whole bunch of people prior to the regular opening time we were able to run to Harry Potter and get the forbidden journey ride done without waiting! No wait for the hippogriff ride and ollivanders either. Getting there early is key because for the first several rides there are barely any waits. Closer to 10-11 and onwards lines were getting up to over an hour!

I feel as if I was mislead here at Universal osaka. So we spent the equivalent to $400 usd to have such a negative experience. We ya d purchased a vip pass. As mentioned above rather pricey. Our ticket was in Japanese and nothing was marked in English. The lady who sold us the ticket did not mention any restrictions. Unlike the vip passes at universal parks in the states, the pass restricts you from going on certain rides and certain times. It is an absolute waste of time and money. Better to visit other theme parks or none at all. Had a very negative experience and feel as if I was robbed. My day was ruined at this theme park.

I have nothing but love to say about this place! Me and my family enjoyed Universal Studio very much! It was great that I booked all our tickets in advance via Klook.. And I would really recommend if you have the budget to avail of some of the fast pass packages..! That way once you and your family get in.. You can immediately enjoy some of the rides without the hassle of the initial wait and long cues..  Great time go and visit is during the cold weather's ! Rides I would highly recommend are the Harry Potter and the Jurassic Rides..! For the ones with small kids and seniors in tow.. the Jaws is fun and kid friendly.. Truly this place is worth every penny and I and my family would definitely go back for another visit..  I hope you guys do to.. and experience the magic that is USJ!

This US is conveniently located next to the subway or train station. We were impress by the bigness and all its beautiful theme structures. Although it was a weekday (14 September 2017), the theme park was crowded and the queuing took a while for us to try the Harry Porter ride - it was an exciting experience.  This is our first visit to any of the US, and we would want to try visit more from now.
i love this theme park so much just a bit disappointing as i found no halal food selling inside of the theme park.

My most favourite park in here is the Harry Potter World. The music playing in the background while you stroll the village and at Three Broomsticks makes you feel like you're in the movie itself. The rides were cool, the butterbeer was delicious. Spent most of my time here before venturing off to other parks. The Minion park was probably the most crazy-crowded of all parks. It was nearing Halloween season as well, so there were zombies and ghosts and vampires roaming all over the place to add on to the festivity. Would come back here again.

I received the daily schedule from their crew. There're English title but hardly understand what they are. The schedule is unclear for me. We started at Harry Potter, we love everything there but there're a lot of visitors (we were there on Friday). Hardly take a picture in there. In the wand studies, the cast mainly speak in Japanese.... i don't understand their conversation... ;( We spent quite a lot of time on queuing up, but we notice actually we can spend less time on it if we get in the games in the evening. The queue up time took 35mins instead of an hour plus in the afternoon. We finally played almost all the rides! yeah~ Better spent longer time for pictures (if u love taking picture) in daytime & have the rides at night. We had pizza in the park for lunch. And it's amazing that we easily found a table with the San Francisco view. Lovely!

Went on a few rides here. Food is expensive like any other places. Came a bit earlier to get the express ticket (Exprensive but worth it! So you don't waste time queueing)  Express ticket: there are options to choose from on which ride you'd like to get the express tickets too. Highly recommended to get the ones with Flying Dinosaur. The queue can get up to 3 hours. Getting an express ticket will cut that time by just 10-15 mins wait.  If you are going for JAWS ride, get a poncho! You'll need it

Very good amusement park for young people and children. Lot of people. Must have express pass if not want to wait hrs . Even though my son is still to young for the rides. But he still love it. There is place called wonderland and it is designed for the young children. Love it.

It's the Harry Potter Ride!  As usual, theme parks like this lets you fall in line for 1 to 2 hours before you can actually ride.. So, in my whole day, I get to avail 4 rides only. But if there's one thing that you need to prioritize, it should should be the harry potter ride. truly magical!

I love The Wizarding World of Harry Potter! The butter beer and the setting is wonderful and I really enjoyed the Harry Potter ride, I had to go for it again (even though queue waits are not the most ideal for most rides in USJ).  Seperate Queue and ticketing (free) is required to enter the Harry Potter attraction in Universal Studio. It has a limit to how many people can enter for each allocated time period on the ticket. Each person is limited to one ticket /day. Once you enter you can stay as long as you want and you'd probably don't want to get out after that.  It would be worth it to buy the express pass if you have limited time but if not, take the whole day to enjoy the park! I would definitely recommend if you love theme parks! Worth a visit at least.
Lots of rides and attractions and you can easily spend a whole day here. I would recommend buying an xpress pass to avoid the ridiculous hour long line ups and the popular rides.

i love that place , been there for more then 20 times , its magic and so much fun , the atmosphere is fun , the attractions could refreshed more often . the biggest problem of that place , to crowded ! the last 5 times i have visited , waste of money , couldn't enjoy the attractions because of too many visitors , during each day of the week ,weekend or a week day , or even monday or tuesday . i gets they only care about selling as much tickets as they can , not about people to have fun . they must decide of a maximum capacity asap .
Here is much more than fun park which middle age like me feel back to 14 years old. A points must to visit are Harry Porter and Chukky which I love the most. :)

We stayed opposite at the Keihan Universal Tower which was a wise choice. By the time we reached the park at 8 am, there was a massive queue to buy the tickets and to enter. Luckily we had bought tickets with klook beforehand. We also bought the express passes. Trust me if you do not have the express passes also bought with klook or JTB or one of the agencies beforehand , you can only go for the popular rides after 180-220 minutes of queuing. We tried several times and did not get to go on the minion rides because of the long queue.( We did not manage to get the express pass for this ride). Basically you purchase the pass, pay up with the agencies online ( they may need you to take a photo of your driving licence) and print out the express pass and present to the appropiate rides entrance attendents and you bypass the long queues. Harry Potter Land is a must and the forbidden journey ride in my opinion is undoubtedly the best . Try the very sweet Butterbeer, purchase a wand for 45000-49000 yen, buy special candy that you read in the books. It was a lot of fun. The restaurant there is disappointing though. We had the worst fish and chips ever and the Halloween feast was okay. I think we would have had better value eating at the universal plaza outside the park. We left the park at mid-day . At exit , you get a chop on the hand and when you return, they scan your hand and tickets again. The hotel is a five minute walk from the park, hence excellent for families with small children because of the rest in between .

We went 30mins before opening right after Japanese golden week and there were already lines of people waiting by the entrance. Smaller than Univerasal Studios LA but definitely bigger and more fun than the one in Singapore. Kids loved Harry Potter town of course. We purchased express pass beforehand and it came handy when we wanted to go on a ride for more than one time but I don't think you will need it if you are going on a weekday on a normal week.

Visited the first time in Japan, small theme park, not much activity, all roller coaster ride, went to Harry Potter land and spiders Man ride, Terminator show was closed early, shows were only in Japanese language, all restaurants were expensive, went to the shops, most of the stuff were not interested and so expensive, found one t-shirt but no extra large, size only small to Large. Overall, very disappointed, rather going back to USA again.
i went on september 2014 it was great but tooooo much crowded and it is not easy to buy fast pass ticket. few people there are speaking english so it was difficult to comunicate.

We went to Universal Studio in Osaka just to kill our first evening in Japan. It turned out to be super great experience. There are walking dead zombies walking among us everywhere and the parade was awesome. And if you are Minion lover, they are everywhere too. Lots of cute photo spots with our little yellow fellows. Last but not least, dont miss to taste takoyaki inside the City Walk building, it's one of the best in town.

we went there on a sunday. it was a mistake on our part. but the place is nice. the line for the harry potter ride is long (took us 2 hours in queue).. but the ride is is excellent. i did not expect that it was too good. i suggest that you will not go here on weekend.

Been here couple of times and 16/10 decided to return even though weather forecast was raining for the whole day in anticipation of lower turnout. Halloween theme mazes and shows was my highlight resulting in the 6pm zombie street breakout. Frightening mazes with human zombies popping out almost at every corner chasing you, growling & screaming is the order of the day. Had almost completed all the Halloween attractions - Deadman Forest, Exorcist, Elm Street (Freddy Kruger and his blades), Saduku a Japanese ghost terror, Chucky and the whole works. Also new is the Minion area. Since it was Halloween had the cosplay locals in full swing coming in as Harlequins, jailbirds, cops, SWAT, Nuns, monks, zombies, ghosts, monsters and after all this is the land of cosplay - even had the Chinese Vampires with their “yellow charm” on forehead. It was mayhem and is on its own an attraction. Well done University Studio for catching up with Halloween Madness and also the locals. Cannot imagine on weekend the horror levels. Had a great time being chased by chainsaw wielding zombies that breaks into a MJ “Thriller type dance routine” HATS OFF.
Harry Potter World! Amazing Lightshow on the castle at night, be sure not to miss it. Truly magical!

I've been to 3 Universal Studios, Osaka by far is the best!! Weekends are definately less crowded. Definately recommend express pass which cut queue time by a fraction!! We are able to finish exploring the entire park, watched a few shows and rides with time to spare. The journey to and from is not entirely pleasant due to multiple JR routes which makes it confusing.

I'm rating this "very good" because solely of harry potter! In terms of others, well, food is expensive, same with the merchandises, but it's normal to most theme parks. It's huge comparing to other theme parks that i've visited. Overall, i enjoyed my stay there, so it's good. =)
I had the Express 7 pass with me so I managed to jump the Q for a few rides. Flying dinosaur highly recommended! Harry Potter was not bad for the first try.

The outside rides were good. But the inside rides were not great. The Harry Potter ride is particularly disappointing. The 3D visual presentation was very poor and badly synchronized with the motion. I had to close my eyes before the end of the ride or I would have been sick. Never again.

I had so much fun in USJ. I bought express pass for 4 rides include Harry Potter and it was worth it! We spent the whole day and like to play few rides few times like Jurassic Park' rides and Hollywood dream. HP' ride is also fun but the queuing was unbelievable so express pass for this ride is a must. Had to try to Butterbeer but the foods there was so-so. Cant wait to go back again to USJ someday

This is a must go for anyone who wants to experience Harry Potter world. The rides were mostly in Japanese though, which makes it rather difficult to fully enjoy them. The crowd did not thin when it grew dark due to the Halloween attractions going on. Queuing for rides tend to exhaust you when it got later in the day. Thankfully we were able to skip some with the exorbitant express passes.

Visiting studio village is definitely an experience! Being that we speak absolutely no Japanese makes the rides hilarious as you have no idea what they are saying but because you know what the story is, quite interestingly 😂 Also well worth it to get the fast pass!!!

It is super crowded! We waited for 2 hours for a ride of 2m on a boat ride! It’s absolutely ridiculous! We were there on a Wednesday and most rides have over 1 or even 2 hours waiting time. We only managed to get on 2 rides and they are all in Japanese only. The street parade shows are also very ordinary. The only interesting part for a tourist is people watching there. A lot of people are properly dressed up in Halloween scheme and cartoon characters.

USJ was very accessible and was very satisfying. Fast pass is the best option here but the queue is worth the wait for the thrilling rides. Spiderman was not much of satisfaction but the rest was a blast. Definitely love the backdrop and the flyng dinosaurs ride. Harry potter was the main attraction, with timing for entrance. I had the fast4 ony bcuz it has almost the same timing as my frens fast8 for harry potter since we purchased it seperately. Fast 8 saves u alot of time. Apparently fast4 does not comes along with the minion ride so i had a long waiting time for it. I dint felt worth it cuz apparently u queued so long but what made it long was the videos before the ride. Overall satisfied with the coasters and HarryPotter.

It's big, it's beautiful and everything but however you may not enjoy all the show as all are conducted in Japanese language so you may not know what's coming or appreciate it.  The rides also other than the roller coasters, I'm not a fan of high intense adrenaline rides did not feel the excitement. For example the Spiderman's ride which I found it just ok where small kids also can ride it.  Be that as it may, you can still enjoy the environment, buildings and scenery especially at the Wizarding World of Harry Potter which is remarkable.

Wow Wow incredible Haloween was definitely the time to go the Japanese certainly embrace it and it wasnt for another week jet people were dressed up everywhere we went.Saved the best for last Harry Potter World is simply amazing words cant describe how impressive it is, and the ride within Hogwarts will blow your mind. I think you shoul d go on it twice as you are so taken aback that you probably may miss details of the journey you are taken on.Enjoy. Kerry & Rob Australia
We visited Dontonbori several times during our stay in Osaka. It lived up to our expectations for the quality, variety and cost of the food we had wanted to try.

No. 1 highly recommended ride is Flying Dinosaur. If you are travelling alone, you have the advantage of getting to the single rider lane. I bought my entrance ticket online via Klook few days before and use the mobile voucher. No need to print. Make sure to arrive there 1 hour before to queue up. I was lucky I did not have to get the timed entry ticket for Harry Potter. Totally worth the wait! Minions Ride is overrated. Wasted my 40 minutes to queue up as they do not have single rider lane.

Massive crowds, ridiculous wait times, often 150 minutes for most rides, enormous queues just to get some popcorn. Maybe good for families with small children who want to go on the “ baby rides” or just look at the sights and it is interesting to see the replicas of the film sets but we left early, frustrated and headed over to the Hard Rock Cafe where we had a great casual meal.

We went to USJ before halloween.. a lot of people came to visit the park using costume.. the theme for this halloween is super good... the zombie zone replace the parade on the evening... the must place to visit is the harry potter world...

If you visit Osaka, this is a place to recall your childhood experiences. Although it's quite expensive for tickets, but it's really worth it. The theme park was very crowded even I went there on Tuesday. The ExpressPass is recommended to avoid long queue on most of the popular rides.  The Wizarding World of Harry Potter is a must-visit zone. You can enjoy the rides with good butter beer (it's non-alcoholic drink, kids can enjoy it too.)  If you would like to buy souvenirs inside the park, make sure to bring your passport for tax refund before exiting the park.  Buying ticket and ExpressPass in advance from authorized agent like Klook.com is also recommended!

do not go here on weekends too crowded. go weekdays and reach by 9 am .  it's pretty empty then . it's every adults and child's dream come true to see the magnificent hogwarts express and the school . Harry potter comes to life here .  all in all I must say it was the best day of my holiday in Japan !

We spent 1.5 days here which i strongly recommend if you are a lover of thrills and roller coasters. It made our time more enjoyable. The first day starts at 3pm, we arrived at 4pm and we managed to do the main rides within a reasonable time period. The waiting time was very quick compared to Disney and also because it was on a monday.  The following day we arrived at 11am and we were still able to do the main rides with our fast pass. I probably for next time wont get the fast pass and do the same thing with getting 1.5 day ticket.  The food here is more expensive compared to disney and they do not allow you to bring in outside food however they did not check on arrival. The staff are all very friendly and helpful.  I would recommend that you check out youtuber Tokiyuyu on tips on how to make your day more enjoyable at usj. Her video allowed me to make my day more enjoyable with her tips and links she provided.  I would definitely come back here again.

Just a quick review for my recent travel to Asia, Osaka being one of the stops. Ive been to universal many times in Orlando. So sort of in the back of my head i would be subconsciously comparing to my pass experience. The rides seem to be less exciting. Long Long line ups even on a weekday on a Off season (sort of happy we got the xpress pass, as suggested on sites) But roller coaster wasnt that thrilling. The minion ride....did the screen get smaller? All in All its smaller theme park (which is understandable) but the rides seem less exciting to. So if youve been to the one in Orlando or LA then you consider saving a few bucks when your in Osaka.

There are a lot of rides in this amusement park but unfortunately (for me), most of them are conducted in Japanese. I found it difficult to know what was going on some of the rides such as Spiderman, Jaws, Terminator, Backdraft, Harry Potter etc. If you don't understand Japanese, your experience may be dampened.

My girlfriend and I had a great time here, but compared to the Universal Studio in Orlando it is a little scaled down. It was fun, and kind of cool to see the Wizarding World of Harry Potter (if you like that sort of thing), so pretty good overall.

You can take the JR train with the harry potter paintings outside until the universal station. When you arrived, there’s hotel and restaurant complex before you can enter the universal studios. The park area is big, with so many themes. There’s so many attraction for toddler and young kids, including go-kart, and also indoor playland. Your kids surely will love it. But you must check the harry potter zone, it’s quite far from the entrance but it’s a cool stuff to visit.

First off, the park rides can be extremely difficult to go on if you don’t have express passes. This review and the rating is based on a express 7 pass. Otherwise the waiting period can be 90 minutes plus for popular attractions. Hollywood dream and backdrop were definitely the best rides. The rest was pretty average even the Harry Potter one.

I’ve been to Universal in both Florida and LA. I have never ever seen queues like this place.  We had a great time, they put just as much effort into it as in the states but boy are there queues.  Get your tickets in advance (I’m from UK and used Voyagin), buy the fast pass, trust me you’ll need it.  We went on a Sunday in November and the ride queue times were up to 260 minutes. With the fast passes we queued less than 20 minutes for all the rides. But seriously without a fast pass you’ve almost got no hope of any of the other rides.  People were queuing for over an hour just to get a photo with a minion.  But we had a great time and I’m glad we went... with our fast passes!

A very fun day at USJ with my family of 4. Much more fun than Disney reason being the queue is not as crazy and you get to join in the party after the street performance and we literally danced with the characters on the street with balloons and streamers everywhere. Really was a mayhem! HPW was a wonderful experience. Buying the wand, casting spells with my kids, taking the Hippogrift ride (though not thrilling) and absorbing magnificent castle was unforgettable. Lunch at HPW was not really great and the q was crazy but it's for the experience. The cold butterbeer was delicious though. I recommend to go during Xmas season when they have extra shows around the park.

We visited on a Monday, so the crowd was not too bad and our queue time was manageable (70min to 80min for most popular rides). The rides were all very exciting. The park has many restaurants and cafe. Overall a great experience!
I am not a theme park fan, but this place was pretty fun. If there had been less of a crowd I would have really enjoyed myself. My 5 year old had a blast anyway.

Visiting Universal Studios was a excellent experience. Lots of rides and experiences areas. We had not been here before and many of the rides, older ones admittedly, had shot lines to get on so we got r experience much of the park in one day. The only real problem we had was that we had read that we should ‘rush’ and book our time for the ‘Harry Potter’ world, we thought we were quick but not fast enough, by the time we entered HP world it was SOLID with people, excellent to walk around but not worth the 90 minutes wait to go on the ride.
Amazing place for leisure. Staff were very friendly and helpful. The facilities were outstanding. Atmosphere full of fun. I will definitely come back again

This is a review for the above merchant only. I was there last week Dec 4. I would like to warn everyone buying merchandises here. They made a mistake charging my credit card twice with the purchase I made. I remember that staff saying the first one was nothing so he scanned again. I only signed on one receipt. But in fact I got charged twice. The staff only asked me to sign 1 receipt. Please be careful and when it happens to you get the receipt they said was a mistake! So you can have an evidence to prove in case you're lucky enough to get in touch with them!  I called the bank last night and they told me they can't help me since this is not a fraudulent transaction but rather a mistake by the merchant. I called the number on the receipt and I was greeted by a Japanese operator, no option for English so I don't really know what to do in the call. No email address from the website for customer service. Facebook and Twitter accounts don't have options for messages. Basically -- i'm doomed.  I am back in Singapore so the bill would probably cost more than the amount they need to waive for me if I call them. It is only $41, small for most people. But i feel it is really unfair to make me pay over something I did not buy. I am upset about this. I was there just last week so probably that staff is still there. So please please guys check your bank unbilled transactions before you leave the country so you can at least call them. I bought a lot of things in there and it's a relief they didn't do it on the amount I purchased for $404. If that's the case, i would prolly end up just paying 😂😂  I wish that since a lot of us tourists are going there, even just the Harry Potter itself, at least they should set up some English customer service for those that can't speak Japanese.  Any of you that can help me find their email address to reach them PLEASE PLEASE let me know! I want to get this waive off before it gets billed 😂😂

My wife and I visited December 2017. We had a very enjoyable experience overall (my 2nd time). It is quite expensive if you want to it right; express pass, foods and souvineers.  The flying dinosaur was amazing, make sure to do this first before you have a big meal or you'll definitely barf...  My wife and I were extremely confused by the Monsters of Rock and Roll. The beetlejuice character was great but the others were strange and all felt out of place.  For an English speaker with a small understranding of Japanese, I've overall enjoyed my experiences here. Just recommend not to wait too long for something and waste your time on one attraction which might only provide a moment of fun (Back drop/Hollywood dream).
Many attractions, est waiting time for the rides is around 45-60min But there are many shows which you can catch up.

Arrive early in the morning and it was already packed with people queuing to buy the tickets to go in. Luckily we bought the entrance tickets and express pass through klook so we can skip the queue and proceed straight in. The queues in some of the rides was so long that the waiting time was 2hrs. The express pass was really worthwhile as it saves us the time to queue for the rides and we were able to spend more time in the world of Harry Potter. The JAWS ride was quite disappointing as it was just a boat ride.

We got there when it opened and didn’t leave till it closed. It was so much fun for everyone. We all bought wands at Harry Potter (you have a chance to be given one for free) did our magic drank butterbeer, ate chocolate frogs and rode the rides! Much more fun then i thought it would be. We went on a Wednesday and it was not crowded at all. No one seemed to mind if you brought in food or drinks even though it asks you not to. The show at the end of the day and lightning of the Christmas tree was one of the best shows i have seen for Christmas. There was way more English spoken and signs then i thought there would be also, communication and getting around was super easy!

When in Osaka, you have to make time to go to Universal Studio Osaka, the place for entertainment. You will find harry potter and hogwards school, elmo and friends, minions, spiderman, snoppy and friends, also jurrasic park. Each studio give different entertainment, however the queue to the ride / entertainment is quite long during peak season. There are many shops sells souvenirs. When you want to eat, there are many choices of restaurants, also there are some located outside the entrance gate.

Visiting USJ was definitely the highlight of my trip to Japan. The whole park was so well done, especially the Wizarding World of Harry Potter. When we went, there was quite a crowd but we managed to enter Hogsmeade before our stipulated timed entry on our express pass. We got the Christmas express pass which allowed us early seating for their Christmas performance, express pass for the Harry Potter ride, and a cup of regular butterbeer with the souvenir plastic cup. Definitely worth getting the express pass to zip to the front of the queue for the ride. We cut straight to the locker area to keep our bags and were at the front of the line in less than 10 minutes. WORTH IT. However, the ride can be quite nauseating so do be prepared to be shaken around a little and do not go on after a big meal if you get motion sickness easily.  We didn't get the express pass for the other rides as they were all sold out very early. (We tried purchasing them through our local authorised reseller a week before our trip but it was all sold out.) We queued up for over an hour for the minion ride, which wasn't the most interesting ride in the park. Cute nonetheless as I am a huge fan of the minions. Another way to beat the queue is to go for the single rider line, which we did for the spider-man 4D ride. I was with my family (5 of us) and we were separated for the ride. Queued up less than 10 minutes for the ride as compared to the hour long wait indicated for the regular line. Express pass would be handy especially for the Harry Potter ride but not totally necessary for the other rides us at least, as we were ok with waiting in line.  Overall, the park is definitely a must-go if you are in Osaka.

The flying dinosour and Harry Porter castle were fhe best attractions. We visited usj on 22 Dec 2017, there were not many visitors i expected. We entered the park with VIP wristbands at 0800 hrs. We first went to Jurassic park as we had purchases Express 4 and booked to enter harry porter and Minions at 1140 hrs and 1520 hrs respectively. We left the park at 1700 hrs as we felt exhausting after playing most of thr attractions. We even played Merry go around on wanderland before leaving.

There really weren’t enough rides or entertainment to call this a good theme park. Not worth the money at all! Don’t waste your time or money on this place. The lines were too long and only 4 or so major rides each with a 2 and a half hour wait. The minions section was super busy with families and children. The rides and shows were very dated, all based on the early 90s versions of cartoons and movies. The only characters we saw dressed up were a woody wood pecker and a minion. Just a disappointment over all. It was basically just shops selling overpriced, not very interesting merchandise. The Harry Potter castle walk and the Spider-Man ride were the highlights of the day.

We bought the 2 day pass on the recommendation of our travel agent but was disappointed when we arrived there ... the park is very small compared to the Disney parks, we had seen/rode all the attractions by mid-afternoon! The waterworld attraction is a must see (not a ride, it's a live stunt show) and it was one of the highlights of the day. The other highlights were the number of characters out and about, there were considerably more than what we seen at both Disney parks and they were happy to pose for photos! Quite a few of the staff were able to speak broken English which we'd not experienced at either of the Disney parks so that was a bonus. There are plenty of places to eat and drink that are relatively cheap with lots of variety considering you're at a theme park with international appeal. There were only two rides that weren't running the day we went (one was closed for maintenance and the other had experienced technical difficulties earlier in the morning) and the crowds weren't chaotic like we were expecting. After a big day of fun, TGIF is the place to go for dinner which is just outside of the entrance of the park on the way back to the nearest train station!

The place is really cool, the place is more to teenagers rather than children, I went to Universal on 29 December, the place is packed with people, we are only able to play 2 games because of the crowd, one of the signature area in the park is Harry Potter, I recommend coming to the park in the morning around 8.15 then straightly go to Harry Potter because when people start to come the area will close and only people with pass (which you can take like a fast pass) can enter on a certain time, when there are little people you can enter without the pass, note that you can only get 1 pass for the whole day (exception when in the morning it doesn’t count, or rare chance 2 or with express ), our mistake is queuing for other ride instead of going into Harry Potter, so we used the pass in the morning, around 6pm we are not able to come back in again because we had used the ticket. In the Harry Potter world you could buy a wand (4900 yen) for the interactive ones, you could find the wands in Olivander’s, You could use the wands to perform spells around Wizard land by performing movements and chant, this experience is unique to this Universal, I had went to Hollywood and there is no Harry Potter land. The food here is Very Good, one of them serve burgers, you can even buy Butterbeer which you should totally try (I recommend the cold one (taste like A&W rootbeer with sweet cream above it), the hot one taste like cinnamon, which is only available on winter (I think), the parade here is boring and short, but on Christmas night they have an angel choir and it was really good, there is also a Christmas tree which earned a Guinness World Record, overall the experience was nice, but I recommend coming not on busy days such as end of December

We have been to numerous theme parks in the US, Australia and Europe and this has been the worst. Nothing could of prepared us for the hordes of people waiting at every ride, food outlet, toilet and gift shop. We decided to brave a wait and went to Harry Potter which said 140 min wait at 9:30 in the morning. After queuing for 40 mins we saw the guides letting random people through an express way. They then did this again further down. We were quite disappointed with the unfairness of this system. After this long wait we thought to get the express pass, but they were all sold out!  At 12pm we checked the queue line times again and saw that the majority of rides were at least 150min wait, with flying dinosaur being 220mins and Minions ride 240mins.  We decided to leave as our backs couldn’t take another queue for this exorbitant amount of time! I suggest don’t go unless buying an express pass before hand

We went on a Saturday so decided to get the VIP express pass. Definitely worth as it was packed with people. With the VIP express pass, we managed to try all the rides in the park. Otherwise we would need to wait average 90 mins for each ride. Our favourite was Harry Potter World, both of the rides were excellent.

The vibe inside universal studios Japan made you feel like going back to your childhood carefree days. I appreciated the fact that the staff are hospitable although they needed the work more on their English.  The highlight of the trip was of course, wizard ing world of Harry Potter. The forbidden journey ride was the best as well as sipping the cold and hot butter beer. Couldn’t ask for a better vacation reliving childhood.

Both myself and my partner thoroughly enjoyed oyr day at Universal Osaka. The rides were fun and the shows were pretty cool.  But you HAVE to be prepared. Express passes are a must otherwise youll be in line for 2 hours each ride at least. Yes its busy so if you hate crowds steer clear.  Otherwise the flying dinosaur was amazing. And so was the Hollywood Dream.
I have been here twice and will definitely come back here again and again. Too crowded but my family enjoyed the trip.

If you are going to Universal Studio Japan for the rides, you might want to consider buying the Fast Pass. Price is double the standard pass but you might get to enjoy all the rides. If you’re on standard pass the cued could get up to 180 min per rides.

Visiting Universal Studios JP is worth it just to visit Harry Potter World! OMG this place is magical. They did an AMAZING job portraying the shops, the restaurant, the castle, etc. The only downside to my experience, but it is very minimal- the characters talk in Japanese when you are inside the castle, so I couldn't understand anything. However, defintely go, get a cup of butter beer, choose your wand at Ollivanders, and most importantly- don't forget your Skip the Line Express Pass!
We were amazed at how clean everything was here considering the large crowd, and the fact that some rides had a two hour wait! Had lunch which was reasonably priced and quite good.

Universal Studios that I have been to: Singapore, Orlando, Osaka  Date Visited: 4 Jan 17 Official Time Park opens: 8:30am Time early ticket holders (ppl who buy special early entry pass entered): 7:30am Time that everyone gets let in if you are there early (no special ticket required): 7:50ish (i dont think that extra 20 mins lead time is worth the early entry pass)  MOST IMPT TIP THAT I LEARNED: COME AT LEAST 50-55 mins before official opening time. COME another 5-10 minutes earlier if you want to buy food outside.  From the station: once you leave the train, everyone will start running. We needed cardio too, so killed 2 birds with one stone and ran too. turn left after the gantry and keep running. you will pass Lawson on your right. run until you reach the gates (around 200 ms from lawson)  From gate to HP: once you are pass the gantry, this is a marathon. run until you reach the first cross section, if you see palm trees of your right, turn down that path and run. once you reach the end, turn right again. run another 50 metres. the entrance to harry potter land is a huge stone and you see forest behind it. run run run. you can always come back to take photos as they bar entry to HP at the very entrance of the enchanted forest. (i.e. you can come back to take photo of the Mr Weasley's car later on, without being worried that you are leaving HP land prematurely).  Useful tip: FOOD: I would recommend you get food from lawson on the way in. My friend and I first went to queue at the gates and then after knowing where we stood in the queue, he ran to buy food at Lawson. not much selection but still better than USS food. anywhere with the shortest queue is fine. note that the far left side is only for early entry pass (purchased).  IMPT (need to get timed ticket?) : if you get in before park opening hours, THERE IS NO NEED TO GET A TIMED TICKET. just run into harry potter land and run (dont stop) until u have reached the castle (you wont regret it). we waited for less than 5 mins for the castle and hippogriffs. and then went to get butter beer and after all that it was only 9am when the castle walk begins. and by 9am the queue for the 4D ride was already 150 mins and hippogriff was 100mins.  impt tip: we planned where to go first based on the uss website. they have a history of all the wait times for the day before. so that you have an accurate gauge of how long the queue times will be for the rest of the day. HP and Minions and Flying Dinosaur almost never drop below 100 mins after 9am.  details of the 4D ride: the queue starts outside, once you are inside, the queue continues until you reach lockers (which are free to store your luggage). The staff will give you a large card (hold on to it) deposit you bags (only small bags) my back pack almost couldnt fit. You wear your key around your wrist like at an onsen and you go through to the next queue by giving the staff your large card. once in, your ride is around 4 mins long.  My friend and I are avid fans of Harry Potter. Having gone to Orlando one before (back in 2012) it was magical and I was excited to see what Osaka's one is like. The main differences are Osaka now has a castle walk (back then to my knowledge Orlando did not have one) (not a bad castle walk as there was no wait at around 9-9:30am). You basically take an almost similar path to those waiting to enter the 4D ride. but you get closer to certain props. quite fun for no wait and little people. Unique to Osaka HP: There is also an interactive wand activity throughout harry potter land. you buy an interactive wand for 4900 yen (quite steep), and you go around the harry potter land to maybe around 10 - 12 spots, stand on them and perform your spell, and things like water will shoot out, fire will shoot out, wind will blow etc etc. it is quite cool but i was put off by the fact that i had to queue for these spots as well (not long though usually 5-10 mins at peak times) and this activity is mainly done by <6 year olds.  other differences is that the best roller coaster in orlando (in my opinion) is the dragon challenge that they did not have here. however, the experience is still magical and the politeness of the staff, much more than the other 2 USS, made it even better. staff even offered to take photos for us and handed us wands to take photos in the shop without asking.  other tips (butter beer) : there are 2 butter beer carts. the first one by the entrance has 2 lines. one in infront that has a long queue and the one behind that we always used had almost no queue. we tried both the hot and cold butter beer. the hot is slightly more expensive and is sweeter more smooth and has a cinnamon taste. the cold one is definitely better. perhaps it is winter but orlando had a slushie / iced version of butter beer, which in my opinion is still the nicest version till date.  impt tip (queue times) : download the USS jp app to see ride timings. the minion and flying dinosaur are consistently > 150 mins wait.  we did not bother to queue for any of them as our main priority was HP. no regrets running just for HP and we were out of the park by 3pm.  impt tip (tax rebate): if you want to claim tax rebate in USS. u have to spend >5000 yen (food and drinks not included) and USS takes a 1.1% commission of your 8% tax rebate. means you only get 6.9% back. if you still want to claim ur rebate there, please bring your passports and make sure u keep ur receipts and show all items when u claim. the area to claim is at studio gifts just before you leave the park on your left.

Universal studios was a bit of a let down for us. We were at Disneyland about a few days earlier and that seem more engaging and eventful. Saving grace was the Harry Potter World. Very excellent done. Wish the rest of the theme park was at that level as well.  The lines for certain ride was upwards of 2 hours. We had the fast pass but since Jaws was closed, we had to go to the backdraft which was really a waste of time.  Overall experience, love Harry Potter world and if you don’t have a fast pass for that, be prepare to wait in line for a very long time!
Like any theme park, it was fun. However everything is so pricey. Seems like they took advantage since it is a captured market.

It's our first time in a Universal Studios (we only get a glimpse in Singapore from the entrance). Really, we even had to choose between Disneyland and USJ taking account the limited time we had in Japan. In the end, its Harry and some monsters (Jaws, Minions and dinosaurs) who we want to encounter over Mickey and friends.  Also, you have to decide which type of tickets you need to buy. The Studio Pass already covers the use of all attractions inside the park. But bear in mind, there will be hundreds of people lining up in the same attraction where you are. So we also bought Express Passes (Express 4 for our family), a priority and timed tickets which cost you more than double.  But its all good. We proceeded first to Hogwarts Castle immediately upon opening of the park. It seems everybody go one direction only. Everyone wants to take the much ballyhooed Forbidden Journey. We even a hard time going thru the entrance for the Express Pass. The ride won't disappoint you of course.  If you love the film, sure it'll be one hell of a ride. The Jurassic Park was breathtaking particularly the end part while the Spiderman was smooth and amazing to say the least. The Jaws is somewhat of a letdown. There were too many kids in the Minions Park and the Waterworld is a live action-packed attraction that you must-see.
Don't ever miss this ride....this is absolutely 1 good reason to visit and endure the long line to have this ride....i can ride this several times and still be thrilled in the same way...

Let's face it Universal Studios is always a great place to visit but the location in Osaka was special. The Japanese people are so incredible. They are polite and just a pleasure to be around. The employees were so energetic, helpful and pleasant it makes the whole park just the best ever. If you have a chance to go, you have to do it.

Huge place. Better to pre-book your tickets online. Also don't forget to get the Express pass in advance to skip queues for the popular rides. Spent the whole day there; had a fantastic time. Good for both adults and children. Easy to get to from city area.

We went here when visiting Osaka. We bought the express pass 4 which included the Harry Potter area and rides around the park. We loved it. Great day, plan and budget to spend money on food cause you can't bring your own in, arrive early as lines start a good hour before opening and don't be worried when you see people running as soon as it opens. People love their Fast passes and will sprint through the park to get theirs. Overall a lovely day. Top rides for kids - minions, Harry Potter rides, and both the terminator and Spider-Man ones were cool. Adults will love the Jurassic park ride, jaws and the flying dinosaur!

We visited the Universal Studio during the school holidays. We studied the fast pass options which cost almost as much as the entry ticket but discovered that the fast pass were for rides that do not suit young children. So we did not choose those options.  As expected there were long queues for every ride. Most rides (even the ones in the young kids area) were at least 90-120 mins wait. Some rides have options for single riders where you wait 90 mins instead of 240 mins. So if you are willing to go as a single rider, that might be an option for you without having to purchase the fast pass.  Currently, the most popular areas are the Minion Park and the Harry Potter Castle. Even though we arrived before the park opens, the Minion Ride was already 240 mins wait when we made our way there. There are lots of other things to visit even if you do not go on rides. The Harry Potter Castle has a walking tour option and was one of the highlights and the fireworks shows at the end of the day. The Snoopy Centre is young children's favourite. The shops are spectacular and cafes are interestingly cute. There's a variety of popcorn flavours available. Our favourite was the salted caramel.  You will need to spend the whole day to fully appreciate the Universal Studio. There are also a number of restaurants and shops just outside where we had our dinner.

We had a great day at Universal Studios Japan while visiting Osaka! Out one major mistake however, buying our express pass in advance! I'm not entirely clear on how these passes are priced, but as we lined up at the gates and saw pass option after pass option sell out, we were definitely kicking ourselves and ended up having to pay the upper end of the range on posted rates we'd seen. Once we paid up and entered Universal however, we were incredibly grateful to be able to skip the lines - which averaged between one and two hours! The Harry Potter ride was fantastic as was the Backdrop Hollywood Dreams were a couple of our favourites! A fun day out in Osaka

The Harry Potter section was fantastic, less focus on rides which was great with small kids. Didn't go on many rides but there was enough diversity to keep the kids entertained. Food is okay, but a little expensive as expected. Merchandise while plentiful is also fairly expensive, also expected. Unexpected snow fall was kind of a bonus, made it a bit more special. Overall a good fun day out.

This place was very good to visit with family and have a lot of activity that good for young and old people. Have a lot of restaurant and bar. I suggest to come arly and que for the best game first if you don’t want to spend more money for fast pass.

We purchased a 7 XR Ride Fast Pass for Universal Studios because we wanted to go on the exclusive Cool Japan rides and get a timed pass for Harry Potter world. The Harry Potter world section only allows a certain amount of visitors in each time slot. You will see that first thing in the morning everyone will run to get a timed ticket for Harry Potter world.  I'd recommend getting there before it opens, as there are no queues once your inside. We managed to go on 80% of the rides before 10am.  Our two most favourite rides were the Evangelion XR Ride and the Spiderman ride.  You need to try the Turkey Leg in Jurrasic World when you go!

We went to USJ before Christmas on a weekday, and the line up wasn't too bad. We did buy tickets in advanced through travel agency as well as express pass (4 rides). I don't understand why at our age of digital transaction era that USJ does not offer online ticket purchase! This was hugely inconvenient! We arrived as the theme park opened, it was a cold Dec day, and that's probably another reason why the place is not as packed as we anticipated. We went first to the Minion Mayham ride, nicely done, the 4D experience was nice and not too overwhelming. Next ride we went to Spiderman, it was more fun than Minion Mayham, where the 4D effects were very realistic, with water, hot air and smoke, and all the villans were "in your face". We enjoyed this ride the most. We then went to Terminator 2, this was a big disappointment, the first 20 mins of standing in a hall with 1 girl acting out an entire scene which we had 0 idea what she was talking about because it's in Japanese! USJ, you have tons of foreign visitors, least you can do for these ride/shows is to offer some sort of translation, so we don't stand there and look silly. The T2 show was OK at best at the 2nd half where we actually get to sit and watch the limited 3D show. Last ride we went to was Space Fantasy ride, my friends and family enjoyed it, but becasue of the darkness any the constantly spinning of the ride, my face turned blue and had to sit for a good while to recover. If you have any kind of motion sickness, stay away from this ride.
