We found foods onsite plentiful but somewhat blend, and we heard that restaurants just outside of USJ gate were much better and cheaper. Stores are all the same as other theme parks all over the world, nothing really to write home about. We left around 6pm as it got pretty cold that day and kids were starting to whine, so we missed the firework, but then if you've been to Florida Disney or Universal Studios in other countries I can't imagine this would be much better. Overall, if you're looking for family fun with kids to spend a day when vacationing in Osaka, this is definitely a good place to allow kids to discharge their energy.

I visited USJ on a thursday in february, with cold and rainy weather. That meant that the park wasn't very crowded - no timed tickets needed and according to the info the longest queue during the day was about 90min. Using the singles-line I could often basically just walk straight onto less popular attractions like Jaws of Jurassic Park.  I can't go on 3D-rides or rollercoasters so I had to skip Forbidden Journey, but I enjoyed Hogsmeade and the castle walk a lot. The amount of detail is incredible! But of course everything is dubbed into Japanese, so the talking portraits and video snippets made no sense to me. Also, the merchandise in Hogsmeade is a bit pricey for what you get. And most of the stuff is for Gryffindor and Slytherin. I had lunch in Three Broomsticks. Again, a bit pricey, but good comfort food. And it's great that there is staff that will find you a table, because it gets pretty crowded.  The rest of the park is amazing too. I tried Jaws, which was pretty funny, and Jurassic Park, which was a great ride (although it would be even greater in warm weather). I also saw the Terminator-show, but didn't understand anything because it was in Japanese. A shame, because it seemed pretty cool. Maybe they could have one show a day that was in English, or at least with subtitles? I wanted to see the Shrek show too, but in the end I didn't bother because I wouldn't understand it anyway.  All in all a good experience, and the Potter-world was my favourite bit by far. But the experience could be improved by a little bit more English/subtitles here and there.

Had the best experience there.....he lines wherent that long but I paid and extra 3000yen and got the express pass...well worth it and they have a fantastic selection of rides and its a great atmosphere:)

Great park as you would expect from universal studios. But believe that without a fast-track/ express ticket it is impossible to enjoy all attractions due to waiting times from 60 up to 160 minutes ( we visited on saturday). With the expres ticket 7 you can do it all on one day. Great and enjoyful attractions. Just be mindfull that all are in Japanese language, except for despicable me (english subtitles). No problem in general but takes a little of the fun away unless you like a Japanese Talking terminator... 😜

This happened to be my second universal studios ive visited. First being Singapore. While the trip was pre planned, I did not anticipate that cool Japan would be in during my visit as well.  This time round was monster hunter and final fantasy. Sailor moon nor Conan does not appeal to me so I'll skip it. I went for the adventure for monster hunter. Honestly it was meh, I expected more. it was a simulation of you holding four different types of weapon naming great sword, long sword, heavy bowgun and Lance. Photos and a special event code for ps4 monster hunter will be provided after the event. It was more of a posing shots photoshoot rather than a ride or some sort.  Next on would be final fantasy XR. While I did not manage to take the ride I'm certain it would be a kill for all final fantasy fans. You will be on a mog ship going through the VR with all the characters from final fantasy appearing. Waiting time was around 120 minutes on a quiet day like Wednesday. Do note that no belongings can be brought into the ride, 100 yen is required for you to deposit your items in the locker beside.  Merchandise for monster hunter and final fantasy: I would say a hit for all fans. Something worth getting.  Harry Potter castle You may find it hard to believe but I only just finished watching Harry Potter in Dec 2017. Just so happen I was going to go on a honeymoon trip to Osaka and there lies Harry Potter as one of the main attraction in USJ. Everything was fresh in my mind. Weasleys car in the wood, mandrake, Hogwarts express, butter beer, lumos etc etc. This is a must visit for all Harry Potter fans. Merchandise are so nice, especially this mug which I regretted not getting. It cost 3000 yen and it's brickish design. Ah yes the ride for Harry Potter. Due to the shortage of time I only took the 3d ride. Oh boy was it fun. 2 hours waiting time seemed to be the norm and I certainly enjoyed it. It features the snitch game and some flying through here and there. Not recommended for people with weak stomach or hearts.  Food in USJ Overall I would probably rate it 2.5/5..  Finnegan's bar and grill with 4 given to Finnegan's bar and grill. I had the winter special and fish and chips. They were decent for me and that was the best I had. Winter time meant that I had more meals.  Special meat by monster hunter I assumed that it's turkey leg given the size and texture.. it was tough and the taste just .. gets worse with every bite. I didn't finished it and it cost 1890 which is almost what I had at Finnegan's. This is a 1.5 for me  Three broomsticks I ordered the pork ribs and chicken platter with butter beer and lemonade. Pork ribs tasted wild with a strong pork taste not to my liking. Chicken was dry.. the only saving grace for the platter? The potatoes.. lemonade was decent, what can go wrong with it. My wife had the butter beer, she likes it and described it tasting like root beer with a faint tinge of butter.  Overall  I would love to visit USJ again. A day just isn't enough to complete all the attractions. Probably along with an express pass you may be able to do so. I too listened to some online guides to visit USJ on Wednesday but still I only took three rides in total. If you like most of the attractions please cater at least two days to complete them all.  Note: based on my encounter, all explanation are done in Japanese. So if you are like me just say no Japanese and they will do their best to explain in basic English for some matters. Enjoy!!

I spent time there in a cold day of January. Threre were long queue even just to enter. I get to ride most of the atttactions without buying Fast Pass. The food is not that expensive and all meals I had there are superb. Flying dinosaur is one of the best ride for me so far. Harry Potter and Minion area are the best places for photos and will give you good vibes and energy

The attractions are 75% for kids. But even adults will love it! Staff are nice, friendly and helpful. The toilets are always clean until closing time. Loved the Wizarding World of Harry Potter. Didn’t appreciate the Backdraft attraction, they should improve on it.

USJ is a busy place. We went on a Friday outside of the holiday period and it was packed. I'd strongly suggest an express pass in order to beat the queues or for some rides, if you're happy to travel as a single, you will have a much shorter wait time. Highlights were Spiderman and Harry Potter.

Having been to the Orlando location, I knew what to expect. This park is much smaller but the crowds are just as big. The Harry Potter ride was excellent but the lines were so long that it was not possible to do all the park's rides in the time we were there. Most rides had waits of 1 hour or more. Especially frustrating is that the shows were all done in Japanese so that if you did not understand Japanese then you had no idea what was happening. Perhaps shows could have English subtitles? The one show at Harry Potter world at Ollivanders was great because the wizard spoke both Japanese and English and blended both together seamlessly. Interesting experience but would not recommend going if you don't speak Japanese.

The park is good . But beware that is full of people . I recommend to buy the express pass for the attractions you want . There are still old attractions inside the park that might not be impressive .

The Wizarding World of Harry Potter really makes this place that much better. Without it, I would have been unimpressed. 3D rides are everywhere, which is disappointing for those of us who don't like them. Skip backdraft, it is a massive waste of time. Hollywood dream was great!
its summer, and usj is full with people from around the region. if u wanna have a good time, better not to visit in summer

The place was very crowded especially the new Minion facility. However, the park was overall fun. You can also buy fast pass for the rides and attractions that you want to play, the fast pass are also attraction specifics so you need to be careful before buying them. The Harry Potter World was amazing, the rides and the Butter beer is great. If you dont have a fast pass I suggest you go line up for Harry Potter for the first few rides of yours because there are going to be a lot of people there.

Visited 2 times and was always surprised with the long queues the Japanese people wait in line.. they have so much patience because they are so disciplined and controlled. Very good examples. I am awed. The students who went there also dressed themselves up as the characters and u end up buying some character souvenirs because somehow the atmosphere just intrigues you to buy. No regrets

It’s very enjoyable especially the temporary ride of Final Fantasy! Luckily I bought the express pass otherwise you have to wait around 170 mins average.  I do enjoy the atmosphere here. Feels like mini version of Orlando.

Despite the long queues for rides ,it's worth it to stay in for the ride. I dropped my 3D glasses early on during one of the rides and couldn't experience like I hoped. I mentioned it to the staff and they gave me another turn. Exceptional service-without leaving me hanging!.

I have been to Universal Studio in different countries but USJ is one of my favorite. It is clean and all the staff are very friendly. I went there on Monday but still a lot of people. If you want to visit every attraction, you need to buy an express pass. USJ’s most thrilling and popular coaster is “The Flying Dinosaur” it took almost 2.5 hours to get on the ride. Another recommended attraction is The Harry Potter and the Forbidden Journey ride which is one of the main attractions at USJ. It’s a 3D thrilling ride that takes you traveling through the Hogwarts castle. It’s fun and enjoyable. The line was long but it was worth it. However what I enjoyed the most was Minion Land. I’m a fan of minion. There is a 4D ride which took only about 60 mins to get on a ride. It is an fantastic place to enjoy your time with friends and families. Ps. Most of the staffs do not really speak English but some of them can.

1. 90% of the crews working there barely speak English  2. Some attractions are only in Japanese. Come on, Japan. You know that anime is famous all over the world. You made the world fall in love with manga and anime. Can't you do better once those lovers come all the way to Japan to savor the fruits of your culture??  3. Yes, many of the crews were friendly, despite their limited English. However, some WERE vicious and probably RACIST. There were younger Japanese kids ahead of us, some of them being toddlers, some spending more than 10 minutes to perform the moves, and the employee was there guiding them patiently teaching them to move the wand. When it was my daughter's turn, she spent 1:47 minutes unsuccessfully, and yet the employee hurriedly told her to STEP ASIDE, giving way to the rest of the queue. My visit was on March 17th 2018 on 17:32, in case anyone from the management is paying attention to this and would like to disciple the employee accordingly. As it was my partner and I travelling we found this park was superior to Disneyland as it accounted a lot more to older people whereas Disneyland is very child orientated. Arrive early as it is extremely busy. We did not purchase any fast passes but the waiting time on the queues were upwards of 2hrs. This is a definite must do when in Japan!

Arrived around 10am and took us almost an hour looking for a coin locker, most of them were full already when we arrived. Better go super early like 8:30am and buy an advance ticket so you don’t have to lineup for the ticket. It was really fun, though we had to lineup for more than 2hrs for the flying dino. Harry Potter was the best one 👌
Went there to see harry potter village, everything is crowded, long lines for every attraction 2 hours. Dont go unless you want to wast your time and 150$

If you're a Harry Potter fan you can't miss this; it's amazing. The rest of the park is really good too. Express passes are definitely worth the extra money, the longest we had to wait was 15 minutes,even the single riders for the same ride were still waiting for 70 minutes. And this was on a Wednesday too.

Let's just say it, it is EXPENSIVE and worth it. Most impressive was Harry Potter. Lived up to all expectations. The only problem was the queues...very very very long. Still, you will just have to deal with it as part of the fun. Go, enjoy and just forget the cost...

Universal studios Harry Potter area is so nice. Enjoyed the rides. The Christmas tree is huge and enjoyed the Christmas show and the lights at night time. Since my youngest daughter is a Harry Potter fan, she was so happy to be in the park. We paid extra to get the special pass to skip the lines and it was so worth it.

It’s a fun theme park, it was raining all day when we were there but the it was still packed. The highlight of the day was HP Forbidden Journey for sure. The queue was 240 minutes for 3-4 minutes ride I think :( Me and my daughter.?? With the express pass we just walked along and got to the ride in 10 minutes. Buy the express pass, you won’t regret it. I read on someone’s blog to avoid coming to USJ on Monday because there will be lots of school groups coming and it’s true. We were there on Monday and students in uniform are everywhere.

It's a complete money rip off. We went there when there's a special collaboration with sailor moon, conan, and final fantasy. With the new minion park and new place with wizardly world of Harry potter, we did expect a large number of crowd and queue. But we didn't expect that most of them are express pass only, which means double the cost. So aside from entry pass, the express pass is almost as the entry pass. It's ridiculous. Seems like the park doesn't want to missed a chance to get more money from customer and did this. They could limit the number of people entering, but nooo they force people to pay more to enjoy what should've been customer right to enjoy the whole park within the entrance fee. Going in most park and area need reservation and it's crazy. Yes we did understand everyone excitement in the harry potter world hence they add almost a kilometer queue just to go into the area but this is too much as to get in the castle need express pass. So do come back in a few years when the park already get thei sanity back and doesn't force people to purchase express pass. And most of the ride doesn't have single ride anymore. If you come here this month, do see 180 queue on EVERY RIDE, or express pass only. Ridiculous. Better go to disneyland tokyo or disney sea, worth so much more.

Do not - I repeat, DO NOT - even think of going to USJ unless you purchase one of the express pass ticket options. Without an express pass, be prepared to wait in line at least two hours, and sometimes up to 3 hours to get into the popular rides. Yes, the Express Pass tickets will double (or triple) your cost of entry – but the extra cost will go a long ways towards ensuring you really enjoy your trip. If you'd rather not pay the extra cost, I almost suggest not going at all, as I think it will almost impossible to really enjoy the day unless you like spending 2+ hours in line per ride (especially with kids!).  We went on a Monday in early April, and the place was - as expected - packed, but reasonably manageable. Two small kids, ages 6 and 8. My 8-year old son and I wanted to do some of the 'scarier' rides, mom and my 6-year old daughter weren't interested. So we bought two Express Pass four-ride tickets, picking two of the main rides we wanted to do most (Flying Dinosaur and Final Fantasy) plus two rides out of a choice of six (ended up doing Spider-Man and Terminator). This ended up working out beautifully as we didn't wait at all to go into these rides which had lines of 220+ minutes when we rode them.  Some tips:  Get to the park at least an hour or so before official opening time. At the open, run and get in line for one of the rides that isn’t part of your Express Pass package. I’d recommend the Harry Potter ride, as the whole Harry Potter area gets so crowded they start restricting access into the area. I think you can get a Fast Track (reserve a time slot to get in) as well, but we didn’t use one so can’t be 100% sure.  Some of the less popular rides have almost no lines early on - we did Jaws twice and the Flight of the Hippogriff within the first hour (my son is a huge Jaws / shark fan); waiting time of less than 15 minutes each. After an hour or so the waiting time was 60-80 minutes, and then -really- got long.  I think all the rides in the Snoopy area have 'Fast Track' ticket options where you can reserve tickets for a specific time and line up through the Express lane. This is a fantastic option if you have younger kids. We’d get tickets for roughly an hour or so out, then ride a separate Snoopy area ride or watch a show, then use the Fast Track tickets, then quick go get another set of Fast Track tickets for another ride.  The Final Fantasy area has lockers, technically for use for people riding on the Final Fantasy attraction, but – well…well, lockers are lockers, and they’re free (cost 100 yen, but you get the coin back).  A lot of the lines get pretty short near the end of the day. We did Spider Man and Jaws (again!) in the last hour of the park closing. Jaws at night was actually great fun, highly recommended.  Altogether, my son and I went on 15 rides and my wife and daughter went on 12 rides – not by any great planning on our part, just lucky in that we got to the park early and stayed late, bought the four-ride Express pass, and made full use of the Fast Track tickets for the Snoopy area rides.  There is a USJ app for your smartphone that you can use while at the park with reasonably up-to-date waiting times and such. We used this a lot.  The entire park is not that big – you can walk from one end to the other in maybe 15-20 minutes, tops. I recommend setting an easy-to-find spot as a ‘if you get lost go here’ spot; maybe the big shark in front of the Jaws ride or Mels’ Drive-in.  In terms of rides: Flying Dinosaur is amazing and terrifying. Final Fantasy was great fun, as was Spider Man. Flight of the Hippogriff was ridiculously short; would not recommend unless wait times are under 20 minutes. Terminator was more a 2-3 and 3-D show, humorous in spots if you know Japanese, but I doubt we’d go it again. Ditto Backdraft and Jaws (we ended up going on the Jaws ride three times (!) because of my son, so it was definitely worth it in our case…) Snoopy’s Great Race was a fun little roller coaster ride, and actually all the Snoopy / Elmo rides were great.  Food is expensive but about what you’d expect at an amusement park.  The park itself is immaculate and everyone is extremely friendly.  TL;DR: you’ll enjoy your day if you spend a bit of money.

I visited USJ with my wife and children (daughter 13 & son 9), I pre bought the tickets via the Klook website which was simple enough.  My son has ADHD so we were able to get a guest support pass which allows the user and family to reserve a place at the chosen ride, the reservation will be calculated by using the current time + current queue time. The only problem with this is that only 1 reservation can be made at a time, which is good as there is no queuing which any parent with a child that has ADHD knows is very difficult time, but bad as you can’t book in a number rides in advanced so you will still only be able to go on a handful of rides with plenty of time to do other things whilst waiting for the time slot.  In hindsight I wish that i had purchased the express passes as every ride had on average a 2 hour queue or wait and even the single rider queue wasn’t much quicker.  All in all we had a fab day, the staff are very friendly and the place is exceptionally lean and tidy.

You definitely need to get a priority (express) pass before you go. The crowds are legendary and places like Harry Potter World had a three hour long queue. The express pass cuts this down but you still queue for some time. There is still length to see and do (my grandson spent ages in an indoor area where they had large balloons fir the kids to hit in the air and chase). We went early in the misguided assumption that no one else would. Didn’t work. Getting food between 11.30 and 2 p.m. was a trial but after that all stalls became accessible. The Amity village (Jaws) was the quietest place and food easier to get. There are plenty of clean toilets and lots of rest areas. The roller coaster looked to be spectacular, but again, the queue was humongous. An interesting way to spend 5 to 6 hours for a family.

we booked our tickets via a preferred 3rd-party ticket site for USJ VIP tickets (which we were led to believe would allow us into the park at least 30 mins to 1 hour before it opens) and from there, we had planned (following the suggestions of a travel blog) to be very specific and hit the big rides before the line starts.  unfortunately for us, USJ opened OUR doors the same time as they opened the main gates. worse of all, they let KIDS (school groups i think) in FIRST!!! so imagine our disappointment when we finally were let out of the holding room (it was on the side of the main gates); we were literally running helter skelter with EVERYONE ELSE!  not a good start!  in the end, the main ride i wanted to go on was the Harry Potter, and it had technical difficulties (but we were not informed until after 1 hour of lining up). what a WASTE OF TIME!! they gave us an express pass to use at any other ride, but express pass does not mean you jump the queue, it just means you wait slightly less. After we left Harry Potter World, where we spent about 2 hours, the rides around USJ were a minimum of 240 minutes.. SIGHHHHHHH  we paid extra for VIP tickets; i would have just gotten to USJ super early and waited at the main gates like everyone else. it made no difference.
More than 100 minutes wait for several of the rides - good that I had a book to read. We will probably skip this next time we visit Osaka.

The rides were great at the park, definitely more thrilling rides than Disneyland. The staff were always happy and friendly. However, wait times would’ve been crazy if we didn’t have an express pass. Thoroughly enjoy the day, just wondering around to see different parts of the park is fun, just to see how much detail they put into each place. A great but expensive experience!

I went with high hopes as have thoroughly enjoyed the US parks however the biggest problem is that it’s all in Japanese with no English subtitles! It was really hard going to Terminator,Spider-Man, Jaws and Backdraft rides/experiences not knowing what on earth was going on! I thought they could have issued headphones to non English speakers but nothing!  We bought the Fast-pass for 4 rides which didn’t really work for us as we only needed one for Harry Potter and The Forbidden Journey and Spider-Man because the Terminator/Backdraft and Jaws rides had hardly any queues. We couldn’t be bothered to wait until the 6pm slot we had booked for the Minions as it seemed a bit childlike and was pouring with rain.  If you’re into thrill rides you need to buy the Fast-pass for the Flying Dinosaur, Flight of the Hippogriff, Hollywood Dream otherwise you are looking at wait times between 60-100 mins.  The highlight for me was Harry Potter world and seeing Hogwarts and Hogsmead being recreated, magical.

It becomes expensive because you’ll need to get express pass which is even more expensive than your entrance ticket. If you don’t get it, you’ll end up wasting time in line. Make sure your kids know and have watched Harry Potter so they’d appreciate the world of Harry Potter more. Younger kids below 4ft, DO NOT get them express pass, not worth it. They can’t go on the rides anyway. If you know someone with the special wand, borrow it.  Bring a raincoat or umbrella. Make sure you go get your timed entries for the rides to plan out your day. Look for timed entries before lining up.  Overall great I’d experience.

if you are looking for fun full day, there is no good option in Japan other than Universal studios at Osaka. For 7900¥ for one day and 13,400¥ for 2 days you can play the Quidditch game with Harry in Hogwarts, plunge into an adorable world of Minion mayhem!, Encounter a new dimension of excitement with Spider man, Then a 25.9 meter headlong drop to escape the lost world!, 360 degrees view through the grab of The Flying Dinosaur and go up and down with no so conventional roller coasters - the ride and the backdrop! Please note, if you are visiting USJ during Japan national holiday season, please take express ticket to beat the 2-3 hour long queues or plan to get 2 day pass.

We came here on 9th April 2018 and had a great day! The Jurassic Park ride called the Flight of the Dinosaur was THE best ride on the day. I liked hanging out in the Harry Potter and Hogwarts area but the food prices at the three broomsticks was crazy expensive and the butter beer tastes like melted fairy floss! Pure sugar high. For someone who hates sugar drinks I had to throw it away unfortunately but I did keep the mug it came in as a memento. Universal studios never disappoints. I’ve been fit he one in Orlando as well and this one was just as good 👍🏼 Even though all the rides are in Japenese, it’s still a great day!

This place is huge! The entire park smells like caramel. Their wizarding world of Harry Potter is excellent, albeit crowded - but that is like most theme parks. I found the attention to detail found in the Harry Potter world didn’t really correlate to the rest of the park, and there was some great things they perhaps should emphasise on more, such as the 4D Amazing Spider-Man ride which we only found by accident. Louie’s was a great place to eat 👌. Overall glad to tick it off my to do list!

The only thing disappointed me in Japan was USJ. There are only 6 - 7 main attractions. And the crowd is massive, which means the line for each ride is 3 hours waiting time. The only reason I went there was because of The Wizarding World of Harry Potter. The park is made very well. And everything is overpriced. But if you don't have option or don't mind the line, then go for it. Or else buy the express pass.

Crowds, crowds and crowds but the experience is well worth the long waits at most spots. Compact enough not to wear one out between areas and yet big enough to accommodate all the important rides .... and the Harry Porter venue.  Do the home work as early as possible, get an Express Pass at extra price or work out a strategy for tackling the long lines.  One minus point is perhaps the language. With so many foreign visitors from all over the world congregating at this theme park, more English usage (or subtitles) is justified especially for shows like Backdraft.

Harry Potter studio was my main destination on this place. All rides and characters in it speak in Japanese languange and unfortunately it didn't provided with English subtitles (at least) but we enjoy this place tho'

Universal Studios Japan is a great place to spend the day but make sure you buy an Express Pass during the busy season to avoid long waiting times for the rides. Waiting times can go up to 2 hours for the busy rides sometimes if you don't have an Express Pass Although some of the rides are old like Jaws & Backdraft & Terminator - the highlights for me were Harry Potter World, The Flying Dinosaur, The Hollywood Dream, The Minions ride & the VR rides in the Cool Japan section. Rides like the Flying Dinosaur & the Hollywood Dream are not for the faint-hearted.

Definitely a highlight of my visit to Osaka. While many shows are only in Japanese, there is plenty to see and experience. The queues can get long so keep and eye on their app and make a whole day of it. Waiting times get shorter in the evening and the newest attraction Harry Potter is open for non-ticket entrance first thing in the morning. The most challenging part of such a crowded attraction are the restaurants. Mealtimes will be busy but show up a bit early and there will be plenty of tables and less people on the rides later on. Compared to other theme parks in the Asia-Pacific region, the restaurants offer a good range of foods for different dietary restrictions including vegetarian and gluten-free.

MUST BUY FAST PASS if you plan to take a few rides. The day i went, all queues was about 130 minutes long, and they say on crowded days it can get to 300 minutes. But i still didnt get to ride that many rides (regret for not buying fast passes).
Great place to have fun but the queues were long. Also, you will not have an option for food if you are a vegetarian as ALL of them were for non-vegetarians.

It’s great fun amusement park. Some tips from my side: 1. Make plan to go form Monday until Thursday then u won’t find more than 25-30 min que at most rides and no need to pay more money to buy express entry pass. It is wise to buy ticket online. 2. Complete Harry Potter at first. For this at least reach there by 8.45 am so that you can enjoy it in early morning and with least que. They can stop entry at Harry Potter side if they feel heavy crowd for normal tickets. They just fixed Harry Potter world in March so now you can experience 4D without any glasses. 3. Take a map at entry area and after Harry Potter take a map and complete rides as per your priorities. 4. Even if you don’t speak Japanese or don’t understand it won’t gonna ruin your day coz hey we all see movies and we gonna enjoy their world which we already saw. Language is not barrier to understand what is going on. 5. Check their site before book tickets that what rides are closed. At my visit they have closed water world and some other rides to fix them.  My experience was great at this place. All people greeted me with smile. Locker at all the places are free to keep your belongings before rides. All Japanese are always up for your help to guide you. Harry Potter and spider man is must go. Minions word is so cute with fun for children and in evening clicking pics feels u like u r really into Hogwarts. Visit in weekdays will not only save your time but also enables you to complete almost whole park in a day.

Went during Halloween and that was the best decision I've made. Brought both my parents and they couldn't go for a lot of the rides but they enjoyed the Halloween entertainment there.  They have a single rider queue that moves really fast. I suggest going for that if you're indifferent about going for rides on your own.
If your a fan of harry potter! No question ask just do it !!! Its an amazing experience you wont regret it

I went here, Disneyland and DisneySea and probably had the most fun here. The Sesame Street themed area is really great for little kids. Be aware that some rides may be too much for some kids even if they meet the height requirements. There are plenty of dining options, including a big centre outside the gates.

We went to Universal Studios specially to visit the wizarding world of Harry Potter. It did not disappoint. Had great fun in that area of the park and also explored other areas like Minion Park where we went on some more rides. Great for families. Was a fantastic day out!

It was good to finally make it to the Japan Universal Studios ! As fun and amazing as it looks the crowd and long queues for each game to try was hectic and sometimes you just need to skip so you don’t waste time in the lines. I had the chance to try one game in Harry Potter section and it was worth the wait , the rest I just skipped so am having more time to enjoy other open shows and shops , food .. etc

This was my first experience of Universal Studios and I fully enjoyed it despite the bad rainy weather. This however reduced the queuing times at each attraction.  We purchased the fast passes which we felt ultimately we didn’t need as the queues weren’t too bad. So we eventually went back and rode the best rides again.  They currently have the Cool Japan theme running but for a limited time which involves attractions based on some of the best selling anime/games from Japan e.g. Sailor Moon and Final Fantasy.  The final fantasy 4D attraction was among the best rides there and highly suggest catching this whilst it’s there.  Rollercoasters include the Hollywood Dream and the Jurassic Park - Flying dinosaur. Which was both brilliant and we went back for a second ride!  My only critique are the restaurants and food options. We went for the Jurassic Park themed restaurant and the food option was very limited which was disappointing. The sailor moon cafe however offered a very delicious pineapple and pistachio cake!  Overall a very good park but would be busy during the peak season. So consider getting the fast passes to maximise your day there.

We went to the park for two days in May on a Tuesday and Wednesday. Was glad that we didn't pay extra for the Express pass. There was no need for it on the days we visited. The longest line in the park was for Backdrop, we chose both days to ride it first and avoided a long line.  We expected long lines for Harry potter; however we rode the ride twice and only waited 15 minutes each time.  The food in the park is over priced and not very good. Citywalk is loaded with great restaurant's however your not allowed to leave the park.  The opening time was 9 am. We arrived around 8:15 both days and noticed that they have an early entry at 8:30 (if you buy your tickets from select vendors offering an early entry package like Klook offers) at about 8:35 that entrance is closed and early entry people go through an area around guest relations. at 8:45 am both days the main gates were opened to the general public.  Try and visit the park on Tuesday, Wednesday or Thursday to avoid the giant crowds and the need to Express pass. Also make sure you arrive 30 minutes before the scheduled opening time.

It was our first new year countdown . It was alot of fun especially during the countdown there were fireworks, lights, music and everybody greeting each other happy new year. We also enjoyed the rides, the foods , shows especially the minions . We loved it so much .

Avoid going during golden week in Japan. Queues starting from 70mins. Get an express pass if you are going during the golden week which is in early may. No outside food allowed. Nearest halal eatery is at red lobster just outside the park.

Recommended attraction : Harry Potter, Minion (YES! even if you're adult), Hollywood Dream/Backdrop, Jurassic Park, JAWS and the craziest MUST ride are The Flying Dinosaur. Least Recommended : The Terminator. Only go if you know Japanese or else you'll find it a bit boring because they talk so much. Try every food sold there they were super good especially their churros! Don't forgot to take the english maps before you enter the gate (if not available ask for it) because once you enter there will be maps in Japanese only

My second time at USJ was even better than the first!!! It was so much fun!! The rides are intense and amazing. Harry Potter 4D, Minion Mayhem and the Final Fantasy were the best rides I have ever done. We did HP twice for its sheer magnificence. The park itself is stunning, well shaded, plenty to do and great food options. I would love to come here again the next time I'm in Japan!!!!

Even though we had a problem entering due to having an ticket purchased prior to coming to Japan it was still a fun filled day. We could have spent more time at the studios. We all enjoyed the young children area with the ball pit and huge balloons.

These are two reviews: of the park itself, and of the Harry Potter exhibit.  The Forbidden Journey HP ride was absolutely incredible! I can fully understand why it was voted as the best ride in the whole world for 5 consecutive years. We were waiting for 2 hours and it was worth every minute!  There is a whole Hogsmeade village filled with various shops - we had a great time strolling around the place.  You can eat a lunch in the Three Broomsticks inn - the building is just like from the movie, and the food was perfect - we had pork ribs, fish&chips and some really good beer.  The whole Harry Potter part of the park is huge, with Howarts model the size of a large building, as the main ride is inside.  As for the PARK itself, its horribly crowded, and an unpleasant experience. If you are a HP fan, just avoid any other parts, or you will be very disappointed.

Think of a small, compact version of the Florida Universal Studios Theme Park but one thing they’re not, is small on fun. This place still has all the excitement brought on by the major rides like the Hollywood Dream and Backdrop, Jaws, Harry Potter, SpiderMan and Jurassic Park. The weather in Osaka was cool and not as sweltering as the Florida and Singapore versions. There was definitely something for all kids af all ages.

Visited USJ in October. The hotel advised us to come earlier to avoid the queue. Though we were an hour before it was opened, there were already long queue at the entrance. As the gates opened, we went to the star attraction, Harry Potter! Queue for the ride for about close to an hour and it was worth the wait! Do note, everything spoken was in Japanese. The ride faced technical difficulties halfway through but we had a chance to experienced another round. Other rides with USJ were as good but you need to have lots of patience queuing. Overall an awesome experience. Do look at the weather forecast before visiting as it was hot and humid back then.

The Universal Studios experience is always one to look forward to. It's like entering a different world for a day and letting go of all inhibitions. Highlight was definitely Harry Potter and I got myself a wand too! Perhaps I went during peak period and most of the rides have waiting time not shorter than 60mins. So if you're planning on taking the rides, I suggest that you buy the express pass. Otherwise for my sister and I, we just enjoyed our time watching and walking around the parks, soaking in the atmosphere and eating! One thing to note for American Express card holders, they DO NOT accept AMEX anywhere in the park apparently despite accepting other major credit cards. But that aside, USJ is definitely not to be missed, for the young, the young at heart, and basically everyone!

This park is amazing as it has lots of great Universal "traditional" attractions and some Japanese limited attractions too. These Cool Japan attractions change every year and are really interesting (we participated in a Detective Conan themed escape room, for example).  To fight the crowds that plague the park almost every day there is only an effective solution: Buy tickets + the two different fast passes in advance. For us the price was worth it and we spent one of the best days of our three weeks trip to Japan at Universal. Highly recommended.

Made it to the park on a rainy Wednesday which is probably ideal for avoiding crowds (which is apparently a big problem at this park). The good news is that the rain/mid-week successfully kept many people away. The bad news is that this meant many line closures, in addition to many things already closed in the park.  Pros: Flying dinosaur, Hollywood dream coaster and Harry Potter are all top-notch attractions. Lots of cute decorated food and dining options inside and outside the park. The whole place is very well decorated with solid theming throughout. Mid-week/rain can help you skip the crowds if you get there early and time things right (we had around 30 min each for HP Forbidden Journey, dream coaster and flying dinosaur—slightly longer for Jaws. Walk on for Spider-Man. Didn’t even need single rider for those. SR for Final Fantasy was a walk-on. There were never timed tickets to enter HP land because it never got that busy).  Cons: rain means ride and show closures. Flying dinosaur and Hollywood dream were closed periodically throughout the day (including at opening) so you had to get very lucky with timing. Waterworld show was delayed for 15-20 min for weather and then cancelled halfway through the show. A bit of a bummer since there are only 2 show times for that one. Also, Jurassic Park was closed long-term (for several weeks), so that meant that 3-4 big attractions were closed throughout the day, as were several food stalls.  On the bright side, the park is small and easy to navigate so if you pay attention you can do well (you can see if the coasters—Flying Dino and Hollywood—are running and then head over to them ASAP from wherever you are if they’ve been closed). Naturally, bad weather is not the park’s fault, but I think adding a few more indoor rides (like Mummy or Transformers from Singapore, Gringots from Florida, or keeping open Jurassic Park) would help to ensure a more even experience. That said, we got lucky and didn’t miss anything because of weather (just JP because of the long-term closure).  The staff are also extremely friendly and helpful (one staff member even got a ladder to retrieve something for me from a display in a store when we couldn’t find that item elsewhere). We started out at HP after finding the coasters closed and were able to even go back a second time later that day. Also, note that they sell HP merchandise near the entrance/exit and it was less crowded there than in the HP speciality stores. One other thing: most things are in Japanese but most useful instructions are available or displayed in English if you look. If you are a big fan of the Backdraft special effects show then feel free to go but note that there are around 15 minutes of dubbed (in Japanese) videos during which you have to stand. That’s really the only attraction I found skippable for the non-Japanese speaker.  So on the whole a very worthwhile visit. Mid-week and bad weather came with fewer crowds but more closures so pick your poison (personally I preferred it this way). I found this park more visually appealing than Singapore but with fewer high-level attractions (especially with Jurassic Park closed) than that one or Florida. Nonetheless a very fun place to visit especially if you can get lucky with rides like we did and don’t mind stomping around completely soaked.
I love this. good food good service. I'm happy every time when I go to japan . I want to go back again and again .

I chose the wrong day to get my Express Pass (got a month in advance and weather forecast wasn't out. You have to choose a specific date when you make your purchase). It rained the whole day so some rides were closed.  On a side note, I would suggest to go on a Wednesday or Thursday when it's less crowded. Also, strongly recommend you get an Express Pass as there's basically no wait time. It gives you timed entrance to Harry Potter, so you do that to get tickets.  The merchandise was really expensive so didn't really buy much except at Harry Potter area. Remember to try the Butter Beer!

We had a great time at the park but as you would have read somewhere already, the line is crazy! We ended getting an Express Pass 4 (which I think saved us about 3-4 hours in the line in total, and it wasn't even peak period). Unless you're prepared to be the first one there and last to leave (which is when the line is shorter) and willing to spend a lot of the middle of the day in line, I'd recommend paying for it (which will make the day a little bit expensive).  Make sure you have a plan (eg study the map) and be smart about which attraction to do first (eg save the theatre shows - Sailor Moon, Terminator, Backdraft etc for when it's busy because they have huge capacity for each show so the wait will be less)  Oh and take a motion sickness tablet before you set out for the day. We didn't but would have been handy to have thought about it!!

We went here for the day prior to catching the plane to Australia, although it is expensive it was a great way to spend the day. If you like the rides buy an express ticket as it will save you hours of queuing, the minimum wait time for any ride was 90 minuets with out the express ticket.

Park is great, have many ride but everything is in japanese so you only got the ride without story if you don't understand japanese. Harry porter area is very nice, but harry porter ride also in japanese. Like the butter bear you must try. Harry porter wand is too expesive 5k jpy. One thing that I like that they have solo line for queu the ride so if you solo you will ride faster.

Having experienced Universal Studios in Hollywood, I was excited to visit Japan’s not only to bring my family, but to compare the two.  And the winner is....drrrummmmmroll....I love Universal in Osaka Japan!  I’m not certain of the exact size, but I feel like the one in Japan is bigger. In addition, the facilities are extremely clean!  Spider-Man, Dispicable me, Jurassic Park, back-drop, and Harry Potter world is a must!

For first timer, must get an express pass for Flying Dinosaur and The forbidden journey which are 2 of the popular rides besides Backdrop. Took The Ride with single rider lane in less than 10 minutes. A much bigger theme park compared to USS. Crews are all cheerful and kind. My favourite park would be The Wizarding World of Harry Potter though :)

To get there, go to Osaka Station and change the line to Nishujio stn. Switch to tue platform that is going to Universal city station. If you r buying the express pass online, dont forget yiu will need to buy the entrance pass as well. The q wasnt that lomg as compared to Disney. Express passis worth ur while if u dont like long lines. The most interesting and impressuve section was the Harry Porter attraction. Its a whole town made exactly from the Harry Porter Movie. The book shop, wizard shop and what have you. Basically theres 2 rides, the forbudden journey which is a 4d ride. Not too bad. The other ride is the roller coaster ride where u will be inverted for some parts. So beware. Other attractions werent really much fun. Minons attraction had another 4D ride. Disappointing were the souveniours. Aint that fasinating so i ddint buy.

Bought 1.5 days ticket. Harry potter forbidden journey is a must go, minion ride is also great. I also bought express pass to japan cool, as final fantasy ride is 100 mins queue. I also went for detective conan 200+ pax real life escape, no problem if u dont understand japanese, as u will be grouped according to ur language. No problem playing the game even if we dont understand the stage story. This is a must go, the escape game game is great!

We were there for one and a half days and spent many hours queueing, some of them more than 2 hours (yes, this is not a typo) for less than 2-minute ride. I didn't see any Fast Pass mechanism, unlike its competitor in Tokyo (you know who). So your only option to save time is to spend much more money on top of the ticket price.  If it's any consolation, the queue was shorter nearing closing time as many went home after the parade.  Harry Potter was excellent, and the Flying Dinosaur was insanely scary.  A couple of major rides were not operating without being announced at the front gate (or anywhere else save the locations themselves).

In general it's a fun place to be, spent lots of time in the Harry Potter world - the ride is great! Other than that I didn't get to explore much as I was with a baby so more on going around and watching the parade. The Jurrasic World rides looks fun but unfortunately it was closed for maintenance when i visited.

We went on a Thursday and crowds were pretty good! Far better than the crowds at Disneyland in Tokyo! Express pass helped a lot for the really popular rides like flying dinosaur and Harry Potter! If your deciding between universal studios or Tokyo Disneyland, I can tell you first hand that universal studios is better in every way, especially for adults! Great day out!

My family and I have been to Universal studios in Japan, and I think it is a really good place for family .Before we went there during Christmas,I think their staff did a good job, they knew lots languages such as Chinese ,English, Japanese.And I think the most interesting game was Harry Potter,because the roller coaster was fun. You had to wear a 3D glass and Harry Potter would bring a mission, but be careful with your shoes.I think this place is very nice and it is a great place for a family.

Review by DrSim001 (Dr. H.C.M. Sim). Tourists Should Visit While in Osaka, Japan. My family enjoyed the visit. Go early. Bring along an umbrella or rain coat, It sometimes rain. Identify the best ride that you must sit and then go straight for it when the door opens. The place is packed towards the later half of the morning and afternoon. People in Japan are courteous and nice. The only problem is that most of the communication is in Japanese which I do not understand. Regards DrSim001 (Dr. H.C.M. Sim)

We went to Hogsmeade Village and explored this magical world in early June this year. The forbidden journey and the flight of hippo griff are highly recommended for Harry Potter’s fans ! The wand is a bit pricey but it’s irresistible to buy for the little ones.

We went there on a rather rainy Saturday in July. The rain probably kept the masses away, as we usually waited 15-20 min for a ride, and our longest wait was 70 min. With these wait times the park was lots of fun and the rides are awesome! I assume with the express pass it's similar so should be fun. Though it was fun that the park wasn't packed.  If we had to wait 100-200 min for a ride (as some commenters mentioned) it would be a total waste of time and not worth it.  The rain was no problem with an umbrella. Don't let it stop you from going. It's probably the best time.  To sum up. Rain keeps the lines reasonable and doesn't interfere with the experience too much. If it's raining, go! If it's not raining get an express pass or skip this place.

I went to Universal Studios recently. The train is great as it takes you right there! I decided to try and buy an express pass as my daughter really wanted to go on the Harry Potter ride. Well...after finding out the cost of buying the express 7 pass was nearly $400 AUD, I said no, that is too expensive for the 3 of us. So then I asked for an express pass for just Harry Potter. The people behind the counter (who spoke bad english), told me 'just today!' they would sell me a ticket for Harry potter express pass only (for the 3 of us). I paid over $100! The lady told me the tickets were stuck together (3 of them). I thought ok. Man, I should have checked. When I got to the Harry Potter ride I was told it was a pass for ONE PERSON!! What??? One person only? Why would I bother buying an express pass for one person, when I have 2 children with me (3 of us!). So after communicating my problems to the staff, I had to wait with my children (IN THE RAIN), while they talked to people. Eventually I was escorted to the administration building for a refund! (where they tried to take 200 yen out of me for administration fees!!) What???? It is a refund. Anyway my daughter, 9 was crying the whole time. We were left to wait 45 minutes (what a waste of ride time!) and eventually escorted to the single lane riders lane, where we got on within 10 minutes! We did love the ride...but I hated seeing my daughter crying and yes, we did get the 200 yen back (they came racing over to me with an envelope of 200 yen after we had the ride). But honestly...NOT GOOD ENOUGH UNIVERSAL STUDIOS! You made us wait in the rain for like 15 minutes, and then upset both me and my daughter. We did not stay the whole day as our time was not enjoyed as much. DO NOT BOTHER WITH EXPRESS PASS!! It's a scam. Universal are there to make money. They don't care about people!

Express pass was sold out when we reached the park one hour after opening. Butter beer taste like rootbeer. Harry potter 4D was not the usual kind of 4D show. Totally unexpected. Do not ride if you're not a fan of roller coaster.

We visited the park this week with four children, ages seven, 11, and 13. It is a smaller version of the Universal Studios in Orlando, but some of the rides are identical, such as the Forbidden Journey and Minions. Going mid week on a very hot day while school is in session, we really did not need our express passes although they did save us about a half an hour on a couple of rides.  We went in with a little bit of caution, having noted that the upside down roller coaster was stranded for two hours on a very busy day a couple of months earlier. So while we did not go on roller coasters, we still had a safety event in another context.  My son and I went to the Terminator experience, which is a hopelessly outdated variation on the second Terminator movie which came out over 25 years ago. We weren’t having that great of time, but things got interesting when sirens went off and there was an announcement of the fire alarm. We stood to go, as we were in an enclosed theater with a ton of other people, but then ushers reassured us that everything was fine. We assumed that it was part of the show, that we did not truly understand because we did not speak Japanese. Then they announced that the fire has been confirmed, and it was on the lower level of the building.  We stood to leave, but the ushers restrained us. They forcefully told us that we were not allowed to leave, even though the doors to the street were about 50 feet away. I am usually a very mild mannered person, but I became increasingly vocal in my need to leave the theater. They, in turn, became increasingly vocal that I was not permitted to do so. At one point they actually put out their arms to block my way. The most absurd moment came when I expressed my need to leave the building given the fire alarm, and the usher told me, “In a disaster situation, must stay inside!”  The ushers then began to bring out rope to cordon off the access to the exit, at which point I forced my way past them, holding my son’s hand, and was able to finally exit the theater. I’m not sure what came of the suppose of fire, but I would have absolutely no confidence in my safety in this park.

Very crowded bit worth visit. Since they open, they have improved a lot and still improving. All the coaster is fun but I recommend flying dynasou. Bad side is, food and drinks are very expensive so take your big water bottle with you.

universal studios japan is easily accessible by train from downtown osaka. the entrance ticket is a bit expensive but worth it. recommend to get the express pass as queues can be very long. the theme park itself is huge and every corner brings a different surprise. worth spending an entire day here!
Great place for whole family to spend a day or two. We spent two days. Make sure to do Jurassic park, Spiderman and other rides.
Harry Potters studio was our destination on this trip. And we did it!! Great🎢🎡A lot of fun. We loved it. Friendly staffs, easy to get around. Don’t worry about the queues. Just make good plans. 😊😊

Me and my kids had a blast here, but be warned everything is in Japanese, wish they had some of the rides and shows in english, any how we stayed at park front hotel so we walked over in the morning on a Thursday, the crowd to me wasn't that bad, we bought our tickets at the hotel so we strolled right in, Sailor moon, Terminator, and those 3D or movie stage shows were in the front so the line was HUGE, we skipped those and walked right over to Jaws and Jurassic area and the there were ZERO wait for those rides, we did those rides 2-3 times each and started to venture the rest of the park, the wait for most after were about 30-40 mins with minions being the longest, I personally thought the 3,5,7 fast pass wasn't worth the money, or at least not for a weekday plus unlike the Los Angeles and Singapore one, its not a VIP pass, the Osaka one sells a one time fast pass, I would suggest using the money else where, again this was on a weekday not weekend. Overall it was a good visit, the 4 not 5 star is due to everything in Japanese, been to lots of other theme parks where english showing on rides or shows were available, step up the game Osaka Universal!! :)

Great day, all 7 of us had great time. Really hot day. Food not great but rides fantastic. Favourite rides : flying dinosaurs, harry potter, and hollywood ride Most scary: the flying dinosaur Advice: Dont wear flip flops wear proper shoes  Take plenty of water with you.  Express pass essential  The banana popcorn is a must.
Loving all the rides as most of them are exciting enough. The Harry Potter theme is super cool, you should definitely try to the butter beer drink!!

Make sure you buy tickets in advance. Took advantage of the fast track passes. We were able to hit all the rides despite the rain. Thought the crowds would be dissipate - not a chance. We had rain all day and made the Harry Potter area a bit of a wet mess. Nothing like having butter beer in rain.

It was almost 40 degrees so was very hard to enjoy what the park has to offer. But from what I could see it is a must visit when in the area. You must pre book and if budget allows then express is the way to jump the crowds. Food and drink was very expensive but plenty of places to refill water bottles.

We visited the park on a hot summer's day, it was an extremely humid day and the express pass did save our lives from wasting time and lining up for rides. I'm a huge Minion fan but was extremely disappointed with the Minion ride, it wasn't as despicable as I thought it was suppose to be. haha!  The Harry Potter rise was pretty thrilling, as a person who gets motion sick I do recommend you to take a motion sickness pill or wear the wrist band to settle the stomach before going on the ride. Because I still got a bit sick, had to rest for a good hour before I felt a bit better.  All the food places had pretty good food but with a price tag. It was a very hot day, and we don't drink soft drink, we did struggle to find vending machines and stalls which sold bottle water. So to stay hydrated we had to buy a few bottles of water everytime we did find a stall that old it.  The night Parade was pretty spectacular, really did enjoy it! Overall i had an amazing day at the park, just be prepared to get there early and leave a night :)

The Park is real great fun, we went for opening at 8:30am and left right at the end of the 8pm night parade. +Express Pass for 4 attractions was expensive with Y 10,000 pp but saved us 90 mins at Harry Potter, 80 mins at Evangelion, 45 mins at Spiderman and 30 mins at Jaws. Jaws I would not include in the Express Pass, the queues are never really long, are shaded and move fast. +shows like the Summer Splash Parade and Night Parade are great highlights +Easy to remember circular park layout +Staff is generally helpful but speaks only basic english +Transport via JR Loop Line is easy and convenient. Only 3 min walk from park entrance to station -There are few vending machines selling plain water, and those that have sell out quickly. Be prepared to queue for water. The park should sell more water instead of all the soft drinks. Most food stalls offer only soft drink options, they don't even have water bottles. Tip: refill water bottles at the few drinking water fountains inside the queues of attractions. -People start to reserve their board walk space 3 hours in advance of the parade. Be prepared to check for the best spots early -food options are ok but there are no healthy options at all. Look for seats before you order food as people hang out at restaurants for long time. Consider snacks instead of a meal  Some More tips: Best rides: +Harry Potter (quick but impressive mix of screen and ride elements) +Minions Mayhem (whole experience is 20 min plus!) +Evangelion (quick but a great VR ride experience!)  Spiderman, Jaws and Jurassic Ride are ok but in my view not worth more than a 30-45min wait.  Do buy or bring a watergun if you're going in summer for the 2pm Parade!  Consider the 'single' ride option if you're not tied to go together - saves lots of time like a Express Pass.

The visit to the Universal Studios Japan is a dream come true!I didn't get to see it in my first Japan travel however, in my next trip, I made sure that USJ is included my itinerary. The feeling of excitement can not be contained once we have entered the park gates.Everyone's face was painted with smile as each one run to the directions of the attractions of their choices. The Wizarding World of Harry Potter was the most sought after, I observed. It was a magical experience flying with Harry Potter as he fought with the enemies. Riding the roller coaster on the Hollywood dream was simply breathtaking! (Not recommended for persons with weak heart conditions). Other attractions/ rides were also much enjoyed. Even the picture takings with the many different characters was such a joyful experience. Park staffs are also very friendly and readily assists to take photos when asked I surely would want to return again!

The most interesting part for me is Harry Potter zone. I really enjoy lunch and harry potter beer (not actually beer). For other part, as there were lot of people everywhere , I had a chance to play only once as I don't like queuing and waiting. So, I just walked around and sightseeing. If you expect to come and play a lot of game, I suggest you should have kind of ticket for express services.

Going in September and getting there early definitely worked to our advantage. We were able to hit our first few rides with barely more than a 20 min wait if that. They have the Halloween horror nights going on September-November so the people watching was amazing as people show up in costume for the evenings attractions.

All rides, shows, programmes were all in Japanese. Its not a place for foreigners who do not understand the japanese language  Express pass was more expensive at 100usd compared to the entry ticket of around 65usd. Express pass rates change depending on the date. Lowest rate is at 50usd for low seasons.

Came back here again after 9 months. I brought the 1.5 days from klook but didnt get the fast pass. The max we lined up was approx 100mins for the flying dinosaur and the VR ride Evangelion XR, which were both very popular rides. We lined up as single riders for the first time we went on the Evangelion, however I think its faster to line up in the normal lines, as they only let you on the ride if the other people in the other lines are at odd numbers to also go on the ride.  We were lucky that we got to go when they had the Halloween events, so there are zombies roaming around the park after 1800 hrs till closing. Also there are halloween shows showing. We also got to see the night parade which was pretty incredible.

Good planning is required to make the most of this visit, even without an express pass .  1. Go on a midweek day - Wednesday or Thursday to have a smaller crowd. Avoid Japanese bank and school holidays.  2. Doors open about half hour before official opening time. By then, huge queues would have formed already. Be there at least 1 hour before opening time.  3. Best ride for us - the flying dinosaur. Also had ridiculously long 3 hour queues at the later part of the day.  4. Other cool rides - Hollywood dream rides - forwards and backward, evangelion XR (VR ride - this replaced the space ride during our visit). All had long queues throughout the day.  5. Harry Potter world - no timed tickets were required during our entire day. The ride - Harry potter and the forbidden journey, was only average in our opinion. Queue times dropped later in the day.  6. Wait times - usually exaggerated. When we actually queued, queue times were shorter than advertised.  Recommendation: 1. Go for the flying dinosaur, Evangelion XR/space ride and Hollywood dream rides first thing in the morning. Queues are shorter as everyone is running towards Harry potter. Only after that, check if timed tickets are needed for Harry potter and take the Harry potter ride once queues shorten.  2. Download the USJ unofficial app to check waiting times.  3. Go back to Harry potter world in the evening to witness the lights all lit up. Looks great!  The rest of the rides are pretty mild and had rather short queue times.

Coming from the US, we’ve been to universal studios in Florida many times already, but this is definitely worth coming to just to see the Japanese influence in the park. People dress up and cosplay casually for the day to the park, and no one is as raucous as it seems to feel in Florida.  We stopped for pizza at lunch, and my little cousin dropped his soda on the floor. In no time, two servicewomen had come to clean the floor, and they even gave him a new soda!

Best wait times at most parks are at opening and closing. We got there early at 8am and waited for the gates to open to try to get reasonable wait times and got most of the important rides done before it peaks at around 10:30, 11am.  The only problem was that we couldn’t reenter the park. We stayed at Park Front Hotel which was like a 2 min walk from the front gate but couldn’t go back to rest or eat. Once the lines started to get long we walked a bit in the park but it was too hot. Decided to have a nap at a table.  Because we went during Halloween we got to do the special Halloween attractions. The horror mazes were great fun and the roaming zombies after 6pm were fantastic. I had a really great time, highly recommended. Lots of thrill rides but be prepared to wait.

Universal Studios Japan is a fantastic way to spend a day in Osaka. Anyone you travel with is guaranteed to find something they will enjoy and make their day. The wait times for rides and attractions are understandably long so if you can afford to budget it in, I’d opt for the express pass. Harry Potter World was a highlight, no detail was missed! Unfortunately, there are no English subtitles on a lot of things which is completely understandable but something that foreign visitors need to be prepared for. Well worth the effort!
I could go on about how much I enjoyed my visit but would end up writing an essay.  If you're in Osaka, go to Universal Studios. You won't regret it. The Wizarding World is especially impressive.
Visited universal studio and expect to have Fun! and it was FUN! Got to visit this place when you are in Japan!

Went on a weekday which was still busy but not prohibitively so.  I'll list the rides we went on & give you my & my friends joint opinion of them. Note: the majority of the rides/ attractions are in Japanese (this is Japan of course!) but we kind of got the jist of what was going on, otherwise we just followed everyone else.  We purchased a Fast Pass 4 (about ¥192,00) which was VERY worth.  If you can afford it then get it. I'll note in my review when we utilized this pass.  Terminator 2 ride. The waiting time was minimal - about 10mins. First you walk into an auditorium with a pair of 3D glasses.  You watch a dated dubbed video for 7mins then a girl comes out & speaks about.... something... for another 10mins. Honestly, its too long & you could feel everyone wanting to get on with the ride.  After she finished, doors opened & we were seated in a theater where we were to don our glasses.  Admittedly the 4D action was pretty good even though the dubbing was laughable, I did like the addition of water spraying, 'smoke'in your face or warmth near your face to emulate what was going on around you. I'd give it a 2/5 & glad I didn't use my Fast Pass on it.  Jaws. Used our Fast Pass because the line was really long.  Not sure why because the ride was terrible. Short, the sharks were hilariously robotic & saw them coming from a mile away (maybe except one). It was truely lame haha.  Give it a miss. 0/5  Jurassic Park - The Ride. We took the 'singles' line as it was a 5min wait compared to a 60min wait, would def recommend the singles line where possible to avoid the wait.  Absolutely LOVED this ride, so much so we went on it twice. You WILL get drenched if you sit at the front & wet if you sit anywhere else. We loved it as it was a hot day. The dinosaurs are pretty good & T-Rex at the end was fantastic - did not expect that drop though! Recommended 4.5/5  The Hollywood Ride.  Being a size 16/18 western woman I was not able to fit in the 'test' seat so I wasnt able to ride this one unfortunately. Please be aware of this, this is not a park that caters for larger people.  Harry Potter. We used the Fast pass as the normal wait was 100mins, we literally went straight in. The walk through the castle was impressive & feels like you're in the movie with the talking pictures. The ride consists of 4 seats in a line & next you are tossed & turned all over the place with wind, water, fire thrown your way.  It is not for those that suffer from motion sickness, it will make you feel ill as there are alotof jerky movements.  I loved it though as it felt like you were really flying, the Japanese dubbing again was lost in translation but I can see why this ride has won the awards it has.  5/5  Spiderman. Similar to Harry Potter in that its a 4D adventure but this time you're in a capsule with about 4 x 6 people.  We used our Fast Pass again & got right through with only a 7min wait, the walkthrough to get to the line was cool, like you're in The Daily Mail office.This was a fun ride, again not for those with motion sickness.  My mate was feeling ill by this stage. 3.5/5  Minions Ride - similar to Harry Potter & Spiderman. We used our last Fast Pass on this & there was no wait at all. There's a few rooms you need to stand & watch amusing Minion safety videos before you get on the ride.  About 5 mins each to watch.  You also get into a capsule (two lines of 4 people). I have to say this was alot more jerky than Spiderman & my friend nearly vomited haha.  Thank goodness she didn't! I really liked it, I thought it was a fun, silly exhilarating experience. 3/5.  Food places were busy but the Diner was great & lines moved fast. Caramel popcorn was delicious. Like all of Japan, bins to place trash are few & far between... Water fountains are near most toilet entrances which was handy. Universal is easy to get to via train.  Great & tiring day!

this place is an amazing amusement park but they really don't have a good customer service. i am a tourist and i just took video for my roller coaster ride like i did in Everland Korea many times. And they throw me outside. i begged them to let me continue my experience with Universal Studios and let them confiscate my camera and my phone to ensure that i won't take any videos anymore but instead they gave me no choice to make it up to them. and i hated the way they treated me. i do understand the consequences it may bring but i promised them that i will not take anymore videos. This what's makes me more proud to be a Filipino because we can understand people the way they act and give them other options to enjoy their experiences in my country even they commit violation unintentionally. They ruined my day (10/17/18), my expectations and my dream! i hate it so much! it gave me such a heartache! i just spent 3 hours in the park and 2 and a half hours of that was the queues from waiting in line! 👹! OMG!

This park so so busy. They have the Halloween horror nights going on til November which made it super busy. It was done well with all shows and so on. The ride lines were out of control. Don't go with kids as there is only 2 rides for under the height of 92cm's.

Love it. Preferable to book your tickets and possibly express pass in advance. This to ensure hassle fee entrance. Better even if u traveling solo/ willing to be separated from you group, cause there will special queues for single and it’s so much faster.

For Ayumi: Tour guide was very helpful which was observed by her efforts to help those in the tour. Even if there are times where her dialogue was not very clear, it was still understandable and she made sure that everyone was comfortable
Great rides! Definitely the best night parade I've ever seen (the Harry Potter set was 11/10). Very expensive in comparison to all the other Universal Studios (express pass).

We had a wonderful time at USJ especially at the Harry Potter section!!!! We enjoyed ourselves so much that we went back to this section after going around the others like Despicable Me, Jurassic Park, Amityville etc. It was a magical experience in Harry Potter's world from the 1st moment we stepped in. The 4D ride is highly recommended!!! Super exciting and heartstopping! There is a waiting room for young kids if the parents wish to go for the ride. The kid can stay with u in the queue until just before u take the ride, and u can collect the kid back from the waiting room first thing after u get off the ride.

My advise is to go on a weekday if you don't want to spend half your day waiting in line. It is also faster if you fall in line as a single rider -- this means that you won't get to seat beside your companion (if you have one) during the ride. Make sure to experience the Harry Potter and the Forbidden Journey ride -- it is my best experience at USJ (we had to fall in line for 1.5hrs though and this was off-peak!). In contrast, we got to ride the Hollywood Dream rollercoster as single riders and we had to wait in line for only 15minutes. :) More often than not, the waiting time shown at the entrance of an attraction is the worst case waiting time. Based on our experience, we had to fall in line for only 30-40minutes for a posted waiting time of 90minutes. I guess if you don't want to wait, you can get the express pass. However, I feel that the express pass is a rip-off and that USJ should be more responsible in controlling the crowd (number of people) allowed to enter the theme park on any given day.

Worth visiting, especially for Harry Potter land! The Forbidden Journey ride is more amazing than I remember it to be in Florida, plus you get to walk around the Castle! What they say about the crowd is real though - be prepared to queue for between 1 to 2 hours per ride. We got the fast pass and skipped the line for some rides (their fast passes work slightly differently and can be complicated so be sure to do sufficient research!) Apparently there are school excursions on Fridays, which may be why the park was so crowded the day we went. The staff at USJ are so enthusiastic and well trained - they talk to just about anyone! Would give this a 5 star if there hadn’t been such a crowd, which somewhat blotches the magical experience.

My husband and I had some time to kill in Osaka and decided to head to universal studios. We stupidly went on a Saturday, which happened also to be the last weekend of there Halloween celebrations - and it was absolutely jam packed. Way too busy. All the rides had a queue time of >200 mins. The fast track tickets had sold out, which was a nightmare - and please be aware they were really expensive (about £300!!). And the queues for drinks/food were really long too. Hay Potter land was quite cool - that’s about the only positive.
Very interesting place, recommend to buy the fast pass, most of the popular games need to wait for about 2 hours.
Superb! My wife and I really enjoyed the amusement park. I ak overwhlemed that we were able to visit this placce. Worth it.

It's my 2nd time to USJ before the Harry Potter land started. USJ has not failed me. Had a great fun and I was quite lucky that the crowd wasn't that many. Longest queue time was around 70mins.. try to avoid wkends, fri & mon, bank holidays and school holidays . Best time to visit between tues to thurs.  Bought my entrance tickets from klook. However do note the price goes up nearer to date especially for the fast pass. Klook was selling around SGD93 for express 4. Which is almost the same price as the entrance fee. Decided to try my luck to buy direct at USJ and I paid around SGD65. Do note if there is any events or festival that happening at USJ, Likely there is a surge in the prices..  A MUST to try out the flying dinosaur ride which is amazing.. do rem to empty your pockets as USJ is rather strict on this. There is a chance you will be ban from the park if things tart to drop from your pocket during the ride.  Harry Potter land was amazing. Felt like Im in hog warts.Super stroked, Rem to try the butter beer. A must visit for Harry Potter fans... the forbidden ride was good as well. If you have motion sickness, this ride you may like to avoid.. I'm prone to motion sickness & I took it anyway. I felt giddy afterwards but still ok.  Do try out evangelion ride if you can. Heard tat it is back by popular demand. Sad to say I did not manage to take the ride..  The night parade was great as well which is different to what I have seen 5 yrs ago. Stay for the parade if you can. Do check out the schedule for night parade.

This was our first family trip to Universal Studios Japan. We have also enjoyed Universal Studios Hollywood and Orlando. Universal Studios Japan was a good but different experience. The food and beverages had a Japanese twist but it was unique and delicious. The downside was that there was not the signature Hollywood characters to take photos of and with.

Best day to go to USJ for us is Tuesdays. Fewer people and lines are not that long also all staffs are very friendly in USJ. Must ride is the harry potter and the forbidden journey in 4D wanted to repeat again! Will visit again sometime!

Went with my husband who has also been to Universal Studios Singapore and we were both horrified by the massive crowds at USJ. So glad we didn't get the Express Pass as the waiting time for Express Pass holders was 1-1.5 hour. We didn't get on to any rides (we'd already plan not to waste time queuing) and just went straight to the Harry Potter part. I got a wand which allowed me to experience different 'magic' at spots that have censor that required a wand to be purchased from the shop. That was fun for me and the queues were very short or non-existent.  We left after watching the Minion Christmas Parade as we were disgusted by the unruly crowd that pushed their way in order to get pictures with the Minion mascots. Despite efforts from the staff to get people to line up, I was pushed around and had people screaming all around me. I empathize with the staff who tried to get people to stand at their designated spots. It was a mad house and my final straw in wanting to stay even a minute longer in USJ. Every where, every single shop and public walkway were full of people.  I'm not sure if this information is useful but we went on a Monday. An unpleasant experience and will not recommend visiting if not for Harry Potter.
