Came here mostly to see the Harry Potter theme park which did not disappoint. The evening christmas show (as well as the other shows that go on during the day) were very well done.  I also ended up enjoying my time in the minion park way more than I expected and the minion-themed foods weren't only cute but tasted great! I really liked the Santa de Minion steamed cream stew bun (filled with mushroom cream filling).  We ended up spending the whole day at the park and still didnt have time to go on any rides (not that that was a priority for us or anything, but for those of you who intend to go on the rides, know that you may end up missing on some great shows, meet and greets, parades, etc.)  Of course, 90% of the shows were in japanese but they were still entertaining nonetheless.

Loved seeing my little girl's eyes light up. The park was busy, so lines for big attractions was approximately 120 minutes on average, even on a weekday. But things like the realism of the dinosaurs in the dinosaur show were amazing. Attention to detail makes the day worthwhile, however they are drastically short in vegetarian and especially vegan options. Waiting in line for food is a nightmare.

Had a fantastic day. Love the express pass system which makes everything so much easier and worth the money if you are in a hurry. Had an excellent burger at the old school diner. Worth the visit for a great day out and excellent rides.

The Japanese have always been known to be meticulous and takes their work seriously, and it shows in their Universal Studios.  Energetic, courteous and attentive staff makes for a great experience. Hi-fiving and waving to kids is a common sight in the compound.  The Harry Potter attraction was simply magical. Even the trail to the actual attraction was carefully planned to replicate what's in the movie. The toilets were not left out in their attention to details.  Most impressive.

Best universal theme park. Make sure you visit the harry potter castle and rides Avoid weekends because it is very crowded. Stay nearby, hotel the park front. A very nice hotel, literally infront of the USJ gate

No words can describe how fun this theme park so I will leave it for yourself to experience.I shall provide the tips i was given by locals there.You should visit on either a wednesday or thursday as its usually the least crowded and the longest queue i had was only 45mins at jurassic park.It is also on these days that express pass is probably not needed.I also recommend u purchase the express passes on site as its much cheaper than websites and also because on site u can see the crowd and guess if u really need it.Make sure u have a full breakfast before going too. Bringing a water bottle and ponchos go a long way tbh.

Really not sure what I expected, but I had read other’s blogs & should’ve heeded their warnings. There was no English, it was way over priced for entry ticket (exchange rate didn’t help) & food and the cues were too long for the worthwhile rides to consider going on. I also didn’t appreciate the fact that if you paid more for your ticket, you got to use the express lines for rides. I consider this highly divisive, unfair & unjust.

If you have gone to other Universal Studio, this one is similar, except that it is all Japanese.  The Harry Potter ride was great, so is the Spider-Man.  Do buy the Express pass if you do not want to join the queue, but the Express pass costs more than the entrance ticket :)  The night parade could have been earlier, the day we went (Friday), the parade starts at 9pm, as we couldn’t stand the cold, we left without watching :( Understood the night parade was at 8pm on a Thursday, so do check the timing...

Although we have another Universal Studio in Asia(which is in Singapore), my first visit to Universal Studios was here in Osaka because we are potter-heads indeed! Sweet butterbeers and everything about Harry Potter from Hogwarts, to every little details is there. Most of our time was spent here looking at people, a happy place indeed. We didn’t get to go for all the rides mostly because I am actually has motion sickness. Better to avoid all the rides rather than give other people troubles later on. But, people screaming(of course because they had a lot of fun) did gives me some motivation to try but not to all rides. Love the parades so much too. We got to take pictures with minions, cookie monster, elmo and even grinch(my sister fav!). Do come early to enjoy every minute here is worth it. We went back after 6pm or nearly 7pm and it’s already dark and it started to rain too

Fantastic theme park. The Harry Porter attraction was definitely the crown jewel - the whole section was simply spectacular with the attraction built like a mini Harry Potter movie set. Kudos to the designers! There are stalls selling all kinds of Harry Potter souvenirs as well as butter beer (non alcoholic).  The atmosphere at the park was great - there were crowds of people enjoying themselves, staff who were very friendly and street parades and shows throughout the day.  The only downside was the waiting line (this is the only reason why I give it a 4 rather than 5). At 11am - the queue for the Harry Potter ride was 3hours! At 5pm, it was 130 minutes! (This was on a Saturday). Similarly, the Flying Dinosaur ride was a 150 minute wait! One option is to purchase the Express Pass - but that is not cheap. Unlike Disney, at Universal Studios the Express Pass are sold separately (limited numbers are sold per day hence advance booking is advised). For the Harry Potter ride, with Express Pass, the wait was 50 minutes.  Getting to the park was easy via the train. There are lots of eateries in the vicinity of the park - but do take note that the park does not allow re-entry once you exit. So meals have to be taken within the park - which adds to the long queues even at the restaurants.

This was the title my son suggested for this review. It is our second trip to Osaka from HK fir a family vacation. Our son loves the Harry Potter attraction and the Minions among others.  We had been to other Universal Studios but the one in Osaka is our favourite place not only because of the attractions but the friendly Japanese attitude particularly the staff who always welcome you with a smile. Definitely highly recommended place to visit.

Came here with two small children for a day in December.  We lashed out an bought an Express 4 tide Pass - highly recommended. Most rides had 100 minute plus queues and we went straight through.  Harry Potter land was fun (the ‘wand’ everyone bought was pricey but entertained the kids finding the places to use it).  The Harry Potter ride was probably the best I went on - but not for small kids - both scary and a 122cm height restriction.  Food wasn’t great (and overpriced ).  Also all the merchandise was excessively expensive and hard to avoid.  All in all a fun (and tiring) day out!

Whenever we travel abroad, we really made it a point to visit theme parks. We visited Universal Studio Singapore and its double the size in USJ.  We love the place and the rides but because of the long queues, we weren't able to enjoy the rides a lot as well as see the attractions and sights. One ride will take us 1 hour for the queues.  But at least, we have the reason to come back and savor our childhood dreams.

Universal Studios did not disappoint. The rides were fun, the lines effectively run, park was well maintained, and the staff pleasant. HARRY POTTER was the main reason we went to Universal Studios and it was magical! We paid for the fast pass and it was totally worth it!

Went on every ride, and was generally not disappointed. The harry potter ride gave me extreme motion sickness though, so avoid if thats you. Wait times for the rides were at the entrances which was nice, with generally 30 minute wait time for most of the rides on a Sunday.The Flying Dinosaur however, had an estimated 2 hour wait time, and it was no joke. A lot of the merchandise was quite over-priced, with some items actually being worth it. Decent amount of food, and just generally a great attraction park.

The rides are definitely more thrilling as compared to Disney's rides. If you love Harry Potter, you shouldn't miss this place. Theme popcorn container I think was ¥3,500 as compared to Disney's ¥2,300 - ¥2,500.

The experience at USJ is super exciting and nice as early in the morning, lots of people will line up at the gates. The park has a unique Hello Kitty section for hello kitty fans and also Sesame Street fans. Wonderful park with exciting rides. Spider-Man is my best choice.

The highlight of our trip to Osaka! Very well worth the price, we spent the NYE here. Gets very crowded fast, but still ok as long as you know where and what to do so plan ahead. Get your express pass online if you dont want to wait the long lines.

One word: Amazing!!! Having just come from holiday spot in Singapore we had visited Universal there thinking it was going to be much of same and thought 3.5/4 hours will be enough because our kids are around 4 & 5 years old and they have limited rides/shows for that age bracket so we’ll go a bit later just after lunch and stay later for the night parade. Well wrong! This place is huge! Is more like Disneyland. It’s really spectacular. Get there early for the gates to open you will want to spend all day here exploring there’s so much to see and do. Make sure you get fast passes lines get long but they do move quickly. Make sure you get popcorn in the minions area it’s banana flavor which sounds like it might be a wrong choice but it’s the best popcorn!!! Everything is in Japanese for the rides and the staff not speak much English so be sure to take a look at the map prior to going to get a better idea of what you want to tick off your list for doing and for heights for kids. Take a stroller for young kids up to 5 as it’s a big park to walk and dress kids in brighter jacket like red as most people are in black or dark colors. We went in January you’ll need gloves beanie and jacket. We had kids in thermal top and pants with just regular jeans and long sleeve top and adults just thermal long sleeve top and jeans and we were fine. Take plenty of spending money as the merchandise in the shops across the whole park is amazing. We opted to have dinner in the city walk area outside the park at the entrance at Wolfgang puck and ordered pizzas and pastas which was easy and not crowded. So go early get fast passes and spend all day having a blast it’s amazing! You won’t be disappointed!!

The park was basically on 50% operations. The average length of time for a ride was from 60 to 180 minutes. We did not take one ride.  Most of the food stands required a 15-30 minute wait in line. One stand promotes Clam Chowder on it awning. After waiting 15 minutes we discovered they only offered hotdogs. Do not go hungry to USJ. Bring lots of cash as everything is wildly expensive.

This is my 3rd time visiting USJ and I never wanted to visit here again... Its waaaay to busy and crowded in such a small theme park as they added so much attractions and areas in the last several years.The rides were awesome I could go on them many times but the QUEUE DOES NOT MOVE!! Waiting for 50 mins is normal, apparently people waited over 3 hours for 3 mins ride in the busy season, F that. The express pass has to be purchased to cut the queues, but I wouldn't pay the same amount as entry tickets, not everyone has money for that. We had x2 minion plates and a cream puffs came up to close to 5,000 yen, so expensive and very tasteless. Very disappointed!! The Halloween zombie event at night was gross and too scary for children, they chased people with fake chainsaw which looks so realistic........  今回、人生３回目のUSJでしたが、もう行きません。ランドに行きます。 園内はすごくごちゃごちゃしてて、平日にも関わらず忙しすぎ。待ち時間もハンパじゃないです、最低でも60分て…エクスプレスパスが購入できますけど、チケット代と同じくらい出してまでUSJに遊びに行きたいとは思いません。それにしてもエクスプレスパスの列は乗り口まで一直線で、ランドみたいに普通の列と乗り口近くからの合流などがないため、普通の列の方はさらに待ちます。お昼にミニオンプレートを２つとシュークリームを頼み、合計が５０００円近くに…実際の味も見た目もお金の無駄でした。まっずかったー。カップに入ったサラダはおいしかったけど、本当にサラダだけ。ハロウィンの夜のイベントでゾンビが街をあるくやつ、完全に大人向けのみです。クラブ状態。本物にめっちゃ似たチェーンソーを振り回して追いかけたり、子供には地獄でした。もういきません。
USJ is one of our favorite theme park accross asia. Do use Express Pass!! Worth it.. 🙏 full of laugh, happiness and one of the favorite theme park in Japan

Best place to be entertained in Osaka. Shows and ride are fantastic. Food are great and facilities are OK. However, too many people make some areas very crowded. Best if you buy express pass for you not to waste time . Waiting time for each ride ranges from 1 hr to 2.5 hrs. Maybe need to create new rides as well. Best ride so far is Harry Potter so don't miss this when you decide to go there.
It is very easy to spend a whole day here - and, you would need to in order to enjoy this fabulous attraction in Osaka.
We enjoyed every single bit of the USJ, parades and shops. It was crowded but still ok. Buy the express pass will help to cut the queue.

I really enjoyed this place. There were a lot of people when we went. Nonetheless, it was enjoying. Cold weather and nice theme parks. I also liked the butter beer in the Harry Potter area. Must try try is the Spiderman ride.

Even though the 'kids' are now grown up, nothing like another visit to bring back memories. There is a new attraction for them, HARRY POTTER. Named as the best ride in the world. How can we miss when we are in Osaka. The queue for us was about 70 minutes, some parts of the queue was in the open and the cold winds BUT it was all worth it. We stayed till evening to watch the digital presentation which was equally wonderful. In between, my wife and I sits in cafe and enjoy coffee and the warmth.

This is a must do attraction in this part of Japan, really good fun with or without kids! Harry Potter world is outstanding as expected, I’d recommend buying a wand and having a go at casting spells at several interactive spots. Jurassic Park rides and Spiderman are awesome too, but I would skip things like Terminator 3D unless you can speak Japanese and like to listen to a screeching hyperactive announcer (we walked out after 10 mins via emergency exit).  A few bad things though. Prices for almost everything are outrageous, especially the average food they serve so feel free to bring your own in a bag. Nobody checks this, how can they when several thousand people are at the gates in the morning ready to run to Harry Potter (literally what happened today so we just ran with them lol). Waiting times were up to 2 hrs today, with an average of 1 hr for top rides. Too bad the express pass is more than the entry ticket, but if you can afford it then do it!  All in all, highly recommended!

Probably our own fault for not doing enough research, and therefore not knowing what to expect, but we found USJ really disappointing compared to the Disney parks in Tokyo. FIrst up, it's small, and because you can see the outside world from inside the park, it doesn't give you the feeling that you're in a magical place. Secondly, a lot of the rides are 4D ones that aren't fun for people who get motion sick (me). Also, I just don't find these rides as special as dark rides, which make you feel like you're entering a new realm. I guess they're cheaper to produce and take us less real estate, but to me, the 4D rides are a bit like going to the movies. Thirdly, there just weren't very many rides that appealed to us. A few big ones were closed, and the rest just weren't that exciting. Finally, I thought the HP area would let you wander around Hogwarts dining hall etc like at HP world in the UK, but there really wasn't much to see except the exterior of Hogsmeade. We only stayed for about 2 hours.  Surprisingly, after everything we'd read, the crowds weren't that bad - it was a cold Thursday in January - although I didn't love seeing lots of people let in early before normal opening time. (Disney does a lot better job of not rubbing your face in other people's privilege and also of not charging for timed entry!) We didn't buy express passes and were glad we didn't because it was an expensive enough mistake as it was.

My famy visited on a Thursday in mid Jan. We did not buy an express pass. Despite being worried about not having one, the park was not too busy. We went straight to Harry Potter. Waited 40 mins for ride. Then went on Jaws ( no wait at all) Flying Dinosaur ( 35 min wait) and Spiderman (25 min). The key was use the single rider lane where possible. The Hollywood dream looked good but was closed. We are very glad we saved the money and did not buy express passes for the 5 of us. We had a good day and went on what we had planned. I guess the time we chose was not peak time so I'm sure that also made a difference. The park is easy to access and is on the water. It is very cold in winter, even with the sun out, so rug up and take warm clothes. The butterbeer is pretty awful..sickly sweet. A good marketing tool but give it a miss or buy 1 cup and share it around!!

I was in high hopes when we initially booked USJ but when we get there I was disappointed. Only the Harry Potter ride and the Flying Dinosaur saved our visit.  1. The queues are long for in-demand rides. In one ride alone (Lupin Car Chase), we spent almost two hours in line and the ride was not even worth the long wait. Some bought the Express Pass but the rides themselves are mediocre, so im not suggesting buying it.  2. There are unnecessary "stories" before the actual ride/show like the ones in Lupin Car Chase and Terminator. In Terminator, we actually slept throughout the show. My sons said the same of the Spiderman ride. The time spent waiting in line is compounded with the time spent listening to unnecessary stories, more so if you cant understand the language.  3. Not so many english-speaking staff, unlike in Universal Studio Singapore. In the Harry Potter ride we had to place our things inside the locker which was "labelled" coin operated. We do not have yen coins with us so we asked the staff if they have change our bill, they kept signing "No" (hands open, moving side to side). It was only after several minutes that we understood that they mean "no need for coin" instead of "no small change for bill".  4. The Harry Potter Castle ride was great, as well as the Flying Dinosaur. These are the only rides that distinguish USJ from common carnival rides. The Hollywood Backdrop was closed, maybe it is ok too but cant really say.

I was hoping we were going to have an equally amazing time at USJ as we did at Disney Sea but it is not comparable. The park is not that big, the worlds are not detailed like they are in Disney Sea but the lines were short (Harry Potter 30 mins, Flying Dinosaur 30 mins, Hollywood dream 20mins, Minions 40 mins, Spiderman 10 minutes). We also didn't have our bags checked so we were able to bring in Lawson sandwhiches etc.  We were able to finish the rides within a few hours and went to explore the park but there isnt too much to see. The majority of the park is filled with souvenir stores or expensive restaurants.
You gotta visit the Harry Potter theme park while you are here. The overall is big, make sure to stay hydrated throughout the day.

not like other theme parks in Hongkong and Singapore they don't provide anyting but in japanese sometimes i coun't get any instructions if there were a fire, only one understands Japanese can survive Linda Hamilton and Kurt Russell speak in Japanese... haha  English subtitles in a tiny corner do no harm to anyone, i think
Certainly a most do if you are a Harry Potter fan, it was less people than we expected, the express passes we purchased were only used once, otherwise, it it was a very good experience.

I've been to several Universal Studios before (Hollywood and Singapore) and I can say that I had an amazing time here. Especially if you're a Harry Potter fan, you should definitely go to the Harry Potter World first as it's the most famous attraction in USJ. Make sure to go during weekdays and not during school holidays as it can be super crowded.

Really enjoyed Universal studios. Bought entry tickets online via govoyagin and caught the train to universal station. Being a weekday was still really busy if you don’t have an express pass expect quite a lot of queuing but most of the rides are worth the wait. Just be aware that all the attractions are spoken in Japanese.
I only recommend going to Universal Osaka if you want to spend your day waiting on long lines...and getting ripped off for lunch.  I will NEVER GO TO ANOTHER UNIVERSAL PARK AGAIN!!!

we had such an awesome day! DEFINITELY get the fast pass! some of the wait times were 3 hours long! fast pass was totally worth every penny! unfortunately you can not bring in food or leave to get food, so my advice is to have a good breakfast, get there early, and have a plan for what rides to go to first... then snack throughout the day and if you need to have a bigger lunch then eat in the wizarding world of harry potter because the view is amazing and it had the best food we found... all of the rides are in Japanese so be aware of that going in - you will not be able to understand the ride stories... the VR ride was the best ever!!!! what a cool concept - it was unlike anything i have ever experienced.

Really enjoyed the rides especially: Harry Potter and the Forbidden Journey The flying dinosaur Amazing Adventures of Spider Man  Suggest visitor to pre-purchase express pass to cut down the ques time, as is really long lines for every rides. The express pass is expensive, but it worth the price. As it cut down all the ques time and you can enjoy different rides.  The Night Parrade is really fantastic too. Enjoyed the show to the max, with the chilling weather. We missed the firework session, definitely will go again, probably during Halloween Seasons!  All the staff is very friendly and cheerful. Love the decoration of every different theme park, especially Harry Porter and the Jurassic Park.

It is undoubtedly well done. But considering the number of visitors, there are very few rides. The flying dinosaur had a wait time of 3 hours 30 min. Can you beat that? People actually queued up for that ride knowing it. It can only happen in Japan - people are nice and polite. Any other country people would ask for refund.

Being an avid theme parker goer, I have been to several parks once or even multiple times. Though it's still a lot of fun each time I go, I already know what to expect, because I usually go in the summer time. This time, however, was way way different. My family and I went to Osaka just in time for Halloween, Oct. 31, 2018. What a biiig difference that made. It wasn't just decorations that were Halloween-themed, but also the rides and attractions. Some usual "summer" attractions were closed down and replaced by Halloween-themed attractions like "Blood Legend" (normally the Shrek 4-D ride), or "Sadako" horror theater (normally the Terminator 3-D theater attraction). And most park goers, including myself, were in costume, in keeping with the Halloween tradition. It was crazy seeing all these people in costume having fun at the rides and attractions. And then, when it was already night time, the park zombies came out to dance and scare people. Suffice it to say, my family and I had an awesome time. So if you love theme parks, I suggest at least once in your life, go to a theme park during Halloween, especially a Universal Studio park, whether in Japan, Singapore or the US. FINAL THOUGHTS: 1) Oct. 31 was a weekday. Even though it was already Halloween, the park was still not that full during the day. But when office and school was already out at the end of the day, the office workers and students started to stream in in droves. 2) I've been to Universal Studios Hollywood and Singapore and I have to say that USJ is much larger than either. So expect to be walking looong distances when getting from one place to another, especially Harry Potter land. From the initial entry way of the HP land, you still have to walk some 200m along a winding path in order to get to the actual HP attractions.

Went on a Sunday, didn't get an express pass (too pricey for a family of 3). Arrived at the USJ gate round 7;30am, there were a lot of people lining up. Took a chance on the timed-entry WWoHP, the odds were in our favor, there was no timed-entry tickets,, we were one of the first to ride the Forbiden Journey. I felt bad for those who bought the express pass for that day. Don't trust the crowd predictor calendar, at the end of the day it's all business. Only a moderate crowd on a Sunday, maybe because it was not yet spring break and the rain was on and off. Even without an express pass, we were able to get in about 6 rides (not bad).

Happy Potter Series 的週邊商品 HP控.. ٩(♡ε♡ )۶ 見到Time Turner, Wands 同Owls.. 邊會唔心動 😍  如出遊..有寄明信片習慣的朋友，可 →自帶 Postcards在Theme Park內買郵票(日本郵政的stamp) →或在Theme Parking內買明信片及郵票套裝！  郵Chop(Chop stamp)是HP的(^_^)/  Really Love The Time Turner and Owls.. Really like Snape.... Coz he's real awesome! (^_^)/

To be fair I am not a big theme park kind of guy, so most probably visit any theme park once and never think of going back again.  Went on a Thursday but the place was absolutely packed, did not bother to get an express pass wished wish I did at least for the Harry Potter ride because the line we were in took us over 2 hours for a 5 minutes ride? Anyway, after that experience I do not want to spend the day lining up to anything.

We are in Osaka visiting family so we headed to USJ to have family fun and wow the weather was with us, fair skinned English showing signs of red. The highlight was the Water World show- not for those spooked by really loud pyrotechnics, they virtually blew the film out of the water. If fact loud bangs seem to crop up in several places. The Minnonns ride was a definite NO amount the younger members of the group amazing for the older and ancient crew. How do they get you to believe it? We did not have a jump the queues pass so avoided some rides due to long wait on a less busy day!
We went on a rainy day. Pros: no Queue for rides Cons: cold and wet, photos show wet floors, some outdoor rides unavailable. Overall pleasant experiecne

The park is all in Japanese, and I understand that, but there are no subtitles in english for several attractions, which make it hard to follow and enjoy some activities. And there was something that bothered us even more. One in our group was a bit bigger (not obese or anything) and twice they made her sit in the ride seat to test if she was able to go on the rollercoaster. I understand the security concern but: 1st the rides need to be able to fit people from various sizes; 2nd this is a humiliating situation to be “tested” in front of everyone; 3rd if you buy the express ticket and you were not tested for the size, you loseyou money

Really enjoy walking while watching the colorful buildings. I was on wheelchair but the officers treat like first class. We enjoyed the night parade. Eating pizza A must there and cleanliness is their priority. Welcome Tokyo Olympic 2020.

We arrived early since we have the VIP pass and special entry so we got to take photos at Wizarding World of Harry Potter without photobombers and since we have express pass, we did not wait in line for a long time, The express pass was so worth it, it made our day more enjoyable. My favorite ride is the Forbidden Journey.

Theme park is good - only 2 real rollercoasters: Flying Dragon and Hollywood dream. Alot of 3/4D type experiences but well done for most part: Lupin (temporary Cool Japan one), Harry potter (excellent), Miniom mayhem and Spiderman.  Backdraft and terminator (very dated) were all in Japanese and a 20 min build up wasn't worth it to see them. Jaws, Jurassic park the ride and Flight of hippogriff weren't much.  Backpacks and bags dont need to be put away for day in lockers. Can bring in and keep with you and put in lockers/hold that are provided directly besidr each ride - totally secure. Bags not checked (despite what we'd read elsewhere) so free go bring in food/drinks from outside.  Wed/Thurs best days to go as quietest. We went on a thursday and still so busy. Bought our ticket and the express 7 tickey online on kkday in advance. Well worth the extra price for express pass.

The USJ park itself was great but DO NOT BOOK YOUR TICKETS THROUGH TRIPADVISOR. I booked 3 tickets 8 days before we left for Japan and 13 days before the date I selected to go to USJ. Upon doing so I got a reply email saying that my tickets were not yet confirmed and I would have to wait for confirmation. There was no indication this would be the process when I booked but I had no concerns with this and waited. After a few days with no confirmation email, I looked at my Tripadvisor profile to check on things. It stated that I had nothing booked. I checked the FAQs which stated that confirmations sometimes take up to 48 hours. As it was beyond 48 hours and I had heard nothing and my profile had no booking recorded, I presumed that my booking had failed. To avoid the same thing happening again, I booked again through the JTB travel agency also on the USJ website. This transaction was completed immediately, easily and successfully. A few days later (about an hour before we were to go to the airport and in the midst of final house etc organization), and 8 DAYS after booking with Tripadvisor, I received an email stating that my booking had now been confirmed and my credit card charged. I contacted Tripadvisor immediately to cancel my booking (4 days before we were booked to visit USJ). But they replied to advise that I could not cancel and my booking remained confirmed. So I paid twice to go to USJ on the same day thanks to Tripadvisor's abysmal booking system. Definitely go to USJ - its great. And although expensive the Express Pass really is worth having due to the long lines for rides. JUST DONT BOOK YOUR TICKETS THROUGH TRIPADVISOR. THEY ARE HOPELESS

There’s something for all ages so a family with children in different age groups all have something to do. Coaster rides are at least 50 mins wait on average days though, so best to do them early to enjoy shorter queues. Night parade is not as long as Disney’s, but the wow factor is there. Watch it where they have projections on the walls for best effect. Try to catch the Hogwarts castle light show too. Only that it usually occurs at the same time as the night parade. 😅

Having recently visited Disney Tokyo and Disney Shanghai, our group all preferred this theme park. Excellent rides - Hollywood Dream with custom music was a nice touch. Spider man ride had 5-D excellent effects. And best of all Harry Potter. Excellent attention to detail in recreating Hogsmeade and Hogwarts - really fun. Only issue is that it is a pricey experience. We bought fast pass for 7 rides so the total price per adult was US$230, but thought it was worth it to spend the day on rides.

Sorry this is long. Visited Universal Studios Japan today (midweek, in April, non school holidays). Found park opened maybe 15 mins early. 1000s people already there. Was imagining horror lines all day but actually was not too bad. Did all the rides wanted to do. Headed first to Harry Potter where wait was 50 mins. Most rides 30 mins. Despicable me Minions ride was 50 mins too. Spiderman 30 mins. Jaws 30 mins. But overall park not too crowded and lines fine. The park is open until 8pm. However the Food shops all close at 6pm (well a few expensive ones are open near the parade). We did not know this and went back for food at 7pm- no food! Electric Parade was on 7.25pm. Harry Potter Hogwarts night show was on 7.50pm. Thought perfect- will see both. BUT Electric Parade did not start until 7.42pm. So ended up missing Harry Potter. It really is impossible to see both shows Alot of USJ pre-rides were all in Japanese. Including any safety instructions. We have been to all other Universals so ok, we knew the drill about safety but wondered about newbies to Universal. It also diminished the experience by rides being solely in Japanese (no subtitles or translater devices like Tokyo Disneyland).

I recently visited Universal Studios Japan on a fairly quiet day. Having done Universal Hollywood and Orlando, I was excited to see what was awaiting...  The park, like everything in Japan, is pristine. Everything was perfectly kept, running smoothly and expertly efficient as only the Japanese can do! One thing that really stood out were the staff, they were so incredibly friendly, and they were constantly smiling, waving, asking how your day is, and genuinely seemed pleased to see you. I've never seen anything like it, and it really was infectious, as you couldn't help smiling!  A big plus if you can use them is the Single Rider lines, it's well worth breaking from the group as we queued 5 minutes for Spider Man when the main queue was 40. Same for Flying Dinosaur which was a 10 minute single rider and 1 hour in the main queue.  We were gutted to miss the night time show, as it was cancelled due to weather.  My only comment, which may seem a but unfair considering it is a Japanese theme park, but most rides are in Japanese, and there is no subtitle, so it can be a bit hard to grasp what's going on, but they are fun netherless. I did think that some of the rides were showing their age, such as Jaws and Terminator 2, but I imagine they will get around to improving or replacing in the coming years.

This had it all food, drinks, rides, it was so much fun. Harry Potter world was fabulous. The Minions were a big hit. Food was good. Just seeing the universal sign at the front made you feel excited. We went on the backwards ride, Jurassic rides, Jaws ride, Spider-Man so much to do. You can go lots of restaurants just outside the park. Hard Rock Cafe,TGIF. High recommend this theme park.

Know what your getting into. Was super busy by 11am on a Tuesday. Sold out of fast pass by that time, huge dissapointment. Took 15 minutes to find a bottle of water. 2 plus hours wait times. Great good. In 8 hours did 5 attractions.

Universal Studios Japan is a mix of quirky, fun, family entertainment with something that will suit everyone. I am not a massive fan of theme parks so was a little apprehensive, however from the incredible welcome you get from the team even before you enter the park to the great variety of attractions, restaurants, bars, cafes, and some incredible street performers - I actually had a brilliant day. The Harry Potter world is really well done, of course everyone was getting soaked on the Jurassic Park ride - hint - if you don't wont to get soaked don't ride it as nowhere is safe!  The kids will love the Minions area but depending on their age and bravery, the ride may be a little overwhelming for smaller children. However all little ones will love Snoopy's Cafe and all of the characters.  I did find that there were way too many souvenir shops - but aybe that is normal for theme parks.  Good variety of food and drink options and some good places to just sit and take in the atmosphere.

My friends and I went during the single busiest time of year, Golden Week, and had no problems at all. The queues were no longer than at other amusement parks, and there are tons of food options; both cheap and more expensive. You just have to look. Walked right in to every park, including Harry Potter. No wait time at all. Being all in Japanese was no problem and it should be expected. If you want an experience in English, go to Universal Studios in America!

Absolutely loved this park. It was well spread out which made the crowds less of an issue. I went on a weekday which is definitely a help. Two of the best rollercoasters going and the old school attractions like backdraft and jaws were fantastic. Lots of different food options at good prices and the lines were an hour or less. The line times are exaggerated too which is interesting and single riders get on a lot quicker again. Be careful of the express pass as it is not fully worth it. I purchased the 3 attractions express pass for the flying dinosaur in particular as this is the most popular ride and that made a massive difference apart from that the wait times on the max 7 attraction one is not worth the massive price over admission. Must see and the whole place is well done.

There were so much people. We waited 180 minutes for a 5 minute ride. Our timing was off because it was the golden week, too much visitors were there. I enjoyed the harry potter area, but still there were too much people and not much of nice food choices.

Everytime have been a pleasure to come here. Since opening day till now lots of nice improvements have been done. Specially Harry Potter world. Lost World,Water world,Jurassic Parc,Children from mostly 3 years old can also enjoy many attractions too like Sesame Streets,Hello Kitty and Snoopy World. If you come to Osaka don’t forget to have great time here!!!!

Spent a day and night around Halloween time, the best experience, different from Hollywood, and Florida’s experience. Amazing mazes, horror events and food. Extremely immersive and all rides, and mazes done in one day.

I hadn’t been to a universal studios for many many years. This didn’t disappoint the only shame was backdraft was closed.  We went on all the rides and didn’t have to queue for long as we had fast pass for the big rides well worth buying in busy days!!  I live this place and if I go again I would stay in one of the hotels on site!

When we visited Japan, one of our must visit in our list is Universal Studios (USJ).  The park is well maintained and have a lot of rides that my teenage daughter enjoyed so much. However, what disappointed me was that the characters you get to see or the attractions are not updated.  I was hoping to see Aquaman or Wonderwoman attractions instead. I have always appreciated Snoopy and Peanuts when I was a child but the new generation dont know these characters anymore.  There are nice portions of the park though, Harry Potter, Spiderman and Jurassic Park are still a must visit in the park.

It’s a great place to visit but be warned - it is so crowded! Of course that’s not unexpected but I wish we’d have planned ahead and gotten to go on more rides. The Harry Potter world was AMAZING! The Hollywood Tower of Terror was also so much fun. The ride waiting times can be hours though (one ride we waited for 3hrs before giving up!) but you can get passes to lessen that. I highly recommend you look into those! Overall it was lots of fun & I highly recommend it!

We were there at around 830 & the queue outside USJ was already very long. We went during non peak period on a wed and got express pass for 4 rides via klook website- hollywood dreams, harry potter, lupin & spiderman. The express pass is expensive, and you may wish to reconsider buying it. For us, queue for hollywood dreams and spiderman is relatively short. E.g. Only 20 min wait time if we never use express pass. Whereas on the other hand, queue time for lupin and harry potter is around 100 mins wait time if we didn't have express pass. Most of the rides - spiderman, minion and lupin makes use of VR technology. It's cool but may get a bit dizzy. Harry Potter ride is simply amazing and the castle looks so real. Most of the rides are family friendly except Hollywood dreams - front and back drop available. Too much adrenaline rush, but it was so fun! Jurassic ride was really good & we went 4 times because there wasn't any queue in evening. A pity we didn't get to go for the flying dinosaur ride due to some health condition. The queue isn't long either - only 20 mins wait time in late noon to late evening.  Tip: stay all the way till closing time. Go for rides in the evening as wait time is only 20-30 mins for most rides. Download USJALERT mobile app - will be able to get updated queue time where ever in the park you are!

Such a fun day out at Universal Studios Japan. Staff are so friendly and helpful. We got there early so ride times weren't too bad, they got much busier during the day so we started queuing for the single line which cut down the time a lot and generally my partner and I were on the same ride close to each other, this was good for the rides we had already done.  Not a great deal of vegetarian food options but was able to make do.

Managed to go on a Friday, and was pleasantly surprised that we managed to do all the major rides during our stay there. Arrived early (820am) and entered when they opened (opening supposedly at 9am but they opened the gates at around 845am) Ran straight to Harry Potter and waited 20 min to ride. When we exited, rode the flight of the hippogriff in 15 minutes. Had our butter beer and photos taken then Brisk walked to Jurassic Park to ride the Flying Dinosaur (took 45 min wait time). Did Spider-Man next (40 min wait) then quick snack. Watched the new show Sing (no wait as we arrived when the doors opened) then rode Hollywood Dream the ride (60 minute wait) lined up for Sailor moon (new show, 40 min) then lined up for Hollywood Dream backdrop 60 min wait) had a late lunch then lined up for Lupin (90 minutes) then Attack on Titan (60 min) This was done without an express pass, so it is possible. But previous visits had 120 minute to 180 min wait times. Try to do the rides late on the afternoon as well before the parade as most people save spaces for the parade and will not be doing the rides

Visiting “Harry Potter” attraction was one of my 9 years old kids who already read whole the story books. I would like to share my experience for your successful visiting the entertainment. 1, To but ticket ahead of time. As soon as possible, if you plan to visit there, many kind of express pass and pay attraction are available buying ticket on website, which is not belong to entrance ticket. If you purchase only entrance ticket, you must wait around 60 minutes for each attractions. 2, To prepare ticket. Printing out the online ticket or showing QR code on smart phone are available. The park does not have free WiFi so if you do not have own router, I recommended you to printing the ticket at your home. 3, To make reservation dining area. Some of the restaurants take online booking until 24 hours ahead. It is one of good solution to cut your waist of time. Out side of the park, Universal city, has so many good restaurants also. 4, Paying around 14JPY provides you free refill drink at some restaurants, but it did not work well, because we have to wait on the long line which is same as food order, so I do not use the system anymore. You can get drink from kiosk and vending machine. 5, “Detective Conan the escape” (B), Took two hours without any seating and bathroom. The mystery attraction was too hard for my 9 years old girls, so we wanted quite middle of the activity but it was not arrow, even though I really wanted to go to bath room. If you really want to quite, your all party have leave all together. Upper from high school students will be appropriate age for the activity. 6, Do not go to Minion ride (26), and Harry Potter and forbidden journey (56), after eating meal. It make your stomach really upset. 7, You will be wet if you ride left side at “Jaws” ride. 8, Some part of activity was closed or not available everyday, so please check web site before you visiting there. 9, The casts could not speak other language besides Japanese. They only use a few words for ride explanation, but some activity has full English translation on their monitor. 10, Staying the nearest hotel will be good for family who has young kids. Walking whole park makes us really exhaust. We chose Park front hotel. I hope you can enjoy your visiting. Good luck. I pray for you.

Really enjoyed my time at Universal Studios Osaka last November especially The Wizarding World of Harry Potter. Plenty of fun rides to on even if you are not a thrill seeker. Staff were also very friendly too.  Must visit when you do drop by Osaka
I love this place so much , as the rainy day , the people are not much , I have two times with flying dinosaur ! It is very fun and excited !
Weather was good and was not that crowded on a tuesday. The harry potter queue was long but worth the wait. The roller coaster was best ever ride taken as well. Highly recommend place to go in Osaka.

My brother and I visited in late June. It was a very fun experience and we did everything we wanted to do in a day, but some of the bigger rides we were looking forward to were closed for maintenance... would have been nice to be able to find ride closings in advance.

Had a great day. Lots of shows, rides and attractions. 1 day is not enough. We spent extra and got an express pass 4 which allowed us express entry into 4 very popular rides. It saved so much time . The p ark was well organised, clean, water bubblers all around and the staff were super friendly. Also loved that we could take our backpack and not have to pay for a locker as the rides that you couldn't take your bag on had safe storage. Was so easy.

I visited Universal Studios and I was having a fun time.But in the Harry Potter section, the Hogwarts Train conductor was REALLy mean. We waited in a line to take a picture with him and when it was finally our turn, there was some random Japanese who cut the line.(I think she didn't know that there was a line)So after her we went to the guy(train conductor) and said that there was a line waiting. He looked straight at my friend's eye and said in such a mean tone 'There is no such thing as a line' when clearly people were waiting. And then he continued taking pictures with random people who were cutting the line. My experience at Universial Studios was great but the whole experience was brought down because of that train conductor.
Overpriced and boring rides which are not worth queuing over an hour for.  Harry Potter World was big a disappointment too. I do not recommend!

We loved this place. We could ride many attractions. We had express 4 pass but we could not use 2 of them. Eventhough entrance and express tickets are expensive, it worth. Espesially we really loved Harry Potter theme. My two kids had magic wand and used in designated spot for many times. Imagination became true in Universal studio. We want to try Florida's if we have chance.

Universal studios Osaka has a far nicer layout than L.A and was more enjoyable to stroll around. We went on a Saturday and it wasn’t as crowded as we’d found L.A a few years earlier (which seemed dangerously crowded!!!). We bought an Express 4 which made it a very expensive day out but seemed worth it as 90 minute minimum waiting times for each ride would have otherwise made our day miserable. The rides were fun, the food was as you’d expect for a theme park (crowded and long wait times to get a table). The staff are to be commended - they are so friendly and upbeat, they really make every interaction wonderful. My daughter looooves anime and they had a special Attack on Titan spectacular!!! Apart from this, I would note there is nothing new to see here if you are looking for something different in your theme park. But, it was a fun day for our teenagers and we had a late dinner in the area outside the park before getting on the very accessible train back to accomodation. It was a busy day (Saturday) and very crowded but Japanese crowds are polite and considerate - as they are everywhere in this beautiful country!!!!!

First of all be sure it isn’t a rainy day. Avoid vacation, holiday Saturday Sunday..because you might wait longer then usually for most attractions .if you could stay in Osaka 4 or 5 days then I really strongly recommend to take time and please visit here

Enjoyed a full days worth at the park. Rides were great fun even though they were narrated in Japanese. Waiting time for popular rides without fastpass was 90 to 100 minutes. Couldn't do it all but that was expected given the popularity and the sheer number of people present. Artwork, costumes and creativity was amazing with different themes spread across the amusement park. Staff on site were really friendly and cheerful all day long. My wife and I enjoyed our time there.

First it’s important to say that the Harry Potter and the Forbidden Journey ride is spectacular and it’s worth a visit to the park just for this alone. The use of special affects to simulate the feeling of flight was amazing and wonderful. Even Harry and Hermione screaming at us in Japanese didn’t spoil the experience (and we are in Japan and they do speak Japanese here afterall).  Any HP fans will love the village of Hogsmeade which has been created and will enjoy looking around and buying HP souvenirs etc. The other ride, Flight of the Hippogriff, was very short but a sweet little roller coaster which we enjoyed as we are not keen on being spun around upside down and scared to death.  The rest of the park feels old and a bit shabby. It’s just a lot of shops which sell souvenirs and food and drinks. Yes it looks like a Hollywood back lot but it’s quite soulless and lacks any kind of character. My 12 year old just didn’t really grasp the whole concept of what a back lot is and why it would be interesting to anyone; he inhabits a digital world after all. And frankly the back lot buildings didn’t create a sense of “Hollywood” or capture the world of movies for me either.  It opens at 9am and from 7am people were queuing outside to be first in and I can understand why, when you have to wait for hours to get on a ride it pays to be at the front of the line! We did pay the extra money for the express tickets which gave us a booked time to turn up, therefore it was a shock when we got there to join a line with a couple of hundred people in it; surely this couldn’t be the express? But yes it was and it moved very quickly thank goodness. But it’s good to know in advance what’s going on as we found there was a complete lack of information provided on how the express tickets worked (except for the time and the ride) and there is no signage at all explaining how anything works.  The staff were all lovely and helpful. The food is dreadful (theme park yuck) but no worse than any other theme park in the world.  We tried the Minion ride and it was really boring.  One more issue, you can’t leave and go back to your hotel for a break. There is really no shade or anywhere to stop and chill out, unless you want to sit in a cafe. As a result it’s a really exhausting day, especially given the crowds (and we were there on a Thursday and it’s not the Japanese holidays yet)

We had a shambolic visit to USJ a couple of years ago, unprepared and arriving to by tickets the day of our visit to find nearly all express passes sold out and leaving us to spend the day dreaming of skipping the crazily long queues.  Well this time I was well prepared... purchased tickets well in advance and forked out the big bucks for the standard/space fantasy express 7 pass. We saved a couple of hundred dollars buy purchasing direct from the USJ Japanese language website. I just used Google Translate on my iPhone to translate the pages on my iPad...... it was relatively simple and I just used the japan address of our accommodation in japan. A link to the tickets is emailed immediately and you even have the option to print them in English which was surprising, anyway the Klook quote was about $250 more expensive than direct from USJ and there was no waiting at all.  So with tickets and express passes in hand we headed for our second attempt, determined to get the most out of the day. We arrived at the gates at 8:15am with gates opening at 8:30, we were through the gates quickly and well ahead of the majority of the crowd and rather than rush to Harry Potter land to queue for the forbidden journey like everyone else, we headed to the Spider-Man ride and walked straight on without any queue. Then we went to Space Fantasy ride and again got straight on without queuing. Next we headed to Harry Potter Land to have an explore before our first timed express pass which was the Forbidden Journey at 10:20am. I had read on a forum that if wands purchased from the park with the the infrared reflector malfunction that they will fix it or replace it. My son had played with his wand which was purchased two years earlier and scratched the plastic tip - no major damage just a couple of scratches on the plastic tip that prevented it from making the magic spells work around Hogsmeade, anyway we asked at the wand shop but they said unless it was purchased that day there was nothing they could do which was disappointing but not surprising.  The express pass line for the Forbidden Journey was huge and had us and everyone else worried we’d wasted a lot of money to still stand in long queues all day but once the line started moving we were in chasing the snitch and dodging dementors in less than 10 minutes. We all loved the Forbidden Journey and can see why it is so highly rated as an attraction. The rest of the day went smoothly using the express passes to skip the queues and feeling no pressure to rush anywhere. For food we had a good hearty lunch at the Hogs Head Inn which made sure the kids didn’t go hungry, the must have Minion Banana Ice-cream Sandwich and a few other snacks during the day. There are additional cost games on offer all over the park for 1200y - I was talked into playing a couple to try and win stuffed things.... if you want to win prizes I would suggest the banana toss at the Minion area - i had two goes for two wins - it seemed ridiculously easy to me but maybe I was just lucky ..... anyway now we have a couple of one foot tall and much loved stuffed Minions to accompany us for the rest of Japan trip. By 4pm we had finished our express passes and rain had arrived...we headed back to Harry Potter land and walked into the wand show in Olivander’s - my 8yo daughter’s favourite part of the day as she was selected to be fitted out with a wand and the actor playing Olivander was absolutely fantastic. We lined up for the forbidden journey again and got on in about 50 minutes. By 6pm with rain still falling we called it a day and headed to Mos Burger at Universal City Walk for some cheap and easy dinner before strolling back to our accommodation at the Universal Port Hotel to bed.  As we had planned the trip a while out I had purchased some cheap Harry Potter costumes from eBay for the kids to wear and it turned out to be a fantastic idea as both the kids were called up to be part of a magic show in Hogsmeade and my daughter was again selected for the Olivander’s show. They were also asked to pose for many photos with people during the day which they thought was fantastic and apparently according to my daughter may her World Famous!! Which for an 8 year old is a big deal.  I think DisneySea and Disneyland are better value parks and the FASTPASS there makes things easier and more fair for everyone - USJ on the other hand really is only worthwhile if you spare willing to throw plenty of money at it. That being said we had a fantastic time and definitely ticked that one off the list.
All the attractions are amazing with a lot of sensations. You obviously don’t have the time to get bored. The atmosphere is perfect and so so so amazing!!!!!!
Beats Singapore’s Studios by Miles. Top service, top rides! Just a great park! Recommended for all families with kids

This was the second visit for my husband and I. Last time we had limited time as it was a port visit during a cruise. This time we were visiting in a group of 9 family members which was a lot of fun!  The Wizarding World of Harry Potter was new since our last visit, and was fun even though not all of our party are fans of the boy wizard. You don't need to know much about the books or movies to enjoy the experiences in this part of the park.  Line ups for some attractions were up to 2 hours long, but we did manage to find a few things with shorter wait times.  There were plenty of food and drink options. We had lunch at Mel's Drive In and dinner at the Park Side Grille. The burger combos at Mel's Drive In were freshly made and good value. The Park Side Grille was a little overpriced for the size and quality of the meals.  Overall it was a good experience and a fun day out. The night parade was a definite highlight.

I usually stay away from Theme Parks so I did not expect to have as great a time as I did. Plan ahead. Figure out what you want to do and the order and how to tackle two hour lines. Do not miss the Harry Potter attraction!! Check out what special events are happening around the time of your visit. When we went they had a Summer Parade where everyone sprays everyone else with water and gets soaked, which was a really fun way to cool off! And don't forget to take a photo in front of the Universal Studios globe by the entrance!

Family group of 7 - 6 adults and an 11 year old. A truly amazing experience despite the language barrier. We enjoyed the shows where very little English is spoken - but that’s ok - we’re in Japan after all. However, two members of staff on the Hollywood Dream ride had the potential to ruin the whole day. Two separate incidents too. Four of us decided to do the singles line to speed things up. My 11yo daughter was fine with this and is a chilled kid. We decided that she’d go in the middle so an adult could be waiting for her. As she placed her bag in the locker at the side she was told she couldn’t and then directed to a full locker. Confused as she couldn’t see where to put her bag - she was shouted at. She then was instructed to put the bag where she was originally going to. She then got told to take something off her head. As she wasn’t wearing anything except a braid that is part of her hair (plaited in and tied back) she again was confused. She was shouted at again by this staff member- she left the ride quite upset.  Same ride - I was asked by a number of staff to remove a bandana prior to the ride. Having been on a previous one I was expecting this. I stated I would remove it at the bag locker and at least 3 staff members smiled and accepted this. I lost all my hair following treatment- it’s not a fashion statement- my hair has grown back super curly and is at a stage where it’s in between. I’m self conscious of this - but I also accept their rules. One staff member would not accept that I would take it off when I put the bag and other belongings that were still in my hand in the locker. He demanded I take it off there and then. I was still in the queue. I was so upset I completed the ride choking back tears.  We be tried to contact the park directly but as I’m not able to felt that it would be part of my review. Such a shame as other members of staff were amazing - server in Harry Potter world for example.  Universal Japan. Please remember that people have paid good money to come to your site, most are either on holiday or enjoying family time.
It was a very nice experience, but the people there would wait three hours for a ride. It was also quite crowded and the food was overpriced.
The tour gave us efficient time to explore each location. Amazing tour guide, Levin was very informative and friendly, did a great job.

This is a detailed review and ideally I would have given a score of 4.5, as there are some issues. Ultimately my journey in USJ was so wonderful at the end that it is a very personal, 5-star rating.  First of all, I strongly recommend the 2-day pass (not express). If you're tight for time during your Japan stay, you can go for the 1-day express. My friend and I did a lot in 1-day without express (8:30-20:00), but it is impossible to do all of it without express. However, the reason I recommend 2-days is because, for me personally, my time in USJ felt like a lifetime. To be able to return for the second day really enhances your experience.  Second, definitely arrive early. I won't guarantee any gimmies if you do, because even at 8:30 there was a 50+ minute wait for the minion ride, which appeared to be the most popular ride during our 2-day visit. Though this is preferable to the 120 minutes wait during the day. Also, try to stay until the end. The park has a different feel at the night-time; looks beautiful; and when you reflect on the 12+ hours that have passed, you really do feel like you're a part of the place.  Third, beware of lunchtime! This is a big complaint that I have in USJ. Waiting for rides is one thing, but you can overcome this with a phone and battery bank, or a nintendo DS/handheld console. Waiting for food is, in my opinion, not acceptable. This is something they definitely need to address. We were there at the beginning of August, so lunchtime isn't just about eating, it's about shelter. You can smuggle in a couple sandwiches in the bottom of a deep bag, but in the end, you'll need a bite to eat at some point, and if you're doing a 8:30-20:00 stay, you're going to need a rest! I can't offer tips here, the diners were jam-packed anytime between 12:00-15:00. I'll I can say is - expect it.  Fourth and finally, do as much as possible! If you do the 2-days, definitely watch some of the parades, the water shows (minions and the stunt Waterworld show). Mix it up a little! The rides are fun, but there's plenty other attractions on offer. Some attractions are intended for kids and family, but the adults will still enjoy those attractions to!  Overall, in my 25-day trip across Japan, the 2 days spent in Osaka's Universal Studios Japan, is one of my favourite memories!

While some of the rides were thrilling the waits were simply too long. Up to 75 minutes wait for a ride that was only a few minutes long. Given the summer heat, the waits were almost unbearable.  Also we had purchased express passes for some of the rides but my teenage children could not use the passes as they were above the size limit for those rides. We were not informed of the size limit at the time we purchased the express passes at the counter.  Some of the rides such as Jaws were simply outdated.

Universal studios it was nearby the city. If you stay around Osaka station. It only take around 30 minutes to there.  During summer holiday time the theme park soooo full, even we got the ticket we also need wait around 10-15 minutes to get inside  Highly recommend purchase the fast pass, otherwise you may need to wait for 120-180 minutes for hot items such as spider-Man Harry Potter.  Lucky I got the fast pass for those hot items.  Theme park have some show around every 2 hours, the guest can watch the show and have fun together, especially the minion water show. So nice to have some water fun in that hot summer time.

I went there to hang out with some friends and because it is very famous. Some 4D movies (we saw ~2 of them) and a water live show were really good;  I bought a basic adult ticket for 9000¥ (10000¥/90€, including transport to get there) which I find it very expensive though: long queueing times, everything (except fairground attractions included in ticket and the toilets) lead to spend more money: not just toys or food but practical things I would have expected to be free, eg. I had to charge my phone (my mistake). For that I had to go to some machines that make you pay, and that were not easy to find. charging it to 40% cost me 600¥ (6€).  But for those who like theme parks like this, a simple tip. Worth going when it’s raining because there are fewer people and queuing time is much shorter.
The theme park seemed dated with attractions from movies now quite a few years old. The express pass was over priced for what you get out of it.
Some great attractions here, the Harry Potter ride is superb. However the amount of people admitted daily is huge making it difficult to see a lot. Go early and stay late will be your only chance

i found this park to be one of the best universal parks that i have been too. If it is a hot day please take sun screen and plenty of Water as it was a hot day on the day i went and i got burnt. Please pace your day out and perhaps do the ride ride that you really want to do earlier in the day with less crowds as i went on a Saturday . As the day went on the park got busier . Find a cool place around 2.00 pm to sit and claim you space for the afternoon parade and just watch the world go past people were dressed up in costumes which made it fun to watch and the parade was interactive with the crowds and unlike a park that has a mouse were the staff forced people to sit down the staff here wanted the people to stand and get involved . I was mad at myself for not seeing the evening parade as from what i have seen it is awesome but i had only one day here and i was tired and sunburned by 6.00pm when i left but maybe get there early do a while bunch of rides in the morning find a cool place to rest for a while and then do some more and rest so that you get to see the night parade.  I want to come back here

We have visited Universal Studios in Florida many times so it was slightly nostalgic to be visiting an almost identical layout in a foreign country. The newly opened Minions Park Area was brilliant much larger than that in the USA. We were there on what was classed as a quiet day so didnt bother with the express pass which can be very expensive. We managed most of the rides within 5-10 mins using the available single rider queues. Lines for Harry Potter and the larger coasters were in the 60 min range and due to a thunderstorm unfortunately these closed down for a period so we missed out doing these. You can choose to just do the Castle walkthrough for Harry Potter if you dont want to ride the Forbidden Journey. Jurassic Park, Spider Man, Jaws and Minions we all managed twice. I would highly recomment the WaterWorld stunt show too it was great to watch even if you didnt understand Japanese. Lots of dining options including Mels Diner although I would advise booking if you want any of the themed restuarants the queue for the Happiness Cafe was over an hour long at lunchtime. Lots of different merchandise to choose from too. Very easy transportation from the Centre of Osaka we took the Universal City Train to the station and it was literally a 5 min walk into City Walk and then the park. Great Day all round. Once you leave the park you cannot re-enter so I would advise eating beforehand as it can be pricy inside and then head to City Walk on your way home.

Excellent theme park, much enjoyed my time here. Being a theme park, F&B items are going to be a bit more expensive, but it is not outrageous. I spent 3800 JPY on lunch for 2. The rest are all on you, water dispensers are available throughout the park and resting areas are plentiful.  Some tips: Be there early: We were at the park at 0735 which was 1 hour ahead of the park opening and there were already long queues with hundreds upon hundreds of people waiting. The gates opened earlier than expected at 0810 instead of 0830 however.  Get an express pass: You will need it to avoid the crazy long queues. Queues can be extremely long at popular rides. I was a single rider on The Flying Dinosaur, entered the queue showing 35 minute wait and eventually waited slightly more than an hour. I finished the ride, looked at the queue board. Normal: 120 minutes. Single: 110 minutes. You can figure this yourself.  Consider planning a rushed start where you're moving fast and running and hitting all the big attractions/rides before the crowd comes. Then tuning down into relaxed mode once you've cleared those rides. Refer to above express pass comment. This also works in favour if you already have an express pass because you will need to make choices on what rides do you want to use your express pass on. For example, we did the Harry potter ride using express pass. We had an option of using the express pass for Jaws which was the next area, but we queued for it instead as the queue was "only" 30 minutes and saved the pass for Terminator.  Some ride review: The Harry Potter ride was excellent, but one tip, lean forward and rest on the shoulder rest. I thought I wanna sit back and relax but my view was partially blocked until I leaned forward and my ride became better. It is nevertheless an excellent ride. You will need to stow your baggage in the provided lockers.  Terminator 2: 3D This is definitely worth your time. 30 minutes of a sit-back-and-enjoy show.  Spiderman 4k Upon reaching the end of the queue and seeing the ride, I asked myself: "Is this recycled from Transformers?" I didn't find this ride enjoyable not because the 3D glasses were constantly being knocked off my face from the movement and I had to hold on to it all the way, but it was really just bland for me. Transformers was much better and I really think this Spiderman is recycled from Transformers but I could be wrong.  I didn't do the Minion ride as our express pass was for a very late timing and my partner was very tired. So we left early. It's a great place to visit nevertheless albeit the expensive express pass.
Provided whole day of fun for the whole family. It’s a shame that the Express Pass are more expensive than the actual entrance ticket.
Regardless of queuing which is normal for USJ, it's a happy moment and i did enjoy it a lot for my first time visiting.

Went to Universal studios on a Wednesday hoping for smaller crowds but seemed like everyone had the same idea.Had a good time especially the Harry Potter experience.Real value for money if you are prepared to wait in the queues.Further it was easily accessible rail from Osaka station.
The VR ride got me nauseaus! Im getting to old for these type of rides. There needs to be better warning about the possibility of getting very sick on that ride.

The weather that day was raining consistently and we are unable to do much activities.  The rides are much more fun that the ones in Universal Studios Singapore.  The food and souvenirs are cute but expensive.  It would have been better if there was English speaking personnel at the various counters.  Overall, it was a very fun experience we had even though it was raining.
We enjoyed ourselves at the Park. It was Halloween and the parade stopped for a few minutes for everyone to dance along, great fun, although the parade was a little short.

I dont know how to explain this place but this place is very crowded and I can not enjoy or ride anything. So many people at this place and use many character as haloween season. Even I come from the opening this place but I can not ride anything because its long queing.

We took our children (aged 6 and 8) to USJ on a Tuesday in early October and had the most wonderful day. We booked tickets online and arrived at around 11am. There were no lines for entry at that time and we went straight through. I'm glad that we didn't arrive earlier. We had read that the lines for rides were long, so we weren't surprised that we had to wait a while for some of the attractions. Overview of some of the rides that we went on: - Harry Potter and the Forbidden Journey: Easily the best ride that we went on. We lined up for 35 minutes at 11:45am but we managed to ride it another three times without a queue at 6:30 pm! - Minion Mayhem: We lined up for around 45 minutes. I thought it was pretty average and not worth the wait but the kids enjoyed it. - Spiderman: Another crazy long wait and they hide the queue around corners. Not worth it if you have young kids. - Jaws: Exciting little river ride during which the host pretends to shoot her gun at sharks. 6-year-old LOVED it. -Jurassic Park Ride: Holy Moly. I was expecting a flat river ride with a few 'scary' dinosaurs and a bit of a wave at the end. I was NOT expecting the very steep ascent and rollercoaster drop that preceded that wave. EEEEEK! - Flight of the Hippogriff: Quick little rollercoaster (long queue). Kids loved it. - Snoopy ride: Nice for little kids- not worth waiting in a big queue for. - Elmo Skateboard: Our kids LOVED this one. Queue was never long. - Elmo(?) Cars: Very slow kiddy 'racing' courses. There is one for 3-5 year olds and another one for older kids. Our 6-year-old loved it.
We had no plans going to Universal Studios but ended up here, fun, loud and everyone gets dressed for the occasion.

I have been to USJ for 3 times, and each time they changed some attractions which makes it very fun to go to. However, was disappointed the last time I was there when I bought express pass to go to Lupin the 3rd, but the show / game was closed and they simply assigned me to any one of the old attractions that they have. I mean this is really not a compensation if you were going to the park for that particular show / game... hope they can have some improvement in the future...
get an express pass to avoid waiting in queues harry potter ride amazing [hang on ]big crowds so pace yourself , see jaws ,jurrassic park,waterworld ,and the zombies walking at night

We bought our VIP passes. Picking up the bracelet from the 16th floor of the viewing tower was no problem. Also finding out the exact opening time of the park for tomorrow went very well (07:00 in our case). On the day itself we were 25 minutes before this time at the meeting point Studio West entrance. The queue at VIP was a bit shorter than at the normal entrance. But ALL entrances were opened at the same time. The VIPs were NOT admitted earlier than the others. Is the VIP ticket worth it? Yes, because you know the exact opening hours and can plan better how early you want to queue. But you don't get in earlier than people with normal tickets. For the Harry Potter world you don't have to get a time ticket in the park so early in the morning (at least not before 09:00 a.m.). We could complete the main line at Harry Potter 3 times without queuing. It was totally worth it - a great experience! After 09:00 the park get very full (we visited the park on a monday).

Today was my daughters 10th Birthday. I have patiently and methodically planned the days outing as a surprise which has been expensive and at times stressful with language barriers and pre paid tickets being absolutely compulsory. Last week we attempted to visit Disneyland and it was sold out. Long story but could not risk that happening on my daughters birthday today. But pre paid tickets and express passes once in Japan and without access to a printer or translator is not that easy. Be patient. Allow yourself lots of time to read all the reviews and tips on what you need. Don’t pounce on the first ticket sale you come across. Some do not allow an upgrade if you decide to get the express pass - whereas you may have got a package to include that with the ground pass. EXPRESS PASS IS A MUST. It’s the Business Class of Theme Park experience. Not in a conceited way but after spending biiiiig money on the bullet train and knowing it was going to be a 14hr day it was well worth being able to walk through without a queue. Ohhhhh it was well worth it! I’m still not entirely sure exactly what I paid for as I tried to get Express into something and it didn’t count and I thought I bought the top level Express but I really only wanted to make sure we got to Harry Potter without a queue. For that you only need an express pass if you are doing the rides. Diagon Alley is open to everyone so if you only want to walk through the castle and not do the simulated ride don’t worry about an Express pass or timed entry. It only takes about 5 mins. The staff at the park were fantastic. Well organised and friendly. My daughter had a birthday sticker we got at family services and everyone made a fuss when they spotted it. You do have to push your way through to get photos with characters as many adults line up and as they are dressed up so attract attention and get in front of the children. We got better at that as the day went on. Harry Potter world is great!! Definitely eat in the Hall!! What a fabulous set up. Find your way through the shops and see if there is a sorting hat etc. we got a little rushed as it was raining and cramped. The park is a great size to easily walk around many times in a day. Good level of rides and attractions for younger and older children.

We are not Harry Potter's fans, but we really enjoyed "Harry potter and the Forbidden Journey", this is now our #1 ride....  The other ride, "The Flying Dinosaur" Lol... at some point, we thought we are going to black out...  The third "flying experience" would be "The Amazing Adventures of Spider-Man"... Fun!!!  Great day out!

We got 1.5 days pass which allow entrance from 3pm on Day 1 & Full day on Day 2. Day 1 was Monday, and there were a long queue to get enter. Despite being weekday & non school holiday / public holiday, it was really crowded. The popular rides waiting time was 100 mins, but waiting time reduced later in the afternoon. Day 2 was less crowded than day 1.  The pupular areas are Harry Potter & Minion. Harry Potter 4D rides was the best with Dementors & Snitch games & whomping willow factored in the rides, we loved it so much that we went twice. If you're not adventures type, there is a separate queue just for castle tour. Unfortunately, the characters speaks only Japanese, but still, highly recommended for Harry Potter Fan. Best to get there at night, as you get to see the laser show in front of castle.  Minion rides was cute. Nobody can resist the charm of Minions. Everyone either have the minion popcorn or minion soft toys or just minion shirts. Highly recommended the popcorn as it is way too cute to pass.  As we visited in October, there was special Halloween event at night. There were staffs dressed up as zombie walking on street & scaring the visitors. There were also many local (Japanese) visitors dressing up as zombie as well added to the whole experience & fun atmosphere for USJ.

It was a good decision to get the one day pass via online as it saved a lot of waiting time to get into USJ. It was a Thursday which was supposed to be less crowded but it was still packed with people even though it was raining for the whole day.  Bought the express pass. Even though it’s quite costly, it can really save a lot of time for the rides. Harry Potter ride was the most enjoyable ride. The express pass does not allow re-entry so we went to queue for another ride. Waiting time was closed to an hour.  Minion ride was quite good too. Spider-Man ride was so-so. Quite disappointed with the terminator show.  Overall it’s an enjoyable trip, minus the rain.

Weather is great here! Just in time for the Halloween night and almost everyone is “dressed to kill” or frighten you! An absolutely fantastic experience especially when we visit at this time. Getting here is quite a breeze just a total of 7 stops from Nippombashi station!

Went there with my 14 year old. Universal Studios offers a great experience if you are Harry Potter fan, Jurassic Park and Minions aficionados. I heard the crowds are crazy big so I bought an Express 4 ticket (wanted an express 7 but it was sold out one week before my visit date). I was there on a Sunday.  Arrived at 9am and the park was already bustling. My daughter and I rushed to the flying dinosaur and the singles line had a 100mins waiting time. Normal line was 220mins long! But the ride was great lasting 2 and a half minutes.  I had express passes for Jaws, jurassic Park, minions and Harry Potter. With passes, the wait time is about 15 to 20 minutes.  Managed to get on the American dream ride. 2 hour wait. I guess its all in the fun of being together. I saw many groups of young adults dressed up in their favourite characters chatting and posing for photos. They didn't seem perturbed by the long wait.  Food and drinks were expensive.
