I I would recommend you go there just for this ride. We had to wait for an hour in queue to go inside on a weekday, but it was worth every single second spent waiting.  Madagascar was skippable and a few others are OK.  Going through all rides in this place will take a at least two days.  I would recommend you visit the place on a weekday if you actually wish to cover every good ride in a single day.  Please take an express pass if your budget allows so that you can skip all the queues. this will save at least 4-5 hours of your time spent inside universal studios.  Please book a whole day and definitely visit this place.  This was at least my best experience in Singapore.

it was my second time in Universal Studio Singapore but the excitement got higher than the first. It was Saturday, so a bigger crowd is expected. I suggest you take the Sentosa Boardwalk in going to the USS for more fun and excitement...it may be quite long but the walk will surely be enjoyable. Just like what others say, I recommend that you get the express pass especially if you're with your kids, so you can save time from queueing as it may really take long especially during weekends.  One should never missed the Water World Theater - a "live" water show with death defying stunts and explosions - check for the schedule of showing so you can catch them up. Just make sure you are equipped with raincoat and extra shirts especially if you wish to occupy the front seats - I bet you will really get wet - real fun!!!  All of us enjoyed the Shrek 4D Adventure experience and the Transformer 3D effect....whoa!!! As if you are experiencing the real thing.... you can't help but to say one more please!!! Sad to say, no photos please :( .... they have installed camera on the journey - either your eyes are closed or you are amazingly shocked! hahaha...  The kids will surely enjoy the Sesame Street Spaghetti Space Chase and Madagascar Crate Adventure. There are surprises in between journey.... plus the Sesame Street Characters are there to entertain you a lot. You are free to take photos with them.  Not to be skipped also is the Lights Camera Action hosted by Steven. It is an attraction everyone would be thrilled to witness as it makes you experience of witnessing a motion picture special effects come to life.  The Revenge of the Mummy attraction is actually a high-speed roller coaster that includes sudden and dramatic acceleration, climbing, tilting, dropping, and backwards motion. You have to grasp your breath afterwards.  There are a lot of other attractions which both the kids and adults will surely enjoy including the Parade of Characters and Fireworks - make sure you have checked the schedule so you will not miss the event.  Hey don't miss to take photos on various vintage cars displayed in the streets of Universal Studio. Feel like a star!!!  As a whole, I should say that the Attraction Fee / Pass you paid is truly worth your money... The Day Pass includes Discounts from the Universal Studio Souvenir Stores and S$5 Meal Voucher you can used in various restaurants / food establishments you can find inside USS.  Have fun... experience the Universal Studio Singapore. It may be small compared to other Universal Studios in the world but the fun and excitement will always be there!!!
A must see place at Singapore ...Dont miss the Transformer which is the highlight of Universal Studio...

look - its a must do - but the biggest ride (battlestar) was not working, and the mummy ride kept breaking. its a small park so not having 2 major rides work was a bummer. I thought the entry fee for the size of the park was crazy expensive. having said that we got the express line pass which was like 50 SGD but i am glad we did it - people were queuing for 80 minutes and we got on and off in under 5 minutes. Given the heat - it was worth paying the extra, but having said that i thought the whole day was very overpriced. But again, when are you going to head to singapore again?
Save your best day of vacation with family and friends in Singapore for this place. Loved the Transformers ride, if you have kids with you then its a must visit. Don't miss it !!
I liked the roller coaster and specially the Red one was fantastic. I suggest to take the premium access.

We were staying in the Festive Hotel on Sentosa so it is very convenient to get there.  It is not a very huge theme park but that's very enough for a 1-day visit.  The transformer ride is great with very real 3D visual and the Jurassic Park ride is exciting which is out of my expectation!

A very nice day, accessed by MRT, one can cover the Universal Studios therme park in less than a day. Don't miss Transformers, the ride. Park is actually cleaner thasn either Osaka or Orlando tho a bit smaller. Garrett's Carmel corn shop is just outside the park gate, as is Hersheys' Chocolates; everythng US and authentic.  Bring your passport to the casino and enter free (same for Marina Bay Sands Casino. Singaporeans and Permanent Residents must pay SD$100 to enter. You gotta pay to lose your money; is that crazy or what?  Many other shops too.  By the way, seniors enter Universal for half-price (about $32 USD) and no parking fee; just a $2.00 monorail ride (round-trip) and no tram ride either.

The cost for seniors of $28 was very good value as it gives you access to all the rides and shows. We spent 5hours here and the longest Queue time was 30 minutes. The Transformers ride is that good we did it 3 times. The last time we went as single riders and it cut the queue time down to 5 minutes. The food options inside park are not that good better options at Sentosa beach.

The transformers ride was one of the best rides I've been on and lights camera action was well worth going for.... Apart from that there were few other rides that were really nice well worth visiting....

Had a very great time at Universal Studios. Rode just about every ride and found two that I liked the best; Mummy and Transformers. Mummy is an indoor roller coaster that is in the dark so you can't see the drops and turns coming. Transformers is hands down the best 3D ride I've ever been on. I just wish the Battle Star Galactica ride had been open during my stay. We even waited until the end of our trip to go to the park in hopes it would eventually open... In any case, this was a great way to spend the day!

Our USS experience was FUN! We came on a relatively lean day so the queues for the rides were okay. Best rides for me were: Transformers, Return of the Mummy, the junior roller coaster in Far Far Away and the Steven Spielberg studio.  The Waterworld show is a must-watch! I also loved the Rockafellas Streetdance Show!
find the Singaporean staff if you get something problem, they more welcome, responsive and solving the problem better than other.

We all enjoyed our day at Universal Studios. The big roller coaster was out of action and there was another ride that was having problems. September was a great time to go. We didn't have to wait any more than 30 min for a ride. Overall we had a nice day.
Happen that i bought a promotional token for entering to the Universal studio. I really enjoy myself. The decoration was great as well as The rides
Do not forget to visit Sentosa Island and Universal Studio :) when you travel Singapore Many rides and experiece zones such as Transformer were attractive for me

We bought the half yearly season pass. Great rides, but the roller coaster was closed the entire 6 month up till now. The pass offers some discounts in the restaurants too. Place is clean & well maintained. It has a baby room in the season pass application office (near the entrance). Tips for parents with strollers: Rent a single or double stroller inside (it has your name on it) to prevent stroller theft if you plan to park your stroller while going for rides.

good fun, but its worth paying the extra 40 $ when you arrive(Turn left to guest services ) to get priority lines. This is much faster than waiting in the standard lines but costs more, $40 to get priority once for each ride, $60 for all day priority on everything. If you have priority you can do most of the park in a few hours and have a good time rather than spend 45 min in a line for a 60 second ride. The water world show is also great.

Plan your day accurately so you can enjoyed all the rides well as you might end up losing your time by waiting. Line up in single lane is MUCH faster (even you are in grouping) Prepare extra clothes Wear comfortable shoes and clothes (NO WEDGES recommended)

Not happy. Went here today and paid $280 for family of 4 only to find some of the rides including two main roller coasters were not operating. If you have ever been to Universal in LA or Orlando don't bother going to this one. It is 1/4 of the size and rides were a lot shorter. A total waste of money and a huge disappointment for our kids.

This was easily the highlight of our holiday. The rides were fantastic our favourites being the Transformers 4D Adventure and The Mummy. There was lots of photo opportunities with characters in each of the themed lands. The food was quite good and not overpriced and loads of souvenirs to commemorate your visit. Would have gone a second day if we had more time.

Visited on a Saturday as was told this was the preferred weekend day to go. So many people there, was elbow room only. Two of the major attractions were closed ???? So that made the $75 entry fee very exorbitant and I felt ripped off. Don't even contemplate the fast food as it was old and tough and the girls serving looked like they would rather bite your head off than say a nice word. Old themes and shows that were dated 15 odd years ago "water world " seemed strange for such a cutting edge country that is up with the first of everything. Certainly not an experience that I would like to repeat and there are so many more interesting things to do in Singapore. My advice don't waste your money!!!!

$74 for adults and $54 for kids,from memory. Not a good start when we had to line up for well over an hour just to get a ticket. We were sweating and impatient before we even got in. I can't understand why they don't put more staff on. There were only 3 ticket booths open, yet they gave the facility to open more than double that. There are 7 lands to explore, each with a different theme. It's basically food options, merchandising stores, then a ride, then more merchandising stores etc. The lines for any rides are just ridiculous. You can pay a extra $50 I think to get an express pass but I'm not a big rides kind of person so didn't think it was worth the extra money. Each 'land' is set out really well it's impressive to look at, but it is just so jam packed, you end up feeling like sheep,shuffling along. If we went again we would probably buy tickets online prior (doh!!) and get there a bit later as it is open until 7pm. Having said that we still spent 6 hours there and that was only with 2 rides.

Perfect amusement park. Good value for money as there are numerous attraction for kids. The feel of the mist around the fountain highlighting Universal Studio at the entrance was amazing n gives the cool effect. The cartoon characters shaking hands with kids n giving a warm gesture throughout attracts kids a lot. Least but not the last the 7 d rides ,different rollercoaters,road shows,characters like Charlie Chaplin....attracts a lot.The most beautiful was its infrastructure which was Very architecturally built.

On the day of entry, we were told the park would be closing early. Why? A corporate function; the whole park gets booked out, meaning full-paying patrons like ourselves miss out.  Rides and attractions are great, but queues are long and time-consuming -- but they do have a "legal bribe system" I mean express-pass ticket where you get to queue-jump certain rides and attractions, which we took advantage of to maximise what we could do in our time there. Good for us, but it certainly upsets other tourists.  It was good until the heavens opened and it poured and poured, meaning we missed a lot of time doing things. Doubled up on the lost time we'd have with the park closing early.  Pretty good overall, but would have been better had we had a full day there.

All-in-one experience.  They've got the unique and fun setting (and rides) in line with the different themes for different zones. A million photo opportunity for the locals and tourists. There isn't really any primetime for USS as the place is always crowded - whether it's the holiday season or not. So you gotta bear with the crazy queues. However, "cutting queues" will cost you a little more with the express passes.  They've got the food you most likely need to taste before leaving Singapore. (except that price may be much steeper than those delicacies you can find outsideof USS/RWS.)  It is easy to get there with the frequent shuttle buses (entrance fee of a normal bus ride) transporting you from Harbourfront Mrt Station to Resorts World Sentosa. You may also opt to walk (where entrance fee is $1),or alternatively take the monorail located at the topmost level of VivoCity (where entrance fee is now $4).

Before booking I thoroughly made sure that the closing time for Sunday was 7pm and the Hollywood Dream Parade and Lake Hollywood Spectacular would be shown (which it did) to my disappointment, this did not occur, due to setting up The Halloween Nights (would have been most appreciative if this was mentioned on the website). The rides were closed by 5:30pm. Other than that, the kids had fun, definitely a must to purchase the express ticket.

It is an excellent place to spend a full day. So travelers, if you want to do just about everything in Universal Studio- Games, Movies, food etc etc......half a day is not enough ( especially with kids who might want to do the rides again and again). Get in early, 8:30 am and you will get to enjoy every ride and every attraction on offer. Pity, during the time of our visit, some exciting rides where closed! Keep in mind, that there is a water park too....so please get a change of clothes!

I've been to other universal studios around the world, and this was the weakest yet. Rides are over the moment they begin. So short. The best rollercoaster was out of service while I was there, too. So that didn't help. Mostly, I just found all the rides way to short.

During our 10 day visit to Singapore, a day at USS was essential :) We were a travelling party of 4 adults, and 3 children aged 8,6 and 2.5 and spent over 10hrs there. We went there midweek, but it was still school holidays so it was quite busy but we still had fun. I would highly recommend you pay attention to the following tips/recommendations which I found helped us IMMENSELY in making sure we had an awesome time there :)  1. Buy your tickets ONLINE. Then when u get there, you can line up at the Online Ticket counter instead of the regular ticket counter which was insanely long. But the Online Ticket counter hardly had anyone there! 2. Get there EARLY. Not to just get your tickets but to wait at the gates. THAT line gets insanely long and if you want to make the most of your time at USS, you don't want to waste time waiting in line. Especially when small kids are involved. We got there just an hour early. 3. Get the EXPRESS ticket! Not the Unlimited One, but the One Go Express ticket. This allows you, for every single ride, to bypass the regular waiting line and wait in the Express Line. This was incrediably useful and I'll explain why in a minute. 4. As soon as you go through the gates, don't browse in the shops, don't stop to take photos with characters, go DIRECTLY towards the Transformer ride, which is THE most popular ride in the whole park. This ride is SO popular, the waiting time was around 2hrs+ by noon! But because we got there immediately the waiting time was only 15mins, so we went straight in. As soon as we got out, the waiting time had changed to 90mins!!!!!!! But because we had the Express Pass, we could go straight in again via the Express Line and only waited 5mins to go on the ride again (which is what our boys wanted to do coz they loved the ride so much). 5. The next most popular ride is the Raging Rivers one at Jurassic Park. We used the Express Pass for this, and waited no more than 10mins whereas the line for the Regular Line was soooooooooooo long! My biggest tip for this ride is take off your shoes and sit on them, they WILL get soaked! Don't worry about buying those waterproof coats because you'll just dry out throughout the day :) 6. I would highly recommend next to catch the first Waterworld show available, I believe that's a 12pm one. The reason why I say get it out of the way, is because if the weather suddenly changes, they DO cancel the show even if its mid-way through! That's what happened to us - we were watching the show, but due to a suddenly forecast change, they cancelled it midway and told us to come back to the next show. Now imagine if you waited til the LAST show of the day (I think 6pm) to watch it, and they cancelled it midshow THEN? You wouldn't have an opportunity to catch another show after. The show is fun, entertaining but loud so get ready to close the ears for the younger kiddies. And watch where you sit too, as some places have Soak & Splash Zones so you may get wet ;) 7. Other awesome rides is the Mummy Indoor Rollercoaster one, that's super fun! We went on twice, kids loved it. 8. I'd highly recommend saving The Shrek 4D show til very end, coz the last show is at 6.45pm. Whereas so many other rides have their last ride around 6pm, the Shrek one stays open late, so do that one last. Be careful tho when those doors open leading u into the theatre, don't stand too close coz they open SO fast and I accidentally caught my foot on it, and it scraped the top of my foot! SOOOOOOO painful! :(( 9. I highly recommend Lights, Camera, Action - but I have a big tip about that one....get in the FIRST row! When they first let you in, its just a movie montage with a little video by Spielberg. You don't have to be in the middle to watch that, stand near the door on the OTHER side leading to the main attraction. Because when that door opens, you want to get yourself a position right in the middle of the first row. Especially when you have kids, its the best place to stand :) 10. Rides I wouldn't recommend, even for little kids is this GoldRush one - its directly in front of the Mummy Rollercoaster ride - sooo boring, even for my 2.5yo haha 11. There are Live shows throughout the day and I recommend (if u have kids) the Sesame St one, followed immediately by the Rockfella Streetboys one (the breakdancing one). During the breakdancing, they DO call for volunteers, so get ready to be called if you want to be called up! My hubby got called up, and he's an ex-Hip Hop dance teacher so he absolutely loved dancing with the crew hehe :) 12. We were able to go on all rides and attractions except 3, so it really was a worthwhile day, but you gotta plan it well. Save all your shopping and browsing til the end of the day as you're heading out unless its something specific you want to be buy from a specific shop (for example the Transformers Shop). You don't want to be lunging all your shopping stuff around the whole day too.  Other great recommendations for travelling with children: 1. Make sure everybody is wearing good walking shoes and hats. 2. Pack light. Even if you bring a stroller, I'd highly recommend a backpack someone can carry over the shoulders not a bulky baby bag that has to be always hung from the stroller. 3. Get the kids to wear BRIGHT coloured shirts so u can easily spot them in a crowd. And before you go in, remind the kids about what YOU are wearing - tell them "Remember, mummy is wearing a bright blue shirt, daddy is wearing a red shirt"....so they also know what to look out for if they get lost in a crowd. 4. Every chance u get, do a toilet break, especially with kids involved. Also coz its Singapore and its quite humid, you will be drinking of water. You want to do toilet breaks often because they DO NOT let you leave the queue and return if you suddenly need to go pee! They don't let folks 'hold' spots too, so if your foresee a long waiting period, make sure the kids and yourselves hit the loo first. 5. The nicest restaurant is the one right in front of Jurassic Park. But it DOES get busy and if you have a large party, finding an available big table can be tricky. So I recommend a few people go get the food, while the others look for a table. Remember its okay to ask a family who are almost finished if you can have their table after they are done, that's what we did :)  Anyways overall, USS is a great attraction and can be thoroughly enjoyed if you plan it well. I hope my tips help others have a good time too :))

If you are going to Universal Studios ... buy an Express Pass for any amusement riders. You will spend hours lining up otherwise! The rides are great, especially the Transformers, Mummy Revenge and Jurassic Park Rapid Ride! Do not miss these. If you buy food, expect to pay through the nose - about $14 for a slice of pizza and a drink. This is a must visit for Singapore and you will have a great time. My hot tip would be to go through Madagasgar first and work around from there. If you enter through New York first, you will have longer lines. Don't forget to wear light clothing as it's hot and you will dry quicker if you get wet.

Always have a great time at universal studios singapore. Fab staff, great park and lots of fun. Love how it's decorated with each occasion Easter and Halloween experience at universal has been great. Would love to be in singapore for Christmas experience at universal as I'm sure the decor will be great

I couldnt believe when the guest relation officer credited back the 94 usd we paid for front line upgrade after a long day of rides.it wasnt crowded and I felt the payment wasn't necessary. Well done universal studios.
Had so much fun here. Really needed more than one day to see everything properly. The Transformers ride was Amazing!!! Did this a couple of times. Recommend getting an express pass we will next time.

Good place to have fun but need to bring large size of mineral water,foods,glasses,hat, and sunblock. Go for transformer ride first then after you finish all the rides you still have time for transformer ride again.

Absolutely brilliant day out, people amazing food great but cheaper to eat outside the studios than in. You get a stamp on your forearm so you can go in and out which was great. Lots to see and do the Steven Speilberg production was fantastic. Definetly recommend this place.

Very near to Harbour front MRT station. Pass through Vivo city mall & take broadway to reach there. You can get good bargains at China Town station (Peoples Park Center mall) for Universal center. Reach early at 9.30 am to be first to enjoy Transformer ride. Followed by this have a mummies ride in Ancient Egypt. Good food at food malls. There are many other rides to choose from. You can again enjoy transformer & mummies rides after 5 pm as the crowd become less. Overall if you want to spend 1 day with your kids, do not miss Universal Studios. Its a technical wonder.

Situated in Sentosa, the park is easily accessible by MRT and followed by Sentosa Express (monorail). Park is a little bit on the small side but this also means that it will give you a chance to go through every single ride in the park! An express pass is definitely good value as it enabled us to avoid the hour long queues on the Transformer/Mummy/Jurassic Park rides! Also watch out for show times for the Waterworld show which is fantastic, as well as all the time slots to meet the various characters too!

may inform by notice before purchase what are the program are closed instead waiting inside & when time reach walk over & was inform us it is closed, no signboard was stated or place it to inform tourist

We were there on a weekday and waiting times were manageable (The longest was 45min). It's different on a weekend. Once when we were there on a Saturday, we waited 80 minutes for one ride before getting the Express pass.  As USS is really small, it is easy to get from place to place and move quickly between rides and shows so if the waiting time was too long for one of them, it's easy to move to another one really quickly. Waiting times can vary a lot even within one ride at different times of the day. Some people in the group we were with waited 90min at Transformers in the late morning but we went at 1.30-ish and we only queued for 40 min.  There are signboards all over broadcasting the waiting times and show times. There's also an app that can be downloaded that shows waiting times. It's the official RWS app.  There really aren't that many big rides in the park. The largest roller coasters (Battlestar Galactica Human and Cylon) were closed. They are building another ride in 'Far Far Away' (Shrek's attraction). Looks like a roller coaster with a Puss in Boots, beanstalk theme.  Some of the more thrilling rides are: Enchanted Airways: Dragon shaped roller coaster at Far Far Away. Ride doesn't last very long. Canopy flyer: Seats are suspended from a rail above and we sit in seats with our legs dangling in the air. It's a VERY SHORT ride (But waiting times are relatively short too cos the turnaround time is so short). There's an area for people to leave their bags and things like their flip flops just before they ride but the bags are not secured or locked so it's not a good idea to leave valuables there. I left my diaper bag there and carried my small sling bag (with phone and wallet) with me. Jurassic Park Rapids: You will definitely get wet. Most people ended up buying $4 ponchos at the shops or vending machines. It's more fun to get wet though. Transformers: Entertaining waiting area with videos but the looping videos got on my kids' nerves a bit. The ride is of the 3-D simulator type but with lots of movement. It's really really cool! Revenge of the Mummy: This is really scary and disturbing for children cos of the skeletons, mummies, scary creatures, scary sound and imagery. Do not recommend for kids, even slightly older ones like 7-8 year olds especially if they are scared of skeletons etc.  Madagascar has the family-friendly rides ( Crate adventure and a carousel) and there's also a new Sesame Street Themed ride about spaghetti in space that's slow and suitable for young kids. Shrek's 4D show is great for young kids too. Treasure Hunters (Ancient Egypt) is also really tame and safe  For families with very young children. There are strict height limits on some of the rides (staff managing the queues will pull out children who do not look like they meet the height limit to measure them. Children below 90 cm have very few options and infant in arms have even fewer options for rides as even the most tame rides do not allow lap riding. (check height limits on website).  They allow child swap where one parent can watch the child while the other rides then parents can trade places without having to queue all over again. I think going on the rides alone's not that much fun though. Single riders can get in the single riders queue, which is much shorter so couples travelling with a baby or toddler and are riding alone may want to queue as single riders.  Was stormy for half the day but there were many indoor rides and shows so it was ok. However, it's important to have umbrellas or raincoats as there are no continuous sheltered walkways in the park. Rides-wise, apart from Enchanted Airways, Jurassic Park Rapids and Canopy flyer, everything else is indoors. Caught the outdoor rides when the storm abated.  Food is expensive and not that great. Met a family from Australia who said the food's really poor. Dining options are mostly fast-food like type restaurants (lots of fried, processed foods) but there are some local options. Drinks are expensive but water coolers are found everywhere (particularly at the queuing areas) so bring a bottle to fill up at the water coolers. I brought snacks for the kids as the snacks cost more than what you would normally pay for outside. There's a Ben and Jerry's scoop parlour at Far Far away that does milkshakes for $7.90 and single scoops for $5.50 which is about what you would pay for Ben and Jerry's outside the park anyway.  Visitors have an option to upgrade their 1-day pass to a six-month one by paying the difference between the one-day pass and 6month pass (6-mth pass $98 sgd) at the Guest Relations office which on the left as you enter the park.
Very entertaining! My daughter loves it. WIll come back again in a week day to avoid the crowd. what a fun day to spend!

Kids and parents had such a fantastic time! We booked tickets online beforehand saved lots of money and waiting in the queues. Rides were great suited to a lot of age groups which was great for us travelling with 4 kids under 9. Only downfall for us was its was very hot. Be sure to pack hats and plenty of sunscreen. You can hire strollers single & double which was very helpful with kids and bags. We really enjoyed our day out here. Do not miss the Waterworld show that was just unbelievable. We taped it and the kids love watching it over and over.

My favourite attraction was the transformers 4d ride as it was really so fun and realistic. The mummy roller coaster ride was really really thrilling.  Be sure to visit this place before the holiday/peak seasons as it can get pretty crowded. I had to queue for 1 hour for a ride when I came here during december last year.

Went to Universal Studio Singapore on a Friday school holiday last week. Took a cab ride from CBD and just cost SGD16. If you have 2 or 3 person it would be much cheaper and more convenient to get a cab. Started the day by having breakfast in Malaysia Food Street stalls. Most are closed at 9.30 am. Only less than 4 are open -- options included coconut rice -- nasi lemak stall, half boiled egg with toast stall. Very limited choices here -- but cheaper when compared with others. Went in straight at around 10am and went in to Transformer immediately. Only had to wait a minute or two and had the ride. Interesting experience and felt like almost hit by the bullets. And then went to the Mummy ride with just 1 to 2 minutes of queue. Fast and you will feel like you will get thrown out from the coaster. And then went to the Jurassic Park for the rapids ride but its still closed as it only open at 11am. So went back for the Treasure Hunt ride. Mainly for 8 year old kids and below. Had to wait for 10 minutes here though. Nothing interesting for an adult like me. And I don't think the 2 teenager in the driver seats enjoyed it too. Then went to the Jurassic ride. By then it was already 1130am and had to wait for about 10-15 minutes. Wore a raincoat. Nice ride -- especially trying to anticipate who might get wet. The water will definitely 100 percent enter the boat. So make sure you use sandals or pull up your legs(not comfortable at all). The chance for getting SOAK is about 1 person out of 6-7 person in the boat. Other than that, the others may just some sprinkle of water to the head/shirt and trousers here and there. Unfortunately at 1150am there was no UnderWater World show. It will only start at 1.30pm. Had to give it a miss as had to attend a meeting in CBD at 2pm. Went on to the Shrek3D -- nice experience at 12 noon. Done in 30 minutes time. Went on to the Steven Spielberg Light Action Camera -- ok experience. You can't feel the wind/water. Just can see only. Not really like in the movies unless you get a typhoon in Singapore island. Calling it a day by 1.30pm and rushed back for the meeting with the cab. Wished had more time to spend and not rush through everything. May come back next time in a few years time when my kids are older. Visited with my dad -- 74 this year. Nice experience for him.

Of course it's fun!!! Overpriced, commercial, tacky... But what else are you expecting? We had a toddler a teen and 2 adults. I'd say it was too much for the toddler. Think very carefully about buying the express tickets as the queues are horrid. One ride was a 70min wait! And the ride was probably a minute! The other thing that worked really well for us (and didn't cost) was to go home relax and then go back in the evening... After 7pm most people have gone home and there are NO queues - fantastic.... It's also cooler and quieter.

This place has something for everyone. Awesome rides for every age group. Our visit to Singapore would have been incomplete if we had missed coming to Universal Studio. Sharing my experience a little late (we visited in July 2012), but its never too late to share wonderful experiences in life!! Just need a good planning on which rides to sit and to skip :).. Guess we managed that well. Even my parents enjoyed Madagascar ride and The Jurassic Park ride. Transformer, Mummy Ride, Roller coasters all went well for us. May be we were lucky to have avoided the crowd. We didn't wait anywhere. Better to start early so that all major rides can be finished. Food is expensive inside, better to carry light snacks as its difficult to take rides with a full tummy :P. If you are a fun loving person, with stable health condition, love to take challenges-this is definitely a place worth visiting
Great place! I will surely come back here and experience the Transformers ride. I hope they have more ventilation/ACU in the queuing area of The mummy and Transformers.

The most sort after name in attractions isUniversal studios. But this one fell short of expectations. Tickets are expensive.Very small in terms of size and rides. Not many shows. If you decide to skip rides and only take a walk you can do that in 15 minutes, its that small. To take pictures with the minions or other characters you have only 30 seconds and they come out only for sometime. so if there is a big que then you get demotivated to even stand and watch them. Not much food options. All in all can skip this attraction if you have better things planned in Singapore.

Worth the tickets we had paid... our extended families enjoyed the rides and excited to see many of their favourite cartoons characters.... definitely a place worth coming again. Only setback was the "Return of the Mummies" was down midway and closed after we had queued for almost 30 minutes. The relevant operator should have given us a sort of replacement, maybe a discount voucher for meal or something like this, since we had paid for a full entrance fees.

This ride is better than anything in have done before. Would recommend to anyone. Only problem was we only went on it once, which was a bit silly. So exciting that there was a bit of wee. Could not speak afterwards for 5 minutes, as I was that excited.

As I have previously been to Universal Studio's in the States, my expectations for Singapore's one was high, I was very disappointed. The cue to get into the site even pre purchasing tickets did not give you any advantage. If you want to cue jump all lines on rides ect you pay extra on your ticket for the express line, Which is fine if you want to do that but for the cattle class... Wait, wait, wait. There were some characters walking around but not many..... I'm sorry to say Movie World in Queensland Australia leaves this for dead.....

Great time with the mrs and my 10 year old son.Was there during the first day of the school holidays.Expected the crowd...was there at 9.30am,waited for 1/2 hour before opening and off we went to Transformer ride! Rode on it 5 times (3 in first day,2 times on the second day).It helps to do some homework on the layout plan to save time and the hassle of queuing.  Forget about taking pictures until perhaps the last hour or so in the park....:)  As for halal meals, one can get out of the park and just a few meters away is a food court(unfortunately only 2 stalls which serves halal dishes ).  As for those staying in Sentosa,(we stayed at Movenpick hotel),there is always Vivo Mall food court at B2 (I think) where there is some delicious halal stalls...nice.  Great time...

I and my husband celebrated New Year at Universal Studios and it was an awesome experience. we reached the park around 11 am, and enjoyed the rides all day, and post sunset the part started with music, unlimited drinks and food. it was great fun and the new year arrivd with beautiful fireworks. a complete package i must say.

This is the second time that I have visited USS within 2 years. Going there is for the kids to enjoy the rides. As went there during beginning of school holiday, there wasn't a need for long queues and we finished all the rides and even had more than 3 rides with the Transformers  Though the entrance tickets are a bit high. But when there are lesser crowds, it is worth. Not to mentioned going there with a good weather

Great family fun day. Not sure who had more fun, us or my 4 year old son. We only had a day to spend here, and on advise of a friend purchased express lane tickets (expensive but worth it) to avoid long delays lining up. That was the best tip ever. Given that some rides were displaying wait of over 2 hours, it was wonderful to be able to bypass the queue and go straight to the front. Added benefit is that express lane patrons also get front carriages for the rides. Another tip is if you are a Kris Flyer member show your membership when purchasing tickets for discounted rate. Plenty to do and see inside. Lots of shade around the place. Food and drink plentiful but on the expensive side, but that is expected in Singapore and a theme park.
Not as big as in the US but worth to visit Even on a rainy day Mostly covered ways - but you can also buy a rain coat at the entrance (4SGD)

Easy access. Very clean. 2 x best rides were not working. Very clean, Entire place & all rides very safe. Staff all friendly. Rides work like clock work. Get speed pass or dont other going. VIP guide package gets you to front of each ride with no wait all. Most rides VERY shorts as in under 60 secs. Great food options. Do not compare to USA Universal Studios. This is on a scale of maybe 5% of those. Overall a nice day spent there but overpriced. If you are in SIngapore with kids and are not for the USA, you should considergoing.

Truly a bad experience. Entering Universal Studios, we were told that one of their best rides, the BATTLESTAR GALACTICA rollercoaster was closed. Upon entering Universal Studios, we headed for the first ride, MADAGASCAR: A CRATE ADVENTURE, for which the wait time was 35 minutes. After waiting, we found that the ride was extremely small and thrill-less and catered only for the younger market. I wish this was stated at the entrance to the ride, but it wasn't. After finding nothing for us big kids in the Far Far Away area or the Madagascar area, we headed to Jurassic Park for the CANOPY FLYER ride. Upon arrival we were told it was closed because of technical faults. (How can there be technical faults at an amusement park so popular?!) We went back several times but the ride was closed the whole day. We did the RAPIDS ADVENTURE ride (after waiting for more than an hour) and left. We did the REVENGE OF THE MUMMY ride once (after waiting for around 40-50 minutes) and left the Ancient Egypt area. At the Sci-Fi area, the wait time for the TRANSFORMERS ride was around TWO HOURS (!!!) so we left without doing anything. After which, we had lunch and decided to leave. Not only are the lines TOO long, but they always let Express or VIP members go first (without having them wait at all), while the rest of us stand for hours in lines. I don't mind letting disabled or elderly folk go first at all, but VIP members are neither of those. The food options are VERY LIMITED for vegetarians. Tourists beware! This Universal Studios is mainly for YOUNGER CHILDREN and families with infants. There is little to nothing for big kids and/or adults. The queues are too long for us non-VIP members. A total waste of $300! :(

The place is a experience in itself. The movies , the rides are just good. It's not very huge but it's quality. The que are really long may be we went at a wrong period of Christmas. One point to remember that is when you use the locker please give exact change as it will not give you the change back. The 4D movies are simply awesome. Must visit for all age groups

Firstly, the negatives - the two fastest rides were closed for the day, so we missed out on the real white-knuckle ride experience. Aside from that, it was superb. The mix of children's' rides, as well as the faster options made it a great day. It's all so clean too. Would recommend it to anyone going to Singapore on a family holiday - or like us, spending a week with my sister while she lived out there. We got taxis there (the only really cheap thing in Singapore) and back.

Worth the visit. Something I would do again. The express ticket is worth every dollar. My children did not want to leave. We went on all the rides numerous times. With the express ticket we stayed on the line 5 minutes at the longest. We always had the first choice of seats on the rides. I think the place could do with healthier choices of food rather than all the fast food and fried stuff. But then we may just be a little fussy. With one of my kids allergic to nuts.

We spent whole day in Universal - big territory, cafes, many attractions - my favorites MUMMY and TRANSFORMERS!!! In the morning and in the evening ques are not so big, but during day time without EXPRESS pass u'll waste lot of time!!! Disappointing was chargeable locker in Jurassic park - for the entrance fee you paid it must be free...and the best attraction - Roller coaster - was closed ....

This is one of the best places i have ever visited in my life. you go with some expectations and i assure you it will exceed your expectations. It is a place for all kinds of people starting from kids to elders all age groups will enjoy their journey here. The adventurous roller coaster rides are breath taking and one of a kind. we can never see such wide variety of roller coaster rides in any other place except universal studios. you would have never dream t that you can get roller-coaster rides in those format. you have lot of rides for kids. there are lot of events which will be appreciated by elders who are not willing to go for the rides. you have events featuring the best bands and great musical shows will be organised. you need one whole day(may not be enough) to cover this place. if you have come with family ensure you know about the rides well in advance before you get in there, the reason would be you can organize your trip accordingly as you have lot of events over here you definitely have to prioritize before you go. It costed us 80$. I assure you end of the day you will feel its value for money. your Singapore journey should not end without a trip to universal studios.

Alot was closed when we were there, and as we had a 2 yr old son the only "land" or area dedicated to him was Madagascar. We arrived at 10am and were gone just after 1pm. The waterworld show is great, i would say this is better suited to older kids / Adults. There wasnt alot for him as he was to small to ride most of the rides. It was still a good day out but quite expensive for what he was. Probably wouldnt go back now we have done it, however if your in Singapore its a good day out.
Great place, heaps of fun for older teenager. Great photos , great rides & a touch of Hollywood . Excellent day.

Did not disappoint! It was everything we expected. There were a wide variety of rides that both young and not so young will enjoy! The Shrek 4d show was hilarious and well executed. The Mummy ride was mind-blowing and great fun. The attraction where there was a movie soundstage simulation was super cool, one would think that they are really in the middle of an action-packed movie! Amazing place to spend a memorable day with family.

Used the Universal Express Pass. Managed to avoid the long queues. Allow a day to enjoy all activities. Reasonable prices for activities.  Tip - sunscreen, sunhat, water, allow heaps of time, good camera

A must in Singapore if you have kids. The rides are for all in the family though and very enjoyable. the terminator ride is amazing and certainly one of the best rides in the park. You will be amazed at the attention to detail. be prepared for long queues if you go during seasonal period.

Nice rides, although nothing of the extraodinary. If you start your visit right from the opening you'll have a chance to beat the crowds to most of the attractions. Should be kept in mind that some rides only open at 11 am. If there're aren't that many people, 3-4 hours should be enough to enjoy the park. Food is pricey but toys cost just as much as in the regular stores. Unfortunately, Battlestar Galactica rollercoaster was closed at the time of visit and there was no infromation as to when it's going to open again.

Went to USS with my sister and found out when we go there that the BIG roller coasters were broken/under maintenance :/ I believe if the coaster were open it would have been a better experience. However the main reason we went there was for the big coasters :( so that was disappointing, so if you can check to see if there are any rides out of order. Other than that the park was very interesting and the rides we did go on were ok, we're more of thrill seekers so I'm thinking it may be aimed more for kids. As you can imagine, everything on the grounds is very expensive, which comes with the territory. I actually had more fun at the water park in Sentosa.

No matter the age you are gonna enjoy it... what a way to recreate the Hollywood and the cartoon industry... absolutely delightful... mind blowing rides and amazing fun... Transformers was the best one... even Shrek was good...  IMP TIP:- Keep one full day allocated for Universal studios.. coz it takes that much time to enjoy it completely... U might wanna go with a kind of light footwear as there are a few rides in which they might get wet... but at the same time you need to keep in mind the long walks that you will have to do coz its HUGE...

One of our party had a dream to meet someone called Bumble bee. Who for people like me he is a mostly yellow Transformer. Well she has meet him and has photo to prove it. My sister loved the Madagascar ride best of all. But plenty to do and see several shows and eating place's. Also public convenience's plenty and clean. One thing to know is that you need to get off sky way at first stop going back as no taxis at bottom. Great day for kids young and old but like all theme parks be prepared for waits.

When comparing with Universal Studio Japan, Universal Studio Singapore did not have that many rides that are attractive. The Transformer is something you must try and we ride that two times. The good news you would understand all the language when compared in Japan that they have the rides in Japanese

Nowhere near as good as its US counterparts but a reasonable bet for a great day out for younger kids. For the older generations there is a dearth of white knuckle rides. The Mummy and Transformers – both of which can be found in Orlando – were the only two thrill rides the day we were there. There was also Galactica which unfortunately was closed. We had a fast past and if you are going to stay for the day I recommend it as the waits on some rides – including kiddies ones – can be 30 to 40 minutes. We were finished within two hours so at a cost of close to S$200 each it was fairly poor value.

The infamous USS well known for being overly packed all the time. Not wanting to risk wasting time queing we purchased the express pass for an additional fee of $20. It was well worth spent as we literally beat the long queue and managed to conquer the whole USS in just a day. Every rides gives an express entry once. The best ride of all would be the transformers ride. The mummy roller coaster was not too bad either. Hand carry and bags are strictly not allowed hence consider sharing a locker to safeguard your belongings. Stash some cash with you while you're at it. You can then proceed to the Jurassic park without carrying your bags as it's a wet ride. I suggest you bring your own poncho instead of purchasing it for $4 each. It's a definitely-get-wet-ride and do wear flip flops instead of shoe else you'll have it soaked. The waterworld show at 1.30pm is worth a watch and also a definitely get wet if you chose to seat at the front. The last two decks would at least be safe from being poured with buckets of water. We also managed to catch a few shows and the meet and greet session with Sesame Street. Sorry for the spoiler, it's meant to ease for those who's new so they don't waste time looking and finding for places and what to do. We even managed to catch the SEA aquarium tour after all the rides.

All parents having kids under 14 should take kids here !! Outstanding experience & lot of fun....Personally I loved the transformer game but all rides and all games are fantastic....just loved it. Can easily spend 12 hours....firecrackers show end of the day is breathtaking !!! Value for money !! Just go early....
The rides were really good. Just a shame the lines are so long for some of them. Favourite was the transformers ride. Definitely visit this place.

I really enjoyed all rides in here .. It's better to take 3 day pass ... Don't miss 4D movie transformer and mummy . It's better to skip Jurassic park , it was the disappointing one because waited more than 90 minutes for the ride and it was so boring , nothing exciting .....

We visited the Univ Studios last month. The place is great with great views of giant Merlion at Sentosa. The cable car trip was also awesome. The park itself is smaller compared to some of the Disneyland parks. The tickets are a bit high priced. But the rides are cool. Especially the newly added transformer ride. Rest of the attractions are ok. Restaurants inside are also costly.  Tips: if travelling with small infant, take your own stroller. Prams available inside for rent are jot so comfortable for kids. You can save ticket prices by buying it from some if the travel consultants outside Sentosa.

The universal studio Singapore consists of various zones some of them depicting famous movie series like Madagascar, Far far away, Jurassic park, Mummy, Water world, Hollywood, Sci-fi city and New York. Every zone is unique and offers exciting rides both for kids and adults.

On entering the premises of the universal studio start with the rotating globe. Several shows like transformers, Mummy returns, Lost world, Underworld, Nemo, soon. There are a variety of rides like Rolling coaster (Blue and red), then some interesting rides which children likes. It was a great experience.

Ok, the admission is expensive for a theme park that you could essentially walk all around in 35 mins. Also factor in the hefty extra you'd pay for the highly recommended Express line. Now put all that aside and focus on what there is. While the park lacked a killer outdoor coaster with Battlestar Galactica on permanent hiatus, the indoor Mummy Returns ride is awesome. As is the Dino River ride, Transformers and Shrek 4D (despite a tediously long intro). Do these four rides a few times and the cover charge feels like money well spent. For my youngster there's the Elmo ride, the Spinning ride, the Shrek roller coaster and the Madagascar ride. Good enough! Given its size you can easily pass 4-5 hrs here, though a full day may be less likely unless you really slow yourself down. And there are lots of other great attractions in Sentosa that also deserve your time.

Came here on monday, and it was a low season. As the gate opened on 10.00 am, we walked fastly to Sci-Fi City zones where Transformers The Ride is located, the queueing line isn't too long yet if it's still early. And as we expexted, we didn't have to spend a lot of time to ride the rides. Accelerator is the second rides we tried, just next to Transformers the Ride. As we finished this ride, we walked to Ancient Egypt Zone to try Revenge of The Mummy, and yes this zone has great building with amazing ancient egypt architecture which is great to be your photo background, but I suggest you to keep your camera first and board into the rides. As I said before, if it's still early, the queueing line isn't too long yet. Lucky for us, It was only need 10 minutes to us before we took the rides and (again) we didn't have to spend a lot of time for queueing. After that amazing rides, I turned on my camera and start taking our picture. And I still have much time to enjoy another rides.  I tried almost all the rides and shows : Canopy flyer, Dino Soarin, Jurassic Park Rapids Adventure and Water World on The Lost World Zone. Shrek 4-D Adventure and Enchanted Airways (an exciting junior roller coaster) on Far Far Away Zones. Madagascar : A Crate Adventure (river boat) on Madagascar Zone. Even some rides need to queue for an hour or more, we still had time to try Transformers and Revenge of The Mummy for a second time. And I still have much time to enjoy and took pictures on Hollywood and New York Zone and also bought some merchandise.  I always curious to try Battlestar Galactica, but unfortunately it was closed for unknown reason from 2013. I was disappointed about this, but It was still an enjoyable experience during the whole day.

The two largest rides were closed on a holiday? The park was well maintained but with a couple of the main rides shut leaves much less to do. Mummies Revenge was by far the best. Also remember this is Universal Studios without the Studios!

Bought the tickets from their own website but no mentioned of the maintenance date. Was really disappointed because the ticket was not cheap and universal studios was supposed to be our highlight of our Singapore trip.

A Must visit place. Tons of fun for all ages. Terminator, Mummies, Spielberg and Shrek. Surprisingly well done. Clean, neat and organized like Singapore is so good at. Remember to pay the extra for express. Worth every penny.
There's something to do or see for the entire family! You must spend the whole day here. Food is great!

The park currently has a lot of rides enough for a whole day fun. These rides however are quick and not that thrilling. People queue at most hours to try a minute ride and this is basically a waste of time. I believe that it would be more worth it if there are more thrilling rides so that people at least be distributed throughout the park. Though the number of guests will definitely go up but this will make the experience more worth it. The Canopy Flyer and the Lights Camera Action were my favorite. As for the ride where you will get wet, there are no free lockers in the vicinity so I suggest you leave your bags at the The Mummy lockers and get it back once you're done. Just make sure it won't be over 40 minutes to avoid additional costs.

Universal Studios Singapore is definitely worth a visit. From Jurassic Park to Sci-Fi City, there was plenty to see and great rides. Shame the best rides - the rollercoasters - were closed for annual maintenance! The Mummy and Battlestar Galactica rollercoasters were the rides I was looking forward to the most so I was gutted to learn they were closed. They should really advertise maintenance months on their website because if I had known, I would have chosen a different month to visit Singapore! Gutted but a great day out all the same.  One thing I don't recommend is the Treasure Hunt ride - it's not a ride. You go round a track in a wooden cart at a slow speed and see nothing for one minute - honestly it's not worth it. I am so glad I bought the Express Unlimited pass - totally recommend them to avoid the queues - because if I had queued for 40 minutes just for that, I would be pissed. Seriously pissed.

I took my 2 children aged 10 and 15 whilst my husband was working in Singapore. We went on a Thursday so it was relatively quiet and no surprises as we had paid for unlimited express passes. We all thought that the rides seemed a lot tamer in comparison to those in the States. There were only really 2 main adult rides excluding the Jurassic Park water ride. These were the Mummy which we went on 5 times and the Transformer ride - 3 times. The advantage of the express pass was that you never had to queue and you always went to the front of the ride which was excellent. The park was very clean but it just seemed aimed at selling you food or merchandise in the shops. When it boiled down to it there just were not enough "thrilling" rides. Apparently the main roller coaster has been closed a year according to a member of staff! It sits there as a reminder of what you could be going on and the whole area around it is closed as well. All said it was still a good day out and cost us approx £150 inc unlimited express tickets.
Visit to sentosa island and Universal studio is amazing and kind of must visit for travelers visiting Singapore as tourist or leisure.

Universal Studio's Singapore is much smaller than the one in Florida but still a fun place to visit. Enjoyed the shows on offer and the slower rides. A very memorable afternoon to be enjoyed by adults as well as children.

I visited USS with 6 of my friends. The ticket price was too pricey for me, but considering the effort for making a wonderful theme park, it's acceptable eventually.  - Transformers 4D = must see and experience! Transformers is one of my favorite films and experiencing this is like making my dreams come true (minus Megan Fox). - The Mummy Roller Coster = scare yet fascinating! Riding roller coaster in very dark tunnel (you can barely see a thing). - The Donkey Live Show = entertaining for both children and adults! The donkey's assistant (human) was very funny, also the donkey (animated in screen). - Shrek 4D = felt like live in far far away. - Jurassic Ride = you'll be very wet - Waterworld Show = the actors and effects was superb. - Steven Spielberg Live Effects (forget the name) = showed me how he created effects in film. - Madagascar Ride = for relaxing a bit after playing all day.  Unfortunately they closed Battlestar Galactica, huge roller coaster. I hope they will operate again.

The park can be easily accessed through the Vivo City MRT. The park is compact since only takes about about 15 minutes to go around the park but it has so many good attractions! For me, the best attractions are of course the Transformers and Revenge of the Mummy. Also don't forget to see the Water World show, a stunning show full with stunt performances. The souvenirs of the park are also a really nice one and make me can't stop shopping. Even the friendliness of the staff is standard, but indeed this park is really awesome!
Went with my colleagues. It was fun to see so many things together at one place.The exterior itself is inviting. You feel like being part of a new movie.. ;)

We went on february 26th, week day, off peak season. We bought transport and Tickets at the Harbourfrount mall (also harbourfront MRT). Everything was well organized and easy. Some of the "main" attractions where not available for maintenance reason. We were advised of this inconvencience at the tickets counter, yet didn't benefit from a discount :(. Could we blaim Universal for checking its installations ? Sure the information should be available from the internet site. Anyway we had a good time and hardly waited more than 15 min for each attractions available. We met Shreck and Fiona, the Mignons, some transformers robots . Well much more celebrities than we have ever met in Disney Paris in 1 day. Still, it is a bit expensive and won't take you more than 2/3 hours to get through.

Having been to Universal Studios in LA, I wasn't expecting too much from the Singapore version, but was presently surprised.  One of the most amazing things was before we even entered, finding out that the huge battlestar galactica roller coaster was down for maintenance. Because of this, they took TEN DOLLARS off the admission price!!!!! That's a first for me. I just came back a few days ago from the Gold Coast & although every theme park there has had multiple broken rides, I've never once been compensated EVER! (Gold Coast theme park reviews coming shortly). So well done for that Universal Studios Singapore!  Once we entered, we found many great rides, including the MASSIVE Madagascar ride, set inside a HUGE ship & perfect for the whole family. The Jurassic Park rides were completely different to the one in LA, but both were fun.  One of the best rides for sure, was the Transformers ride!!  I also really enjoyed the Waterworld show, where the set looked EXACTLY like the LA Universal Studios same show, so I felt like I was back there at that moment.  A great day for singles, friends, couples or families :)

Halfway through my visit, it started to rain a little bit and so the Studios closed down some of the rides, even when the rain had stopped; which was very disappointing. Apart from that the shows were AMAZING! Loved the Lost World show, and the Steven Spielberg show the most.

ok so give it a full day. you wont be able to finish all rides otherwise. they do not give any refund for bad weather so be aware of that. now the rides... well simply wow. from transformer to mummy to lost world, no shortage of fun. single riders get reduced wait time in some rides. if you have money, spend it to have priority pass. you will love it, your kids will too.

the rides were thrilling.it was an exhilarating experience.There were rides for adults and kids.If possible go on a weekday instead of weekend..on a weekend to avoid big queues we had to buy the express ticket
Dont miss the Transformers ride, best part of universal studios. Spend a full day here and enjoy the final parade event which is memorable.

This was the first time I took my kids to USS and they really enjoyed their day. Although it was a weekday it was still heavily crowded so after 3 pm we bought the universal express paying extra 50 dollars as we had to finish all the rides before the closing time. I wonder if others who didn't have the pass would have been able to finish all the rides with that crowd.
what an awesome day! such a great vibe and the rides were great. the only downfall is there are no thrill rides.

We had visited Universal Studio recently. Good part is that there are plenty of things. Bad part is that you need more time for same. We have done lot of riding. The most exicted was Mummy ridiing and Transformer one. However the "Hidden treasure" was very boring and adult can avoid the same. If you take express pass it will good, since you can save 30-40minutes in each place. The Madgasacar acitivities were very nice. They have danced and sang well, they really need applause. If you are tourist and do not have much time, you can start your day form 8AM reach at achtivity and try to stay till longer. SOme of the rides were there till 8PM some were close after 6PM. May be they can keep those rides open till 7/8PM.

If you're in singapore and not visiting Universal Studios, you're missing out a chance of a lifetime. Take a single day pass (for around 100$) and enjoy everything here at universal studios. The only problem here is there are long lines for all the rides and attractions. While one might get bored waiting in queues for their turn on rides or at restaurants inside, everything is worth the wait. The demos, shows, movies, rides everything is just spectacular! Enjoy!

Had a great time here and there is plenty to do. The transformer ride and the Mummy ride stood out for me but there was many more things happening in the park. We booked tickets from the hotel and therefore missed the queues and found the prices to be cheaper. Overall a great day out and a must for anyone that goes to Singapore no matter what age.

This is a must visit place in your life. Enjoy the experience and share the best captured moment with your besties is the other way to appreciate your friendship. Love the scenery and even though it started to rain heavily in the evening, we were able to finish the ride. Tips...just snap a picture once you pass the attractions as you might experience rain in the evening. Bring your own empty bottle to refill or you can just straight away drink from the water cooler. The sentosa express to vivo mall is free from the sentosa island. Consider to wear flip flop or flat sandal as you might want to avoid sore on your feet. Raincoat is a good item to bring with. Rent a daily locker and share the big one with your friends. Don't forget to bring pressed coin cost 2 dollar as your token from there
truly amazing for all ages must go as there is something or the other for fun for all ages. crazy rides, adventurous rides and fun atmosphere . must go ! and I will be back again in December

What a fun day!! Everything is so well done. The atmosphere was awesome. All of the areas were fantastic. The rides were so exhilarating. I would recommend paying extra for the express pass, it gets you to the front of the line at all of the rides. The food isn't that crash hot, but if you plan on going on heaps of rides you won't have time to eat anyway :) I also really loved the performance at Water World, that was really well done.

It is a full day world of wonder, excitement and education. Spielberg's world of movie effects (Lights, Action, Camera), Transformers (4 D world), Ancient Egypt, and real-life stunts in the Waterworld are just superb. There are many rides, and theme locations and actions for all ages of people. It is a make-believe world, rivalled perhaps only by the Disney World. Jaims KJ

I recommend tourists to go there during off peak season or secure fast pass. Wear light clothes and bring umbrella. Recommended attractions are the mummy and transformers. Have fun taking pictures with Sesame characters, Madagascar and other characters. Also, do not forget to watch "monster show". have fun!
Its a nice place to go with ones family and spend quality time. The assortment of rides are simply awesome and is for people from all age groups.

Universal studio is the best thing in Singapore. Its a must visit for every traveler. Your trip to Singapore is incomplete if you don't visit Universal Studio.  There are rides and activities for everyone... children, youngsters and elders.  Its amazing place....must visit....

afther paying 6 tickets and entered the universal,it started to rain. from that moment we found ourselves having to pay tickets for nothing,they closed all the games for 2 hours,even those reported because water enters from all sides
A great day out for young and old alike. Very impressed with the effort and lengths gone to to create the place, lots of fun! Highly recommended.

I was there with my parents as my partner could not make it. Rides were fun and if you are riding alone, make sure you use the individual lane as that's faster and you will get someone else partnered to ride with you on the roller coasters and other crazy rides. :)
clean and great environment. I enjoy every attraction they have there and will come back again with my nephews next time. thank you!
Came early in the morning and get in the rodes which attracts the most visitors the most: Transformers, Revenge of the Mummy, and the thrill roller coaster!
it was really awesome... but we spend an hour to be on line but not even 5mins on the ride... nonetheless, its a great adventure. we really enjoyed a lot! must see it again!
Rides good for all ages, best time to go is mid week then not needed to up grade to Expess ticket. Like the lay out of park, needed a few more water stations, and shelter from hot weather.
The rides there are great for people of all ages. The highlight for me was the Transformers ride which was awesome!

Must visit place for the family . Quite a large no. rides - should experience all the 7 theme zones the place is divided into. Family favorites were Transformers 4d , Jurassic park ride and Puss in boots which has been opened recently. Food options available though quality is average. Avoid weekends as waste a lot of time in queues.

Love Universal. Battlestar Galactica had just reopened which was the highlight of the day. We took the VIP tour and thought it was fantastic. Our guide Malek was infinitely patient and took us on all the rides we wanted. He rode a few with us too, which was brave considering Cylon turns you literally upside down ! If you get the chance to do Universal on a VIP tour you should. And ask for Malek. The guy is a total legend 😎

Once in a life time must visit place. Rides are amazing. The big galatica ride was closed. But all others amazing.  Very friendly and helpful staff. Big thank you for the great experience and the smiles to make our holiday special.
Don't even think of missing this during your trip to Singapore. Excellent place...all including kids will love the place. Very well planned and huge. Will get lot of opportunities to click pictures..

This was my second trip to Universal Studios, first one was at LA. Kids enjoyed the rides though the biggest roller coster was not working. It is very well planned and you don't need to walk much for rides. Overall lots of options to spend a day there. It is tiring but lots of fun for kids.

One of best experience. Me and my husband had done each and every ride. Attended all shows. It quiet possible in one day. Jurassic Park, Mummy and few other rides were very enjoyable. great place for kids.

A wonderful experience for each member in family. The park has a lot to offer to Kids and adults. Food and beverages are decently priced and much lesser than Zoo and Bird Park. Recommendation: buy express ticket if visiting weekend, would save lot of waiting time in queues to rides. Water show at Jurassic park zone was fun and entertaining.

If you visit Singapore then Universal Studios is a must. Buy a day pass and go on as many rides etc as you like as many times as you like. Sentosa is not so good. You can buy a pack of attractions but can only visit a single attraction once.

We ha a great time. We bought tickets right before the park opened so line was non existent. Since we have impatient children we all got express passes and we were glad we did! We had negligible waiting time at the rides which allowed us to enjoy the park thoroughly. We went in May and I can only imagine how even more handy the express pass would be during peak seasons! Didn't enjoy the new puss in boots ride so much (fortunately we didn't wait long thanks to the express pass, otherwise I would have felt it was waste of time!). We regrettably didn't get to ride the Star Trek roller coasters which opened a few weeks later (darn)!

It was a great theme park. The queues weren't too long either, most of the rides we were on within 5 minutes. The atmosphere was great, plenty of places to eat good food and enough seating around the park. Transport to and from the park was easy and cheap. Would love to go back again.
It was a thrilling experience in general, games and rides are very good and various, food is expensive though, and try wearing light clothes during summer, humidity will exhaust you!!!
Place is clean and the rides are fun! Food is quite expensive. Bring along a raincoat just in case for water rides.

Loved all the rides I managed to go on and everything I saw. As usual the lines for the rides are always too long but they are worth the effort to wait in them. Lots to see and do so go as early as possible and wait at the gates to be let in when it opens as you will need all day at least to see everything, maybe even the next day to finish off.
I have been to Universal Studio in Orlando, Florida, and this is my first time fir Singapore. It's quite smaller but still fantastic. I love all the games and shows, and will come back again.

Reached the island at around 11 am...decided to take the boardwalk... My advise is take the bus or the express.. Save your energy for later aa you'll need every ounce of it... Me.and my partner entered universal at around 12 ish and we're there till.around 6 we bought the express pass and we were so glad we did cause we still missed around 3 to 4 rides.. It was an amazing day... We had the time of our lives.. The mummy ride is the best... Don't even bother going for the treasure hunt total waste of time... Overall it'll always be an experience we will cherished 😀.

Right from the minute you enter till the end of the day....amazing. The rides as sweet as the madagascar, a roller coster, the best is the galatic red and blue ride....and not to miss the mummy egyptian rolleroster the biggest surprise. The 4d transformer ride was out of this world. Keep munching n corn dogs, fish n chips, turkey legs, star balls ice cream....and lotsa shows.

We visited here on what felt like our hottest day in Singapore yet with our 2 children (7 & 5). We didn't get to the park until 12 as we did the indoor skydiving first. My biggest advise is to take frozen water for everyone in the family as it will melt quickly and you will need a lot of it. Secondly buy an express pass. We didn't and due to this we only managed to go on three rides as waiting in queues for 60-70 minutes with you children is not fun. If you go without children and don't mind going on a ride without your friends then go in the single line queue, in most cases you will go to the front of the line. Food is massively overpriced so try to take some of your own. Now for the good stuff, the rides we did go on we're awesome, Transformers , Jurassic water ride & The Madagascar water ride. The kids loved the Madagascar ride even if it was a little tame for us. This is one ride we didn't have to queue for too long for. Staff were super friendly and went out of their way to be helpful. We will go back one day but will buy express pass in advance so that we do t notice the cost as much. One further tip, take a hand held fan ( can buy cheap from Chinatown) will help on the very hot days and in queues

A great place for a family hangout. It has something for everyone - slow, entertaining rides for kids and the elderly and crazy roller coasters for teens and young adults. Though expensive, it is a must visit for tourists.

Amazing place with something or the other in abundance for all age groups. Weekdays are anyday a better choice to visit as weekends can be very busy. Strongly recommend "Universal Express Unlimited Pass" as it lets you skip the long queues and enjoy to the maximum. The passes come at a cost but they rwally are worth it. Great rides and a must visit for all age groups. Can be tiring too as it almost can last a complete day trying all their rides. Good and plenty eating joints all through the park.

Reach Sentosa as early as possible. Spend the whole day at Universal Studios. The rides are trilling especially the ones at Lost World - Jurassic Park. The 5D ride in the Hollywood section was great and worth experiencing. The food at the stalls is good.

Its a must visit place in Singapore if you havent been to any other Universal Studio. Must try/see: - Transformers - Mummy Ride - Some water show (dont remember the name). Please dont be late for the show otherwise you wont be allowed to enter. I guess there are 2 shows per day.
This is awesome! Beauty of the Universal studio is fantastic! We have enjoyed so much with my family and friends! The architectural design is very nice!

Clean, well organised and easy to get to using MRT and Monorail. We went on a Monday but it was busy. We got an Express pass which was and extra $50 per person but well worth it because it dramatically cuts down the que time .This is important in very hot weather with a 9 year old.  Plenty of places to eat and the New York Steakhouse understands Gluten free (only place to get GF food there, expensive, but worth it).

A fun way to spend the day with our 4 & 6 year old kids. Plenty to do for all ages. We spent the extra money on express passes which was well worth it as lines were crazy long. If it wasn't such an expensive day we could have done with a 2nd day there as there was heaps to do.
The place is a must see in Singapore. Its a theme park with awesome roller coasters. There are artist shows as well as real shows.

We had celebrated our 25 anniversary with our teenaged. This place indeed is the best place to visit along with your family and friends. There's so much to do here during visit we've been to many Hollywood studios replicas with their own amphitheater. This place gives an impression of real Hollywood.  Must visit for families.
Another must see in Singapore The theme rides are amazing Loved the Transformers theme, it is just mind blowing

It was good fun with my family at the Universal studios..however the florida universal studios is lot better..all the good rides had super long queues which was boring!! better to visit it on a weekday I suppose.. a must visit nevertheless.. :)

Universal studios is a must visit for all tourists. With a variety of easy, difficult and extremely challenging rides, universal studios offers an experience for people of all ages. The best is the character parade held on weekends. Children as well as adults get extremely excited in seeing their favourite characters roaming on the streets of New York.
Despite being physically small, it has all the rides of its global brethren. Staff is friendly and helpful. Pricing is pretty standard.

We went outside the local Singaporean school holidays but the queues for each ride were still 1 hour +. In the heat my patience was tested and overall I didn't enjoy myself. The rides were good but for all that waiting I don't think it was worth it although the staff on the rides were nice. Gave up waiting at the American Diner as there was one line and it was nearly out the door. The line didn't move after 20 mins so we left. There are plenty of other food courts though. One thing that did feel like magic was a cold drink in AC! The bathrooms were very clean and plentiful. At the end of the day we waited another 1 hour at the taxi stand. So basically I stood around waiting for 8 hours of the day. Oh well....been there, done that, got the T-shirt!!

I have been to both Universal parks in the U.S. with Orlando being the best, Singapore has the second best. This is an amazing park and even tho it's small it doesn't feel like it and you get your money's worth. Just make sure to get the fastpass to skip all the lines. You won't regret it.
This place was beautiful. Food is great, very well priced and so much to see and do. Really wanting to go back again one day
Good!! Lucky me i don't have to q for entrance. Very good but too many people Inside the theme park!!

Definitely buy a skip the queue ticket we didn't and wish we had its hot hot hot lining up for ages even though we went on Monday . Buy your tickets from your hotel and receive vouchers to spend on food and merchandise.

Went on a Sunday and found the park extremely crowded and small. Queues for Battlestar Galactica was more than an hour long so it would be worthwhile paying more for express entry to save all the time wasted on waiting.
This is a place where everybody could just have fun . We went as soon as it was open so it was less crowded and enjoyed it very much .

We went on athursday july 2015, so many people, we had a blunder we lined up for the transformer which was had the greatest review, yes it was good but not worth the almost 2 hrs wait. A visit to universal studios with an 8 year old and a 10 year old - perfect ages (and heights) to enjoy all of the rides.
